units.zh: 五禮之別，二曰凶。
units.en: Among the five canonical rituals, the second category is mourning for the dead.
units.literal: Of the five kinds of ritual, the second is called 'inauspicious' (mourning).

units.zh: 自天子至於庶人，身體髮膚，受之父母，其理既均，其情亦等，生則養，死則哀，故曰三年之喪，天下之達禮者也。
units.en: From the sovereign to the humblest subject, flesh and hair come from one's parents; the duty is the same and the grief no different—while they live we sustain them, when they die we mourn them. Hence the canon calls three years' mourning the rite that runs through all the world.
units.literal: From the Son of Heaven down to the common people, body, skin, and hair are received from father and mother; the principle is uniform and the feeling equal—in life they nurture, in death they mourn; therefore it is said that three years' mourning is the penetrating rite of the realm.

units.zh: 漢禮，天子崩，自不豫至於登遐及葬，喪紀之制，與夫三代變易。
units.en: Han court precedent for an emperor's death—from the first illness through the lying-in-state to interment—shifted its mourning code across the Xia, Shang, and Zhou models.
units.literal: Under Han ritual, when the Son of Heaven collapsed, from the first illness through the final journey to burial, the mourning regulations changed with the Three Dynasties.

units.zh: 魏晉以來，大體同漢。
units.en: From the Wei through the Jin, the dynasty largely kept Han practice.
units.literal: From Wei and Jin onward, the broad pattern matched Han.

units.zh: 然自漢文革喪禮之制，後代遵之，無復三年之禮。
units.en: Yet once Emperor Wen of Han pared the mourning statutes, every succeeding age copied his shortcut, and the full three-year observance disappeared.
units.literal: Yet from Emperor Wen of Han's reform of mourning regulations, later ages followed it and no longer practiced three years' mourning.

units.zh: 及魏武臨終，遺令「天下尚未安定，未得遵古。
units.en: When Wei Wu was near death, he left a command: 'All under Heaven is not yet settled; I cannot follow antiquity.
units.literal: When Wei Wu was near death, he left a command: 'All under Heaven is not yet settled; I cannot follow antiquity.

units.zh: 百官當臨中者，十五舉音，葬畢便除。
units.en: For the hundred officials who should attend at the central halt, raise the dirge fifteen times; when burial is finished, remove mourning at once.
units.literal: For the hundred officials who should attend at the central halt, raise the dirge fifteen times; when burial is finished, remove mourning at once.

units.zh: 其將兵屯戍者，不得離部。」
units.en: Those who command troops on garrison may not leave their commands.'
units.literal: Those who command troops on garrison may not leave their commands.'

units.zh: 魏武以正月庚子崩，辛丑即殯，是月丁卯葬，是為不逾月也。
units.en: Cao Cao died on the gengzi day of the first month; by xinchou the bier stood ready; dingmao that same month saw the interment—mourning lifted inside a single month.
units.literal: Wei Wu died on gengzi in the first month; on xinchou he was encoffined; on dingmao that same month he was buried—this is what is meant by 'not exceeding one month.'

units.zh: 及宣帝、景帝之崩，並從權制。
units.en: The deaths of Sima Yi and Sima Shi were handled under the same shortened schedule.
units.literal: When Emperor Xuan and Emperor Jing died, each likewise followed the expedient code.

units.zh: 文帝之崩，國內服三日。
units.en: When Sima Zhao died, the whole state wore mourning for three days and no more.
units.literal: When Emperor Wen died, the realm observed mourning for three days only.

units.zh: 武帝亦遵漢魏之典，既葬除喪，然猶深衣素冠，降席撤膳。
units.en: Emperor Sima Yan kept the Han–Wei rule of ending court mourning at burial, but he still dressed in plain hemp deep robes, set aside brocade cushions, and ate only coarse fare.
units.literal: Emperor Wu likewise followed Han and Wei precedent: once the burial ended he set aside formal mourning, yet still wore plain deep garments and an undyed cap, lowered his mat, and withdrew rich food from his table.

units.zh: 太宰司馬孚、太傅鄭沖、太保王祥、太尉何曾、司徒領中領軍司馬望、司空荀顗、車騎將軍賈充、尚書令裴秀、尚書僕射武陔、都護大將軍郭建、侍中郭綏、中書監荀勖、中軍將軍羊祜等奏曰：「臣聞禮典軌度，豐殺隨時，虞夏商周，咸不相襲，蓋有由也。
units.en: Grand Preceptor Sima Fu, Grand Tutor Zheng Chong, Grand Guardian Wang Xiang, Grand Commandant He Ceng, Minister of Education concurrently Central Army commander Sima Wang, Minister of Works Xun Yi, General of Chariots and Cavalry Jia Chong, Prefect of the Masters of Writing Pei Xiu, Vice Minister of the Masters of Writing Wu Gai, Chief Protector and Grand General Guo Jian, Palace Attendant Guo Sui, Director of the Palace Secretariat Xun Xu, Central Army General Yang Hu, and others memorialized: 'We have heard that ritual canons and measures wax or wane with the times; the houses of Yu, Xia, Shang, and Zhou never blindly copied one another—each had its reasons.
units.literal: Grand Preceptor Sima Fu, Grand Tutor Zheng Chong, Grand Guardian Wang Xiang, Grand Commandant He Ceng, Minister of Education concurrently Central Army commander Sima Wang, Minister of Works Xun Yi, General of Chariots and Cavalry Jia Chong, Prefect of the Masters of Writing Pei Xiu, Vice Minister of the Masters of Writing Wu Yan, Chief Protector and Grand General Guo Jian, Palace Attendant Guo Sui, Director of the Palace Secretariat Xun Xu, Central Army General Yang Hu, and others memorialized: 'We have heard that ritual canons and measures wax or wane with the times; the houses of Yu, Xia, Shang, and Zhou never blindly copied one another—each had its reasons.

units.zh: 大晉紹承漢魏，有革有因，期於足以興化而已，故未得皆返太素，同規上古也。
units.en: Great Jin inherits Han and Wei with some reforms and some continuities, aiming only to lift custom where it must; therefore it cannot yet return wholesale to pristine antiquity or match high antiquity in a single stroke.
units.literal: Great Jin inherits Han and Wei with some reforms and some continuities, aiming only to lift custom where it must; therefore it cannot yet return wholesale to pristine antiquity or match high antiquity in a single stroke.

units.zh: 陛下既以俯遵漢魏降喪之典，以濟時務，而躬蹈大孝，情過乎哀，素冠深衣，降席撤膳，雖武丁行之于殷世，曾閔履之於布衣，未足以逾。
units.en: Your Majesty has already bowed to Han and Wei's lowered mourning canons to meet pressing affairs, yet you personally tread the utmost filial path; your feeling overshoots moderation—plain cap, deep garments, lowered mat, curtailed meals—even King Wuding in the Yin age or Zengzi and Min Ziqian as commoners did not surpass this.
units.literal: Your Majesty has already bowed to Han and Wei's lowered mourning canons to meet pressing affairs, yet you personally tread the utmost filial path; your feeling overshoots moderation—plain cap, deep garments, lowered mat, curtailed meals—even King Wuding in the Yin age or Zengzi and Min Ziqian as commoners did not surpass this.

units.zh: 方今荊蠻未夷，庶政未乂，萬機事殷，動勞神慮，豈遑全遂聖旨，以從至情。
units.en: Now the southern tribes are not yet pacified, government is not yet ordered, and myriad threads of business press upon you, taxing mind and spirit—how could you wholly indulge sage intent and the utmost of private feeling?
units.literal: Now the southern tribes are not yet pacified, government is not yet ordered, and myriad threads of business press upon you, taxing mind and spirit—how could you wholly indulge sage intent and the utmost of private feeling?

units.zh: 臣等以為陛下宜割情以康時濟俗，輒敕御府易服，內省改坐，太官復膳，諸所施行，皆如舊制。」
units.en: We your servants therefore believe Your Majesty should cut private feeling to heal the age and aid custom; we dare order the Palace Treasury to exchange garments, the inner apartments to restore seating, the Grand Provisioner to restore full meals, and every other measure to follow the standing regulations.'
units.literal: We your servants therefore believe Your Majesty should cut private feeling to heal the age and aid custom; we dare order the Palace Treasury to exchange garments, the inner apartments to restore seating, the Grand Provisioner to restore full meals, and every other measure to follow the standing regulations.'

units.zh: 詔曰：「每感念幽冥，而不得終苴絰於草土，以存此痛，況當食稻衣錦，誠詭然激切其心，非所以相解也。
units.en: The edict replied: 'Whenever I brood on the shades below and realize I cannot finish wearing straw cord on the burial mound to keep this pain alive—how much more to eat polished rice and wear brocade—indeed it stabs the heart; that is no way to console myself.
units.literal: The edict replied: 'Whenever I brood on the shades below and realize I cannot finish wearing straw cord on the burial mound to keep this pain alive—how much more to eat polished rice and wear brocade—indeed it stabs the heart; that is no way to console myself.

units.zh: 吾本諸生家，傳禮來久，何心一旦便易此情於所天！
units.en: I was born to a house of scholars; the rites have been handed down among us a long time—how could my heart one morning cast off this feeling toward him who is my heaven!
units.literal: I was born to a house of scholars; the rites have been handed down among us a long time—how could my heart one morning cast off this feeling toward him who is my heaven!

units.zh: 相從已多，可試省孔子答宰我之言，無事紛紜也。
units.en: You have followed me long; try reviewing Confucius's answer to Zai Wo—do not fuss at me again and again.
units.literal: You have followed me long; try reviewing Confucius's answer to Zai Wo—do not fuss at me again and again.

units.zh: 言及悲剝，柰何！
units.en: When words touch grief it tears the heart—what can be done!
units.literal: When words touch grief it tears the heart—what can be done!

units.zh: 柰何！」
units.en: What can be done!'
units.literal: What can be done!'

units.zh: 孚等重奏：「伏讀聖詔，感以悲懷，輒思仲尼所以抑宰我之問，聖思所以不能已已，甚深甚篤。
units.en: Fu and the others rememorialized: 'We have read the sage edict and are moved to grief; we reflect on why Confucius checked Zai Wo's question—the sage mind cannot stop itself; the feeling is very deep and very earnest.
units.literal: Fu and the others rememorialized: 'We have read the sage edict and are moved to grief; we reflect on why Confucius checked Zai Wo's question—the sage mind cannot stop itself; the feeling is very deep and very earnest.

units.zh: 然今者干戈未戢，武事未偃，萬機至重，天下至眾。
units.en: Yet now weapons are not yet stilled, military affairs not yet rested, the myriad threads are weightiest, and all under Heaven is most numerous.
units.literal: Yet now weapons are not yet stilled, military affairs not yet rested, the myriad threads are weightiest, and all under Heaven is most numerous.

units.zh: 陛下以萬乘之尊，履布衣之禮，服粗席稿，水飲疏食，殷憂內盈，毀悴外表。
units.en: Your Majesty in the honor of ten thousand chariots treads the rites of a commoner—coarse mat and straw padding, drinking water and eating coarse food, sorrow swelling within, emaciation showing without.
units.literal: Your Majesty in the honor of ten thousand chariots treads the rites of a commoner—coarse mat and straw padding, drinking water and eating coarse food, sorrow swelling within, emaciation showing without.

units.zh: 而躬勤萬機，坐而待旦，降心接下，仄不遑食，所以勞力者如斯之甚。
units.en: Yet you personally toil at myriad threads of state, sit awaiting dawn, humble your heart to receive subordinates, and lean so far you have no leisure to eat—such labor of strength is extreme.
units.literal: Yet you personally toil at myriad threads of state, sit awaiting dawn, humble your heart to receive subordinates, and lean so far you have no leisure to eat—such labor of strength is extreme.

units.zh: 是以臣等悚息不寧，誠懼神氣用損，以疚大事。
units.en: Therefore we your servants tremble and breathe uneasily, truly fearing that spirit will be depleted and the great affair harmed.
units.literal: Therefore we your servants tremble and breathe uneasily, truly fearing that spirit will be depleted and the great affair harmed.

units.zh: 輒敕有司，改坐復常，率由舊典。
units.en: We dare order the relevant offices to restore your seat and routine, following the old canons.
units.literal: We dare order the relevant offices to restore your seat and routine, following the old canons.

units.zh: 惟陛下察納愚款，以慰皇太后之心。」
units.en: Only let Your Majesty examine and accept our foolish sincerity, so as to console the heart of the Empress Dowager.'
units.literal: Only let Your Majesty examine and accept our foolish sincerity, so as to console the heart of the Empress Dowager.'

units.zh: 又詔曰：「重覽奏議，益以悲剝，不能自勝，柰何！
units.en: Another edict said: 'Rereading your memorials only deepens the tearing grief; I cannot master myself—what can be done!
units.literal: Another edict said: 'Rereading your memorials only deepens the tearing grief; I cannot master myself—what can be done!

units.zh: 柰何！
units.en: What can be done!
units.literal: What can be done!

units.zh: 三年之喪，自古達禮，誠聖人稱情立衷，明恕而行也。
units.en: Three years' mourning has from antiquity been the penetrating rite of the realm; truly the sages weighed human feeling, set the inner mean, and acted with enlightened forbearance.
units.literal: Three years' mourning has from antiquity been the penetrating rite of the realm; truly the sages weighed human feeling, set the inner mean, and acted with enlightened forbearance.

units.zh: 神靈日遠，無所訴告，雖薄於情，食旨服美，所不堪也。
units.en: The spirits grow daily more distant; there is nowhere to cry complaint—though the outward show be slight, to taste rich food and wear fine cloth is unbearable.
units.literal: The spirits grow daily more distant; there is nowhere to cry complaint—though the outward show be slight, to taste rich food and wear fine cloth is unbearable.

units.zh: 不宜反覆，重傷其心，言用斷絕，柰何！
units.en: You ought not go back and forth and doubly wound this heart; I break off words—what can be done!
units.literal: You ought not go back and forth and doubly wound this heart; I break off words—what can be done!

units.zh: 柰何！」
units.en: What can be done!'
units.literal: What can be done!'

units.zh: 帝遂以此禮終三年。
units.en: With that he carried the full three-year vigil despite every plea.
units.literal: The emperor therefore observed mourning to the full three years under this rite.

units.zh: 後居太后之喪亦如之。
units.en: He repeated the same austerity when the empress dowager died.
units.literal: Later, when mourning the Empress Dowager, he did the same.

units.zh: 泰始二年八月，詔曰：「此上旬，先帝棄天下日也，便以周年。
units.en: In the eighth month of the second year of Taishi, an edict said, "This first third of the month is the day on which the late emperor abandoned all under Heaven, and it is now the full year.
units.literal: In the eighth month of the second year of Taishi, an edict said, "This first third of the month is the day on which the late emperor abandoned all under Heaven, and it is now the full year.

units.zh: 吾煢煢，當復何時一得敘人子之情邪！
units.en: I am alone and bereft. At what time could I ever once express the feelings of a son!
units.literal: I am alone and bereft. At what time could I ever once express the feelings of a son!

units.zh: 思慕煩毒，欲詔陵瞻侍，以盡哀憤。
units.en: My longing and grief trouble and poison me, and I wish to order a visit and attendance at the mausoleum, in order to exhaust my grief and resentment.
units.literal: My longing and grief trouble and poison me, and I wish to order a visit and attendance at the mausoleum, in order to exhaust my grief and resentment.

units.zh: 主者具行備。」
units.en: Let the responsible officials fully prepare the procession."
units.literal: Let the responsible officials fully prepare the procession."

units.zh: 太宰安平王孚、尚書令裴秀、尚書僕射武陔等奏：「陛下至孝蒸蒸，哀思罔極。
units.en: Grand Steward Prince Fu of Anping, Director of the Secretariat Pei Xiu, Vice Director of the Secretariat Wu Gai, and others memorialized, "Your Majesty's utmost filial piety rises abundantly, and your grieving thoughts have no limit.
units.literal: Grand Steward Prince Fu of Anping, Director of the Secretariat Pei Xiu, Vice Director of the Secretariat Wu Gai, and others memorialized, "Your Majesty's utmost filial piety rises abundantly, and your grieving thoughts have no limit.

units.zh: 衰麻雖除，哀毀疏食，有損神和。
units.en: Although sackcloth and hemp have been removed, grieving self-injury and coarse food damage the harmony of the spirit.
units.literal: Although sackcloth and hemp have been removed, grieving self-injury and coarse food damage the harmony of the spirit.

units.zh: 今雖秋節，尚有餘暑，謁見山陵，悲感摧傷，群下竊用竦息，以為宜降抑聖情，以慰萬國。」
units.en: Now, although it is the autumn season, there is still remaining heat. To visit and see the mountain mausoleum would bring grief and feeling that crush and wound you. We below privately tremble and hold our breath, and consider it fitting that you lower and restrain the sacred feelings, in order to comfort the myriad states."
units.literal: Now, although it is the autumn season, there is still remaining heat. To visit and see the mountain mausoleum would bring grief and feeling that crush and wound you. We below privately tremble and hold our breath, and consider it fitting that you lower and restrain the sacred feelings, in order to comfort the myriad states."

units.zh: 詔曰：「孤煢忽爾，日月已周，痛慕摧感，永無逮及。
units.en: An edict said, "I was suddenly made orphaned and bereft, and the days and months have already completed the cycle. Pain and longing crush and move me; there is forever no way to reach him.
units.literal: An edict said, "I was suddenly made orphaned and bereft, and the days and months have already completed the cycle. Pain and longing crush and move me; there is forever no way to reach him.

units.zh: 欲瞻奉山陵，以敘哀憤，體氣自佳耳。
units.en: I wish to look upon and attend the mountain mausoleum, in order to express my grief and resentment. My physical energy is naturally still good.
units.literal: I wish to look upon and attend the mountain mausoleum, in order to express my grief and resentment. My physical energy is naturally still good.

units.zh: 又已涼，便當行，不得如所奏也。
units.en: Moreover, it is already cool, and I shall go at once. I cannot do as you memorialized.
units.literal: Moreover, it is already cool, and I shall go at once. I cannot do as you memorialized.

units.zh: 主者便具行備。」
units.en: Let the responsible officials fully prepare the procession at once."
units.literal: Let the responsible officials fully prepare the procession at once."

units.zh: 又詔曰：「漢文不使天下盡哀，亦帝王至謙之志。
units.en: Another edict said, "That Emperor Wen of Han did not make all under Heaven exhaust grief was also the supremely modest intent of an emperor and king.
units.literal: Another edict said, "That Emperor Wen of Han did not make all under Heaven exhaust grief was also the supremely modest intent of an emperor and king.

units.zh: 當見山陵，何心而無服，其以衰絰行。」
units.en: When I am to see the mountain mausoleum, with what heart could I be without mourning dress? Let me go wearing sackcloth and headband."
units.literal: When I am to see the mountain mausoleum, with what heart could I be without mourning dress? Let me go wearing sackcloth and headband."

units.zh: 孚等重奏曰：「臣聞上古喪期無數，後世乃有年月之漸。
units.en: Fu and the others again memorialized, "We your servants have heard that in high antiquity mourning terms had no fixed number, and only in later ages did there gradually come to be years and months.
units.literal: Fu and the others again memorialized, "We your servants have heard that in high antiquity mourning terms had no fixed number, and only in later ages did there gradually come to be years and months.

units.zh: 漢文帝隨時之義，制為短喪，傳之於後。
units.en: Emperor Wen of Han followed the meaning of the time, made a system of shortened mourning, and transmitted it to later ages.
units.literal: Emperor Wen of Han followed the meaning of the time, made a system of shortened mourning, and transmitted it to later ages.

units.zh: 陛下以社稷宗廟之重，萬方億兆之故，既從權制，釋除衰麻，群臣百姓吉服，今者謁陵，以敘哀慕，若加衰絰，進退無當。
units.en: Because of the weight of the altars of soil and grain and the ancestral temple, and because of the countless people in the myriad regions, Your Majesty has already followed the expedient system, released and removed sackcloth and hemp, and the assembled ministers and hundred surnames wear auspicious dress. Now, in visiting the mausoleum to express grief and longing, if you add sackcloth and headband, neither advance nor retreat would be fitting.
units.literal: Because of the weight of the altars of soil and grain and the ancestral temple, and because of the countless people in the myriad regions, Your Majesty has already followed the expedient system, released and removed sackcloth and hemp, and the assembled ministers and hundred surnames wear auspicious dress. Now, in visiting the mausoleum to express grief and longing, if you add sackcloth and headband, neither advance nor retreat would be fitting.

units.zh: 不敢奉詔。」
units.en: We dare not receive and carry out the edict."
units.literal: We dare not receive and carry out the edict."

units.zh: 詔曰：「亦知不在此麻布耳。
units.en: An edict said, "I also know that it does not lie in this hempen cloth.
units.literal: An edict said, "I also know that it does not lie in this hempen cloth.

units.zh: 然人子情思，為欲令哀喪之物在身，蓋近情也。
units.en: Yet the feelings and thoughts of a son are such that he wants the things of grief and mourning to be on his body; this is probably close to the feeling.
units.literal: Yet the feelings and thoughts of a son are such that he wants the things of grief and mourning to be on his body; this is probably close to the feeling.

units.zh: 群臣自當案舊制。」
units.en: The assembled ministers should themselves follow the old system."
units.literal: The assembled ministers should themselves follow the old system."

units.zh: 孚等又奏曰：「臣聞聖人制作，必從時宜。
units.en: Fu and the others again memorialized, "We your servants have heard that when the sages made institutions, they always followed what was fitting to the time.
units.literal: Fu and the others again memorialized, "We your servants have heard that when the sages made institutions, they always followed what was fitting to the time.

units.zh: 故五帝殊樂，三王異禮，此古今所以不同，質文所以迭用也。
units.en: Therefore the Five Emperors differed in music, and the Three Kings differed in ritual. This is why ancient and modern are not the same, and why substance and refinement are used in alternation.
units.literal: Therefore the Five Emperors differed in music, and the Three Kings differed in ritual. This is why ancient and modern are not the same, and why substance and refinement are used in alternation.

units.zh: 陛下隨時之宜，既降心克己，俯就權制，既除衰麻，而行心喪之禮，今復制服，義無所依。
units.en: Your Majesty followed what was fitting to the time, lowered your heart and overcame yourself, bowed down to the expedient system, already removed sackcloth and hemp, and practiced the ritual of mourning in the heart. Now to again put on the regulated dress has no meaning on which to rely.
units.literal: Your Majesty followed what was fitting to the time, lowered your heart and overcame yourself, bowed down to the expedient system, already removed sackcloth and hemp, and practiced the ritual of mourning in the heart. Now to again put on the regulated dress has no meaning on which to rely.

units.zh: 若君服而臣不服，亦未之敢安也。
units.en: If the ruler wears mourning dress and the ministers do not, this too is not something we would dare consider at ease.
units.literal: If the ruler wears mourning dress and the ministers do not, this too is not something we would dare consider at ease.

units.zh: 參議宜如前奏。」
units.en: Our joint deliberation holds that it should be as in the previous memorial."
units.literal: Our joint deliberation holds that it should be as in the previous memorial."

units.zh: 詔曰：「患情不能跂及耳，衣服何在。
units.en: An edict said, "What I suffer from is only that my feelings cannot stretch to reach him; what does it have to do with clothing?
units.literal: An edict said, "What I suffer from is only that my feelings cannot stretch to reach him; what does it have to do with clothing?

units.zh: 諸君勤勤之至，豈苟相違。」，
units.en: You gentlemen are diligent to the utmost. How could I merely oppose you?"
units.literal: You gentlemen are diligent to the utmost. How could I merely oppose you?"

units.zh: 泰始四年，皇太后崩。
units.en: In the fourth year of Taishi, the Empress Dowager died.
units.literal: In the fourth year of Taishi, the Empress Dowager died.

units.zh: 有司奏：「前代故事，倚廬中施白縑帳、蓐、素床，以布巾裹塊草，軺輦、版輿、細犢車皆施縑裏。」
units.en: The responsible offices memorialized, "Former-generation precedents set white silk curtains, mats, and a plain bed in the leaning hut, wrapped clods and grass in a cloth kerchief, and applied silk linings to the light carriage, plank carriage, and small-calf cart."
units.literal: The responsible offices memorialized, "Former-generation precedents set white silk curtains, mats, and a plain bed in the leaning hut, wrapped clods and grass in a cloth kerchief, and applied silk linings to the light carriage, plank carriage, and small-calf cart."

units.zh: 詔不聽，但令以布衣車而已，其餘居喪之制，不改禮文。
units.en: He refused the silks but allowed plain carts only, leaving every other mourning rule as written in the canon.
units.literal: The edict did not consent; it ordered only plain-cloth carts; as for the rest of the dwelling-in-mourning system, it did not alter the ritual text.

units.zh: 有司又奏：「大行皇太后當以四月二十五日安厝。
units.en: The responsible offices again memorialized, "The deceased Empress Dowager should be interred on the twenty-fifth day of the fourth month.
units.literal: The responsible offices again memorialized, "The deceased Empress Dowager should be interred on the twenty-fifth day of the fourth month.

units.zh: 故事，虞著衰服，既虞而除。
units.en: According to precedent, at the yu sacrifice one wears mourning dress, and after the yu sacrifice one removes it.
units.literal: According to precedent, at the yu sacrifice one wears mourning dress, and after the yu sacrifice one removes it.

units.zh: 其內外官僚皆就朝晡臨位，御除服訖，各還所次除衰服。」
units.en: Let the officials inside and outside all go to their mourning positions at morning and afternoon, and when the imperial removal of dress is complete, each return to his quarters and remove mourning dress."
units.literal: Let the officials inside and outside all go to their mourning positions at morning and afternoon, and when the imperial removal of dress is complete, each return to his quarters and remove mourning dress."

units.zh: 詔曰：「夫三年之喪，天下之達禮也。
units.en: An edict said, "The three-year mourning is the universally observed ritual throughout all under Heaven.
units.literal: An edict said, "The three-year mourning is the universally observed ritual throughout all under Heaven.

units.zh: 受終身之愛，而無數年之報，柰何葬而便即吉，情所不忍也。」
units.en: Having received a lifetime of love, yet making no repayment of several years: how could one be buried and then immediately return to felicity? My feeling cannot bear it."
units.literal: Having received a lifetime of love, yet making no repayment of several years: how could one be buried and then immediately return to felicity? My feeling cannot bear it."

units.zh: 有司又奏：「世有險易，道有洿隆，所遇之時異，誠有由然，非忽禮也。
units.en: The responsible offices again memorialized, "Ages have danger and ease, and the Way has hollows and heights. That the times encountered differ truly has reasons; it is not disregard for ritual.
units.literal: The responsible offices again memorialized, "Ages have danger and ease, and the Way has hollows and heights. That the times encountered differ truly has reasons; it is not disregard for ritual.

units.zh: 方今戎馬未散，王事至殷，更須聽斷，以熙庶績。
units.en: At present, war horses have not yet dispersed, and royal affairs are extremely urgent. It is further necessary to hear and decide matters, in order to brighten the many tasks.
units.literal: At present, war horses have not yet dispersed, and royal affairs are extremely urgent. It is further necessary to hear and decide matters, in order to brighten the many tasks.

units.zh: 昔周康王始登翌室，猶戴冕臨朝。
units.en: Formerly, when King Kang of Zhou first ascended the next chamber, he still wore the cap and robe and attended court.
units.literal: Formerly, when King Kang of Zhou first ascended the next chamber, he still wore the cap and robe and attended court.

units.zh: 降于漢魏，既葬除釋，諒闇之禮，自遠代而廢矣。
units.en: Down to Han and Wei, after burial mourning was removed and released, and the ritual of liang'an had been abandoned since distant ages.
units.literal: Down to Han and Wei, after burial mourning was removed and released, and the ritual of liang'an had been abandoned since distant ages.

units.zh: 惟陛下割高宗之制，從當時之宜。」
units.en: We only ask Your Majesty to cut back the system of Gaozong and follow what is fitting to the present time."
units.literal: We only ask Your Majesty to cut back the system of Gaozong and follow what is fitting to the present time."

units.zh: 詔曰：「夫三年之喪，所以盡情致禮，葬已便除，所不堪也。
units.en: An edict said, "The three-year mourning is how one exhausts feeling and brings ritual to completion. To remove it once burial is finished is what I cannot bear.
units.literal: An edict said, "The three-year mourning is how one exhausts feeling and brings ritual to completion. To remove it once burial is finished is what I cannot bear.

units.zh: 當敘吾哀懷，言用斷絕，柰何！
units.en: When I try to express my grief, words are cut off. What can I do!
units.literal: When I try to express my grief, words are cut off. What can I do!

units.zh: 柰何！」
units.en: What can I do!"
units.literal: What can I do!"

units.zh: 有司又固請。
units.en: The bureaus petitioned again, harder.
units.literal: The offices again firmly requested.

units.zh: 詔曰：「不能篤孝，勿以毀傷為憂也。
units.en: An edict said, "If I cannot be deeply filial, do not take self-injury as a worry.
units.literal: An edict said, "If I cannot be deeply filial, do not take self-injury as a worry.

units.zh: 誠知衣服末事耳，然今思存草土，率當以吉物奪之，乃所以重傷至心，非見念也。
units.en: I truly know that clothing is a minor matter. Yet now, when my thoughts are to remain with grass and earth, to take it away by means of auspicious things is precisely to wound the utmost heart again; it is not thinking of me.
units.literal: I truly know that clothing is a minor matter. Yet now, when my thoughts are to remain with grass and earth, to take it away by means of auspicious things is precisely to wound the utmost heart again; it is not thinking of me.

units.zh: 每代禮典質文皆不同耳，何為限以近制，使達喪闕然乎！」
units.en: In each age, ritual codes differ in substance and refinement. Why restrict me by a recent system and make the universal mourning deficient!"
units.literal: In each age, ritual codes differ in substance and refinement. Why restrict me by a recent system and make the universal mourning deficient!"

units.zh: 群臣又固請，帝流涕久之乃許。
units.en: Ministers pressed until he wept long and yielded.
units.literal: The many ministers again firmly requested; the emperor wept a long time and then consented.

units.zh: 文明皇后崩及武元楊后崩，天下將吏發哀三日止。
units.en: When Empress Wenming died and when Empress Yang the consort of Wu died, officers empire-wide wailed three days only.
units.literal: When Empress Dowager Wenming died and when Empress Wu-Yuan Yang died, officers throughout the realm raised mourning for three days and then stopped.

units.zh: 穆帝崩，哀帝立。
units.en: Emperor Ai succeeded when Emperor Mu passed.
units.literal: When Emperor Mu died, Emperor Ai was enthroned.

units.zh: 帝于穆帝為從父昆弟，穆帝舅褚歆有表，中書答表朝廷無其儀，詔下議。
units.en: Ai was Mu's cousin; Mu's uncle Chu Xin asked how to mourn; the Secretariat said no rule existed and the throne sent the case to debate.
units.literal: The emperor toward Emperor Mu was a father's-brother's son; Emperor Mu's maternal uncle Chu Xin submitted a memorial; the Secretariat replied to the memorial that the court had no such precedent, and an edict sent the matter down for deliberation.

units.zh: 尚書僕射江虨等四人並云，閔僖兄弟也，而為父子，則哀帝應為帝嗣。
units.en: Jiang Pin and four others cited Duke Min and Duke Xi of Lu—brothers treated as father and son—and argued Ai should be the late emperor's heir.
units.literal: Vice Minister of the Masters of Writing Jiang Pin and four others together said: 'Duke Min and Duke Xi were brothers yet treated as father and son—therefore Emperor Ai ought to follow the emperor's line of succession.'

units.zh: 衛軍王述等二十五人云「成帝不私親愛，越授天倫，康帝受命顯宗。
units.en: Guard General Wang Shu and twenty-five others said, "Emperor Cheng did not privately favor his own loved ones, but passed beyond natural kinship in conferring the succession, and Emperor Kang received the command from Xianzong.
units.literal: Guard General Wang Shu and twenty-five others said, "Emperor Cheng did not privately favor his own loved ones, but passed beyond natural kinship in conferring the succession, and Emperor Kang received the command from Xianzong.

units.zh: 社稷之重，已移所授，纂承之序，宜繼康皇。」
units.en: The weight of the altars of soil and grain had already moved to the one who received it, and in the sequence of succession it is fitting to continue Emperor Kang."
units.literal: The weight of the altars of soil and grain had already moved to the one who received it, and in the sequence of succession it is fitting to continue Emperor Kang."

units.zh: 尚書謝奉等六人云：「繼體之正，宜本天屬，考之人情，宜繼顯宗也。」
units.en: Xie Feng of the Secretariat and six others said, "The correctness of inheriting the body should be rooted in Heaven-given kinship. Examining it according to human feeling, it is fitting to continue Xianzong."
units.literal: Xie Feng of the Secretariat and six others said, "The correctness of inheriting the body should be rooted in Heaven-given kinship. Examining it according to human feeling, it is fitting to continue Xianzong."

units.zh: 詔從述等議，上繼顯宗。
units.en: The edict followed Wang Shu and the others and ordered succession to continue Xianzong.
units.literal: The edict followed Wang Shu and the others' debate and ordered succession to continue Emperor Yuan.

units.zh: 寧康二年七月，簡文帝崩再周而遇閏。
units.en: In the second year of Ningkang, in the seventh month, Emperor Jianwen died just as the second mourning round collided with an intercalary month.
units.literal: In the second year of Ningkang, in the seventh month Emperor Jianwen died—the second full mourning cycle met an intercalary month.

units.zh: 博士謝攸、孔粲議：「魯襄二十八年十二月乙未，楚子卒，實閏月而言十二月者，附正於前月也。
units.en: Erudites Xie You and Kong Can deliberated, "In the twenty-eighth year of Duke Xiang of Lu, in the twelfth month, yiwei, the viscount of Chu died. It was actually an intercalary month, but saying twelfth month attached the regular designation to the preceding month.
units.literal: Erudites Xie You and Kong Can deliberated, "In the twenty-eighth year of Duke Xiang of Lu, in the twelfth month, yiwei, the viscount of Chu died. It was actually an intercalary month, but saying twelfth month attached the regular designation to the preceding month.

units.zh: 喪事先遠，則應用博士吳商之言，以閏月祥。」
units.en: For mourning affairs, one first chooses what is distant; therefore one should use the words of Erudite Wu Shang and hold the xiang sacrifice in the intercalary month."
units.literal: For mourning affairs, one first chooses what is distant; therefore one should use the words of Erudite Wu Shang and hold the xiang sacrifice in the intercalary month."

units.zh: 尚書僕射謝安、中領軍王劭、散騎常侍鄭襲、右衛將軍殷康、驍騎將軍袁宏、散騎侍郎殷茂、中書郎車胤、左丞劉遵、吏部郎劉耽意皆同。
units.en: Xie An, Wang Shao, Zheng Xi, Yin Kang, Yuan Hong, Yin Mao, Che Yin, Liu Zun, and Liu Dan concurred.
units.literal: Vice Minister of the Masters of Writing Xie An, Central Army commander Wang Shao, Cavalier Attendant-in-ordinary Zheng Xi, General of the Right Guard Yin Kang, General of Swift Cavalry Yuan Hong, Cavalier Gentleman Yin Mao, Palace Secretariat Secretary Che Yin, Left Assistant Liu Zun, Personnel Section chief Liu Dan—all agreed.

units.zh: 康曰：「過七月而未及八月，豈可謂之逾期。
units.en: Yin Kang said, "To pass the seventh month but not yet reach the eighth: how could this be called exceeding the term?
units.literal: Yin Kang said, "To pass the seventh month but not yet reach the eighth: how could this be called exceeding the term?

units.zh: 必所不了，則當從其重者。」
units.en: If it truly cannot be settled, then one should follow the weightier option."
units.literal: If it truly cannot be settled, then one should follow the weightier option."

units.zh: 宏曰：「假值閏十二月而不取者，此則歲未終，固不可得矣。
units.en: Yuan Hong said, "If it happened to be an intercalary twelfth month and one did not take it, then the year would not yet be complete, and this certainly could not be done.
units.literal: Yuan Hong said, "If it happened to be an intercalary twelfth month and one did not take it, then the year would not yet be complete, and this certainly could not be done.

units.zh: 《漢書》以閏為後九月，明其同體也。」
units.en: The Han shu treats an intercalary month as a later ninth month, showing that it is of the same body."
units.literal: The Han shu treats an intercalary month as a later ninth month, showing that it is of the same body."

units.zh: 襲曰：「中宗、肅祖皆以閏月崩，祥除之變皆用閏之後月。
units.en: Zheng Xi said, "Zhongzong and Suzong both died in intercalary months, and in the changes of xiang sacrifice and removal, all used the month after the intercalary month.
units.literal: Zheng Xi said, "Zhongzong and Suzong both died in intercalary months, and in the changes of xiang sacrifice and removal, all used the month after the intercalary month.

units.zh: 先朝尚用閏之後月，今閏附七月，取之何疑，亦合遠日申情之言。
units.en: The former court still used the month after the intercalary month. Now the intercalary month is attached to the seventh month; what doubt is there in taking it? This also accords with the statement that a distant day extends the feeling.
units.literal: The former court still used the month after the intercalary month. Now the intercalary month is attached to the seventh month; what doubt is there in taking it? This also accords with the statement that a distant day extends the feeling.

units.zh: 又閏是後七而非八也，豈逾月之嫌乎！」
units.en: Moreover, the intercalary month is after the seventh and is not the eighth; how could there be suspicion of exceeding the month!"
units.literal: Moreover, the intercalary month is after the seventh and is not the eighth; how could there be suspicion of exceeding the month!"

units.zh: 尚書令王彪之、侍中王混、中丞譙王恬、右丞戴謐等議異，彪之曰：「吳商中才小官，非名賢碩儒、公輔重臣、為時所準則者。
units.en: Director of the Secretariat Wang Biaozhi, Palace Attendant Wang Hun, Censor-in-Chief Prince Tian of Qiao, Right Assistant Director Dai Mi, and others deliberated differently. Biaozhi said, "Wu Shang was a man of middling talent and a minor official, not a famous worthy, great classicist, high minister, or weighty servant whom the age should take as a standard.
units.literal: Director of the Secretariat Wang Biaozhi, Palace Attendant Wang Hun, Censor-in-Chief Prince Tian of Qiao, Right Assistant Director Dai Mi, and others deliberated differently. Biaozhi said, "Wu Shang was a man of middling talent and a minor official, not a famous worthy, great classicist, high minister, or weighty servant whom the age should take as a standard.

units.zh: 又取閏無證據，直攬遠日之義，越祥忌，限外取，不合卜遠之理。
units.en: Moreover, taking the intercalary month has no evidence. It merely seizes on the meaning of the distant day, passes beyond the xiang taboo, and takes something outside the limit; this does not accord with the principle of divining the distant day.
units.literal: Moreover, taking the intercalary month has no evidence. It merely seizes on the meaning of the distant day, passes beyond the xiang taboo, and takes something outside the limit; this does not accord with the principle of divining the distant day.

units.zh: 又丞相桓公嘗論云，《禮》二十五月大祥。
units.en: Furthermore, Chancellor Huan once argued that according to ritual the great xiang sacrifice is in the twenty-fifth month.
units.literal: Furthermore, Chancellor Huan once argued that according to ritual the great xiang sacrifice is in the twenty-fifth month.

units.zh: 何緣越期取閏，乃二十六月乎？」
units.en: On what basis would one pass beyond the term and take the intercalary month, making it the twenty-sixth month?"
units.literal: On what basis would one pass beyond the term and take the intercalary month, making it the twenty-sixth month?"

units.zh: 於是啟曰：「或以閏附七月，宜用閏月除者。
units.en: Thereupon they submitted, "Some consider that because the intercalary month is attached to the seventh month, the intercalary month should be used for removal.
units.literal: Thereupon they submitted, "Some consider that because the intercalary month is attached to the seventh month, the intercalary month should be used for removal.

units.zh: 或以閏名雖除七月，而實以三旬別為一月，故應以七月除者。
units.en: Others consider that although the intercalary month is named as attached to the seventh month, in reality the three ten-day periods separately make one month, and therefore the seventh month should be used for removal.
units.literal: Others consider that although the intercalary month is named as attached to the seventh month, in reality the three ten-day periods separately make one month, and therefore the seventh month should be used for removal.

units.zh: 臣等與中軍將軍沖參詳，一代大禮，宜準經典。
units.en: We your servants, together with General of the Central Army Chong, have examined the matter in detail. A great ritual of one age should take the classics as its standard.
units.literal: We your servants, together with General of the Central Army Chong, have examined the matter in detail. A great ritual of one age should take the classics as its standard.

units.zh: 三年之喪，十三月而練，二十五月而畢，《禮》之明文也。
units.en: For the three-year mourning, the lian sacrifice is in the thirteenth month, and it is completed in the twenty-fifth month; this is the clear text of the rites.
units.literal: For the three-year mourning, the lian sacrifice is in the thirteenth month, and it is completed in the twenty-fifth month; this is the clear text of the rites.

units.zh: 《陽秋》之義，閏在年內，則略而不數。
units.en: According to the meaning of the Yangqiu, when an intercalary month is inside the year, it is omitted and not counted.
units.literal: According to the meaning of the Yangqiu, when an intercalary month is inside the year, it is omitted and not counted.

units.zh: 明閏在年外，則不應取之以越期忌之重，禮制祥除必正期月故也。」
units.en: It is clear that when the intercalary month is outside the year, one should not take it and thereby exceed the weight of the term and taboo, because the ritual system for xiang sacrifice and removal must correct the numbered months."
units.literal: It is clear that when the intercalary month is outside the year, one should not take it and thereby exceed the weight of the term and taboo, because the ritual system for xiang sacrifice and removal must correct the numbered months."

units.zh: 己酉晦，帝除縞即吉。
units.en: On jiyou, month-end, the sovereign left white mourning and resumed felicity garb.
units.literal: On jiyou, the last day of the month, the emperor shed mourning white silk and returned to auspicious dress.'

units.zh: 徐廣論曰：「凡辨義詳理，無顯據明文可以折中奪易，則非疑如何。
units.en: Xu Guang's discussion said, "In general, when distinguishing meaning and detailing principle, if there is no manifest evidence or clear text by which to decide and overturn the matter, then how can it not be doubtful?
units.literal: Xu Guang's discussion said, "In general, when distinguishing meaning and detailing principle, if there is no manifest evidence or clear text by which to decide and overturn the matter, then how can it not be doubtful?

units.zh: 禮疑從重，喪易甯戚，順情通物，固有成言矣。
units.en: When ritual is doubtful, one follows the weightier option; in mourning, when changing, one prefers grief. To follow feeling and comprehend things certainly already has established sayings.
units.literal: When ritual is doubtful, one follows the weightier option; in mourning, when changing, one prefers grief. To follow feeling and comprehend things certainly already has established sayings.

units.zh: 彪之不能徵援正義，有以相屈，但以名位格人，君子虛受，心無適莫，豈其然哉！
units.en: Biaozhi could not cite and invoke correct meaning in a way that would make others yield, but only used name and rank to restrain people. The gentleman receives emptily, and in his heart has no fixed leaning; how could this be so!
units.literal: Biaozhi could not cite and invoke correct meaning in a way that would make others yield, but only used name and rank to restrain people. The gentleman receives emptily, and in his heart has no fixed leaning; how could this be so!

units.zh: 執政從而行之，其殆過矣。」
units.en: Those who held government followed and carried it out; this was probably an error."
units.literal: Those who held government followed and carried it out; this was probably an error."

units.zh: 魏武以正月崩，魏文以其年七月設妓樂百戲，是則魏不以喪廢樂也。
units.en: Cao Cao died in the first month; Cao Pi still staged troupes and acrobats that seventh month—so Wei never treated mourning as a reason to silence the bands.
units.literal: Wei Wu died in the first month; Wei Wen in that year's seventh month set singing-girls and the hundred entertainments—therefore Wei did not cancel music because of mourning.

units.zh: 武帝以來，國有大喪，輒廢樂終三年。
units.en: Under Emperor Sima Yan, every dynastic bereavement silenced the orchestras for three years.
units.literal: From Emperor Wu onward, whenever the state had great mourning, court music was suspended for the full three years.

units.zh: 惠帝太安元年，太子喪未除，及元會亦廢樂。
units.en: In Emperor Hui's Taian era, while the heir still wore mourning, the Yuan-day levee went without music.
units.literal: In the first year of Taian under Emperor Hui, the crown prince's mourning was not yet removed—yet for the New Year court assembly music was likewise suspended.

units.zh: 穆帝永和中，為中原山陵未修復，頻年元會廢樂。
units.en: Yonghe years saw the New Year court go silent while Luoyang's tombs lay in ruins.
units.literal: During Yonghe under Emperor Mu, because the imperial tombs on the Central Plain were not yet repaired, for successive years the Yuan assembly suspended music.

units.zh: 是時太后臨朝，后父褚裒薨，元會又廢樂也。
units.en: The regent's father Chu Pou died that same span, so the levee stayed mute again.
units.literal: At that time the empress dowager presided at court; the empress's father Chu Pou died—the Yuan assembly again suspended music.

units.zh: 孝武太元六年，為皇后王氏喪，亦廢樂。
units.en: In the sixth year of Taiyuan under Emperor Xiaowu, during mourning for Empress Wang, music was likewise suspended.
units.literal: In the sixth year of Taiyuan under Emperor Xiaowu, during mourning for Empress Wang, music was likewise suspended.

units.zh: 孝武崩，太傅錄尚書會稽王道子議：「山陵之後，通婚嫁不得作樂，以一期為斷。」
units.en: When Xiaowu died, Grand Tutor concurrently recording Masters of Writing the Prince of Guiji, Sima Daozi, debated: 'After the imperial tomb is closed, weddings may proceed but without music—take one full cycle as the limit.'"
units.literal: When Xiaowu died, Grand Tutor concurrently recording Masters of Writing the Prince of Guiji, Sima Daozi, debated: 'After the imperial tomb is closed, weddings may proceed but without music—take one full cycle as the limit.'"

units.zh: 漢儀，太皇太后、皇太后崩，長樂太僕、少府大長秋典喪事，三公奉制度，他皆如禮。
units.en: Han statute put the inner-palace stewards in charge of a dowager's obsequies while the Three Dukes supplied the legal template.
units.literal: Han regulations: when the grand empress dowager or empress dowager died, the Director of Changle, the Grand Coachman, the Grand Provisioner, and the Greater Chief of Staff managed funeral affairs; the Three Dukes presented the statutory scheme; everything else followed ritual.

units.zh: 魏晉亦同天子之儀，
units.en: Wei and Jin copied the same imperial funeral code.
units.literal: Wei and Jin likewise matched the Son of Heaven's observances.

units.zh: 泰始十年，武元楊皇后崩，及將遷于峻陽陵，依舊制，既葬，帝及群臣除喪即吉。
units.en: In the tenth year of Taishi, when Empress Yang was conveyed to the Junyang tomb, the standing rule had everyone shed mourning the moment the vault closed.
units.literal: In the tenth year of Taishi, [The narrative continues:] When Empress Wu-Yuan Yang died, and when she was about to be moved to the Junyang mausoleum, according to old precedent, once burial ended the emperor and all ministers removed mourning and returned to auspicious dress.

units.zh: 先是，尚書祠部奏從博士張靖議，皇太子亦從制俱釋服。
units.en: The Ministry of Rites had already accepted Zhang Jing's view, so the heir was told to strip hemp with everyone else.
units.literal: Earlier, the Ministry of Rites had memorialized following Erudite Zhang Jing's opinion—the crown prince likewise followed regulation and together removed mourning garments.

units.zh: 博士陳逵議，以為「今制所依，蓋漢帝權制，興於有事，非禮之正。
units.en: Erudite Chen Kui held that 'the regulation we follow today is the Han emperor's expedient system, born of emergency—it is not orthodox ritual.
units.literal: Erudite Chen Kui held that 'the regulation we follow today is the Han emperor's expedient system, born of emergency—it is not orthodox ritual.

units.zh: 皇太子無有國事，自宜終服。」
units.en: The crown prince has no state business of his own—naturally he ought complete the full mourning.'
units.literal: The crown prince has no state business of his own—naturally he ought complete the full mourning.'

units.zh: 有詔更詳議。
units.en: The throne ordered another round of discussion.
units.literal: There was an edict ordering further detailed debate.'"

units.zh: 尚書杜預以為：「古者天子諸侯三年之喪始同齊斬，既葬除喪服，諒闇以居，心喪終制，不與士庶同禮。
units.en: Minister Du Yu held that 'in antiquity the Son of Heaven and feudal lords began three years' mourning alike in qi- and zhan-grade hemp; once burial ended they removed mourning garments, dwelt in silent seclusion (liang'an), and finished with heart mourning—not the same ritual as gentlemen and commoners.
units.literal: Minister Du Yu held that 'in antiquity the Son of Heaven and feudal lords began three years' mourning alike in qi- and zhan-grade hemp; once burial ended they removed mourning garments, dwelt in silent seclusion (liang'an), and finished with heart mourning—not the same ritual as gentlemen and commoners.

units.zh: 漢氏承秦，率天下為天子修服三年。
units.en: Han inherited Qin and compelled all under Heaven to observe three years of mourning garments for the Son of Heaven.
units.literal: Han inherited Qin and compelled all under Heaven to observe three years of mourning garments for the Son of Heaven.

units.zh: 漢文帝見其下不可久行，而不知古制，更以意制祥禫，除喪即吉。
units.en: Han Wendi saw that his subordinates could not long sustain it, yet did not know the ancient system; further by his own intent fashioned xiang and dan rites, removed mourning, and went auspicious.
units.literal: Han Wendi saw that his subordinates could not long sustain it, yet did not know the ancient system; further by his own intent fashioned xiang and dan rites, removed mourning, and went auspicious.

units.zh: 魏氏直以訖葬為節，嗣君皆不復諒闇終制。
units.en: The Wei house simply took the completion of burial as the limit—successive lords never again practiced silent seclusion to the end of the regulation.
units.literal: The Wei house simply took the completion of burial as the limit—successive lords never again practiced silent seclusion to the end of the regulation.

units.zh: 學者非之久矣，然竟不推究經傳，考其行事，專謂王者三年之喪，當以衰麻終二十五月。
units.en: Scholars have faulted this a long time—yet in the end they did not investigate classics and commentary, examine actual practice, and solely assert that for kings three years' mourning ought mean wearing frayed hemp through twenty-five months.
units.literal: Scholars have faulted this a long time—yet in the end they did not investigate classics and commentary, examine actual practice, and solely assert that for kings three years' mourning ought mean wearing frayed hemp through twenty-five months.

units.zh: 嗣君苟若此，則天子群臣皆不得除喪。
units.en: If successor lords were like this, then the Son of Heaven and all ministers could never remove mourning.
units.literal: If successor lords were like this, then the Son of Heaven and all ministers could never remove mourning.

units.zh: 雖志在居篤，更逼而不行。
units.en: Though their intent lay in dwelling earnestly, they were pressed and unable to carry it out.
units.literal: Though their intent lay in dwelling earnestly, they were pressed and unable to carry it out.

units.zh: 至今世主皆從漢文輕典，由處制者非制也。
units.en: Down to the present generation's lords all follow Han Wendi's light canon—because those who framed the system were not establishing true system.
units.literal: Down to the present generation's lords all follow Han Wendi's light canon—because those who framed the system were not establishing true system.

units.zh: 今皇太子與尊同體，宜復古典，卒哭除衰麻，以諒闇終制。
units.en: Now the crown prince shares one body with the honored—he ought restore the ancient classic: at zuku remove frayed hemp, use silent seclusion to end the regulation.
units.literal: Now the crown prince shares one body with the honored—he ought restore the ancient classic: at zuku remove frayed hemp, use silent seclusion to end the regulation.

units.zh: 于義既不應不除，又無取于漢文，乃所以篤喪禮也。」
units.en: By right he neither ought refuse removal; nor is there reason to imitate Han Wendi—this thereby deepens the mourning ritual.'
units.literal: By right he neither ought refuse removal; nor is there reason to imitate Han Wendi—this thereby deepens the mourning ritual.'

units.zh: 於是尚書僕射盧欽、尚書魏舒問杜預證據所依。
units.en: Lu Qin and Wei Shu then pressed Du Yu for his sources.
units.literal: Thereupon Vice Ministers Lu Qin and Wei Shu asked Du Yu what evidence he relied on.'"

units.zh: 預云：「傳稱三年之喪自天子達，此謂天子絕期，唯有三年喪也。
units.en: Yu said: 'The commentary states that three years' mourning extends from the Son of Heaven downward—this means the Son of Heaven cuts off qi-grade mourning and only the three-year mourning [in heart] applies.
units.literal: Yu said: 'The commentary states that three years' mourning extends from the Son of Heaven downward—this means the Son of Heaven cuts off qi-grade mourning and only the three-year mourning [in heart] applies.

units.zh: 非謂居喪衰服三年，與士庶同也。
units.en: It does not mean dwelling in mourning garments and wearing frayed hemp for three years, the same as gentlemen and commoners.
units.literal: It does not mean dwelling in mourning garments and wearing frayed hemp for three years, the same as gentlemen and commoners.

units.zh: 故后、世子之喪，而叔向稱有三年之喪二也。
units.en: Therefore regarding the empress and crown prince's mourning, Shu Xiang spoke of there being two instances of 'three years' mourning.'
units.literal: Therefore regarding the empress and crown prince's mourning, Shu Xiang spoke of there being two instances of 'three years' mourning.'

units.zh: 周公不言高宗服喪三年，而云諒闇三年，此釋服心喪之文也。
units.en: The Duke of Zhou did not say that Gaozong wore mourning garments three years, but said he 'dwelt in silence' three years—this is text explaining removing garments and observing heart mourning.
units.literal: The Duke of Zhou did not say that Gaozong wore mourning garments three years, but said he 'dwelt in silence' three years—this is text explaining removing garments and observing heart mourning.

units.zh: 叔向不譏景王除喪，而譏其燕樂已早，明既葬應除，而違諒闇之節也。
units.en: Shu Xiang did not reproach King Jing for removing mourning, but reproached his banquet music as too early—clarifying that once burial one ought remove mourning, yet he violated the moderation of silent seclusion.
units.literal: Shu Xiang did not reproach King Jing for removing mourning, but reproached his banquet music as too early—clarifying that once burial one ought remove mourning, yet he violated the moderation of silent seclusion.

units.zh: 《春秋》，晉侯享諸侯，子產相鄭伯，時簡公未葬，請免喪以聽命，君子謂之得禮。
units.en: In the Spring and Autumn, the Marquis of Jin feasted the feudal lords; Zichan assisted the Earl of Zheng—at the time Duke Jian was not yet buried—he requested to set aside mourning to hear commands—the gentlemen called this obtaining ritual.
units.literal: In the Spring and Autumn, the Marquis of Jin feasted the feudal lords; Zichan assisted the Earl of Zheng—at the time Duke Jian was not yet buried—he requested to set aside mourning to hear commands—the gentlemen called this obtaining ritual.

units.zh: 宰咺來歸惠公仲子之賵，傳曰『弔生不及哀』。
units.en: Steward Xuan came to present condolence gifts for Duke Hui and Zhongzi; the commentary states 'condoling the living does not catch up with mourning.'
units.literal: Steward Xuan came to present condolence gifts for Dukes Hui and Zhongzi; the commentary states 'condoling the living does not catch up with mourning.'

units.zh: 此皆既葬除服諒闇之證，先儒舊說，往往亦見，學者來之思耳。
units.en: These all are proofs of removing garments after burial and of silent seclusion—former Confucians' old explanations often appear as well—scholars simply have not pondered them.
units.literal: These all are proofs of removing garments after burial and of silent seclusion—former Confucians' old explanations often appear as well—scholars simply have not pondered them.

units.zh: 《喪服》，諸侯為天子亦斬衰，豈可謂終服三年邪！
units.en: In Mourning Garments, feudal lords for the Son of Heaven likewise wear zhan-cui—how can one say they complete hemp garments for three years!
units.literal: In Mourning Garments, feudal lords for the Son of Heaven likewise wear zhan-cui—how can one say they complete hemp garments for three years!

units.zh: 上考七代，未知王者君臣上下衰麻三年者誰；
units.en: Looking up through seven generations, I do not know which king's lord and minister, high and low, wore frayed hemp for three years;
units.literal: Looking up through seven generations, I do not know which king's lord and minister, high and low, wore frayed hemp for three years;

units.zh: 下推將來，恐百世之主其理一也。
units.en: projecting down to the future, I fear that for a hundred generations' lords the principle will be one.
units.literal: projecting down to the future, I fear that for a hundred generations' lords the principle will be one.

units.zh: 非必不能，乃事勢不得，故知聖人不虛設不行之制。
units.en: It is not that they could not—it is that the momentum of affairs did not allow it—therefore know that sages do not vainly establish systems that cannot be practiced.
units.literal: It is not that they could not—it is that the momentum of affairs did not allow it—therefore know that sages do not vainly establish systems that cannot be practiced.

units.zh: 仲尼曰『禮所損益雖百世可知』，此之謂也。」
units.en: Zhongni said 'ritual's diminishing and increasing, though a hundred generations, can be known'—this is what is meant.'
units.literal: Zhongni said 'ritual's diminishing and increasing, though a hundred generations, can be known'—this is what is meant.'

units.zh: 於是飲、舒從之，遂命預造議，奏曰：侍中尚書令司空魯公臣賈充、侍中尚書僕射奉車都尉大梁侯臣盧欽、尚書新遝伯臣山濤、尚書奉車都尉平春侯臣胡威、尚書劇陽子臣魏舒、尚書堂陽子臣石鑒、尚書豐樂亭侯臣杜預稽首言：禮官參議博士張靖等議，以為「孝文權制三十六日之服，以日易月，道有汙隆，禮不得全，皇太子亦宜割情除服」。
units.en: Thereupon Lu Qin and Wei Shu followed this, and so ordered Du Yu to compose an opinion. He memorialized, saying: Your servants Jia Chong, Palace Attendant, Director of the Secretariat, Minister of Works, and Duke of Lu; Lu Qin, Palace Attendant, Vice Director of the Secretariat, Imperial Carriage Commandant, and Marquis of Daliang; Shan Tao, Minister and Earl of Xinta; Hu Wei, Minister, Imperial Carriage Commandant, and Marquis of Pingchun; Wei Shu, Minister and Baron of Juyang; Shi Jian, Minister and Baron of Tangyang; and Du Yu, Minister and Marquis of Fengle Precinct, bow their heads and say: Zhang Jing and others, deliberating officials and erudites among the ritual officers, argue, 'Emperor Xiaowen made an expedient rule of thirty-six days of mourning, exchanging days for months. The Way has rises and declines, and ritual cannot be kept complete; the crown prince should also cut off his feeling and remove mourning dress.'
units.literal: Thereupon Lu Qin and Wei Shu followed this, and so ordered Du Yu to compose an opinion. He memorialized, saying: Your servants Jia Chong, Palace Attendant, Director of the Secretariat, Minister of Works, and Duke of Lu; Lu Qin, Palace Attendant, Vice Director of the Secretariat, Imperial Carriage Commandant, and Marquis of Daliang; Shan Tao, Minister of Xinta; Hu Wei, Minister, Imperial Carriage Commandant, and Marquis of Pingchun; Wei Shu, Minister and Baron of Juyang; Shi Jian, Minister and Baron of Tangyang; and Du Yu, Minister and Marquis of Fengle Precinct, bow their heads and say: Zhang Jing and others, deliberating officials and erudites among the ritual officers, argue, 'Emperor Xiaowen made an expedient rule of thirty-six days of mourning, exchanging days for months. The Way has rises and declines, and ritual cannot be kept complete; the crown prince should also cut off his feeling and remove mourning dress.'

units.zh: 博士陳逵等議，以為「三年之喪，人子所以自盡，故聖人制禮，自上達下。是以今制，將吏諸遭父母喪，皆假寧二十五月。敦崇孝道，所以風化天下。皇太子至孝著於內，而衰服除於外，非禮所謂稱情者也。宜其不除。」臣欽、臣舒、臣預謹案靖、逵等議，各見所學之一端，未曉帝者居喪古今之通禮也。
units.en: Erudite Chen Kui and others argue, "The three-year mourning is how a son exhausts himself; therefore the sages established ritual, reaching from above down below. For this reason, under the present system, whenever generals and officials suffer mourning for parents, all are granted leave for twenty-five months. Honoring and elevating filial piety is how one transforms all under Heaven. The crown prince's utmost filial piety is manifest within, yet mourning dress would be removed without; this is not what ritual calls matching the feeling. It is fitting that he not remove it." Your servants Qin, Shu, and Yu respectfully examine the arguments of Jing, Kui, and the others: each sees one end of what he has studied, but they have not understood the common ritual, ancient and modern, for an emperor in mourning.
units.literal: Erudite Chen Kui and others argue, "The three-year mourning is how a son exhausts himself; therefore the sages established ritual, reaching from above down below. For this reason, under the present system, whenever generals and officials suffer mourning for parents, all are granted leave for twenty-five months. Honoring and elevating filial piety is how one transforms all under Heaven. The crown prince's utmost filial piety is manifest within, yet mourning dress would be removed without; this is not what ritual calls matching the feeling. It is fitting that he not remove it." Your servants Qin, Shu, and Yu respectfully examine the arguments of Jing, Kui, and the others: each sees one end of what he has studied, but they have not understood the common ritual, ancient and modern, for an emperor in mourning.

units.zh: 自上及下，尊卑貴賤，物有其宜。
units.en: From above down below, for honored and humble, noble and base, each thing has what is fitting to it.
units.literal: From above down below, for honored and humble, noble and base, each thing has what is fitting to it.

units.zh: 故禮有以多為貴者，有以少為貴者，有以高為貴者，有以下為貴者，唯其稱也。
units.en: Thus in ritual there are cases in which much is valued, cases in which little is valued, cases in which height is valued, and cases in which lowness is valued: it depends only on what is proportionate.
units.literal: Thus in ritual there are cases in which much is valued, cases in which little is valued, cases in which height is valued, and cases in which lowness is valued: it depends only on what is proportionate.

units.zh: 不然，則本末不經，行之不遠。
units.en: If it is not so, then root and branch do not follow the constant, and the practice cannot go far.
units.literal: If it is not so, then root and branch do not follow the constant, and the practice cannot go far.

units.zh: 天子之與群臣，雖哀樂之情若一，而所居之宜實異，故禮不得同。
units.en: The Son of Heaven and the assembled ministers may be alike in the feelings of grief and joy, but what is fitting to their positions is truly different; therefore their rituals cannot be the same.
units.literal: The Son of Heaven and the assembled ministers may be alike in the feelings of grief and joy, but what is fitting to their positions is truly different; therefore their rituals cannot be the same.

units.zh: 《易》曰「上古之世喪期無數」，《虞書》稱「三載四海遏密八音」，其後無文。
units.en: The Yi says, "In the world of high antiquity, mourning terms had no fixed number"; the Yu shu says, "For three years, within the four seas, the eight sounds were stopped and silenced." After this, there is no text.
units.literal: The Yi says, "In the world of high antiquity, mourning terms had no fixed number"; the Yu shu says, "For three years, within the four seas, the eight sounds were stopped and silenced." After this, there is no text.

units.zh: 至周公旦，乃稱「殷之高宗諒闇三年不言」。
units.en: When it reaches the Duke of Zhou, Dan, then it says, "Gaozong of Yin was in liang'an and did not speak for three years."
units.literal: When it reaches the Duke of Zhou, Dan, then it says, "Gaozong of Yin was in liang'an and did not speak for three years."

units.zh: 其傳曰「諒，信也；闇，默也」。
units.en: Its commentary says, "Liang means trust; an means silence."
units.literal: Its commentary says, "Liang means trust; an means silence."

units.zh: 下逮五百餘歲，而子張疑之，以問仲尼。
units.en: Down more than five hundred years later, Zizhang doubted this and asked Zhongni about it.
units.literal: Down more than five hundred years later, Zizhang doubted this and asked Zhongni about it.

units.zh: 仲尼答云：「何必高宗，古之人皆然，君薨，百官總己以聽於塚宰三年。」周景王有后、世子之喪，既葬除喪而樂。
units.en: Zhongni answered, "Why only Gaozong? People of antiquity were all so. When the ruler died, the hundred officials gathered themselves and listened to the chief minister for three years." King Jing of Zhou had mourning for his queen and heir; after burial he removed mourning and had music.
units.literal: Zhongni answered, "Why only Gaozong? People of antiquity were all so. When the ruler died, the hundred officials gathered themselves and listened to the chief minister for three years." King Jing of Zhou had mourning for his queen and heir; after burial he removed mourning and had music.

units.zh: 晉叔向譏之曰：「三年之喪，雖貴遂服，禮也。王雖弗遂，宴樂已早，亦非禮也。」此皆天子喪事見於古文者也。
units.en: Shuxiang of Jin criticized him, saying, "For the three-year mourning, even the noble carry the dress through; this is ritual. Although the king did not carry it through, feasting and music were too early, and this too was not ritual." These are all mourning affairs of Sons of Heaven seen in ancient texts.
units.literal: Shuxiang of Jin criticized him, saying, "For the three-year mourning, even the noble carry the dress through; this is ritual. Although the king did not carry it through, feasting and music were too early, and this too was not ritual." These are all mourning affairs of Sons of Heaven seen in ancient texts.

units.zh: 稱高宗不云服喪三年，而云諒闇三年，此釋服心喪之文也。
units.en: In speaking of Gaozong, the text does not say he wore mourning for three years, but says he was in liang'an for three years; this is a text explaining removal of dress and mourning in the heart.
units.literal: In speaking of Gaozong, the text does not say he wore mourning for three years, but says he was in liang'an for three years; this is a text explaining removal of dress and mourning in the heart.

units.zh: 譏景王不譏其除喪，而譏其宴樂已早，明既葬應除，而違諒闇之節也。
units.en: In criticizing King Jing, it does not criticize his removal of mourning, but criticizes the fact that feasting and music were too early. This shows that after burial one should remove mourning, but that he violated the restraint of liang'an.
units.literal: In criticizing King Jing, it does not criticize his removal of mourning, but criticizes the fact that feasting and music were too early. This shows that after burial one should remove mourning, but that he violated the restraint of liang'an.

units.zh: 堯崩，舜諒闇三年，故稱遏密八音。
units.en: When Yao died, Shun was in liang'an for three years, and therefore it speaks of stopping and silencing the eight sounds.
units.literal: When Yao died, Shun was in liang'an for three years, and therefore it speaks of stopping and silencing the eight sounds.

units.zh: 由此言之，天子居喪，齊斬之制，菲杖絰帶，當遂其服。
units.en: Speaking from this, when the Son of Heaven is in mourning, in the systems of unhemmed and hemmed sackcloth, with coarse staff, headband, and girdle, he should carry through the wearing of the dress.
units.literal: Speaking from this, when the Son of Heaven is in mourning, in the systems of unhemmed and hemmed sackcloth, with coarse staff, headband, and girdle, he should carry through the wearing of the dress.

units.zh: 既葬而除，諒闇以終之，三年無改父之道，故百官總已聽於塚宰。
units.en: After burial, however, he removes it and completes the matter through liang'an. For three years he does not change his father's Way, and therefore the hundred officials gather themselves and listen to the chief minister.
units.literal: After burial, however, he removes it and completes the matter through liang'an. For three years he does not change his father's Way, and therefore the hundred officials gather themselves and listen to the chief minister.

units.zh: 喪服已除，故稱不言之美，明不復寢苫枕塊，以荒大政也。
units.en: Because the mourning dress has already been removed, the beauty of not speaking is praised; this shows that he no longer sleeps on straw and pillows his head on a clod, thereby neglecting great government.
units.literal: Because the mourning dress has already been removed, the beauty of not speaking is praised; this shows that he no longer sleeps on straw and pillows his head on a clod, thereby neglecting great government.

units.zh: 《禮記》：「三年之喪，自天子達。」又云：「父母之喪，無貴賤一也。」又云：「端衰喪車皆無等。」此通謂天子居喪，衣服之節同於凡人，心喪之禮終於三年，亦無服喪三年之文。
units.en: The Liji says, "The three-year mourning extends from the Son of Heaven downward." It also says, "For mourning for father and mother, noble and base are the same." It also says, "Plain mourning garments and mourning carriages all have no grades." This broadly means that when the Son of Heaven is in mourning, the regulations for clothing are the same as for ordinary people and the ritual of mourning in the heart ends after three years; there is still no text saying that he wears mourning for three years.
units.literal: The Liji says, "The three-year mourning extends from the Son of Heaven downward." It also says, "For mourning for father and mother, noble and base are the same." It also says, "Plain mourning garments and mourning carriages all have no grades." This broadly means that when the Son of Heaven is in mourning, the regulations for clothing are the same as for ordinary people and the ritual of mourning in the heart ends after three years; there is still no text saying that he wears mourning for three years.

units.zh: 然繼體之君，猶多荒寧。
units.en: Yet rulers who inherited the body of the state still often fell into neglect and repose.
units.literal: Yet rulers who inherited the body of the state still often fell into neglect and repose.

units.zh: 自從廢諒闇之制，至令高宗擅名於往代，子張致疑於當時，此乃賢聖所以為譏，非譏天子不以服終喪也。
units.en: From the abandonment of the liang'an system onward, it came to make Gaozong alone famous in past generations and caused Zizhang to raise doubts in his own time. This is what worthies and sages criticized; they were not criticizing Sons of Heaven for not completing mourning by wearing the dress.
units.literal: From the abandonment of the liang'an system onward, it came to make Gaozong alone famous in past generations and caused Zizhang to raise doubts in his own time. This is what worthies and sages criticized; they were not criticizing Sons of Heaven for not completing mourning by wearing the dress.

units.zh: 秦燔書籍，率意而行，亢上抑下。
units.en: Qin burned the books, acted according to its own wishes, exalted those above, and pressed down those below.
units.literal: Qin burned the books, acted according to its own wishes, exalted those above, and pressed down those below.

units.zh: 漢祖草創，因而不革。
units.en: The Han ancestor created the dynasty in rough beginnings and accordingly did not reform it.
units.literal: The Han ancestor created the dynasty in rough beginnings and accordingly did not reform it.

units.zh: 乃至率天下皆終重服，旦夕哀臨，經罹寒暑，禁塞嫁娶飲酒食肉，制不稱情。
units.en: It even led all under Heaven to complete heavy mourning dress, attend in grief morning and evening, pass through heat and cold, and be barred from marriages, drinking wine, and eating meat; the system did not match feeling.
units.literal: It even led all under Heaven to complete heavy mourning dress, attend in grief morning and evening, pass through heat and cold, and be barred from marriages, drinking wine, and eating meat; the system did not match feeling.

units.zh: 是以孝文遺詔，斂畢便葬，葬畢制紅禫之除。
units.en: For this reason, Emperor Xiaowen's final edict ordered that once encoffining was complete burial should proceed, and once burial was complete the removal after red-tassel sacrifice was to be fixed.
units.literal: For this reason, Emperor Xiaowen's final edict ordered that once encoffining was complete burial should proceed, and once burial was complete the removal after red-tassel sacrifice was to be fixed.

units.zh: 雖不合高宗諒闇之義，近於古典，故傳之後嗣。
units.en: Although this did not accord with the meaning of Gaozong's liang'an, it was close to the ancient models, and therefore it was transmitted to later heirs.
units.literal: Although this did not accord with the meaning of Gaozong's liang'an, it was close to the ancient models, and therefore it was transmitted to later heirs.

units.zh: 于時預修陵廟，故斂葬得在浹辰之內，因以定制。
units.en: At that time the tomb and temple had been prepared in advance, so encoffining and burial could be completed within twelve days, and on that basis a fixed system was established.
units.literal: At that time the tomb and temple had been prepared in advance, so encoffining and burial could be completed within twelve days, and on that basis a fixed system was established.

units.zh: 近至明帝，存無陵寢，五旬乃葬，安在三十六日。
units.en: Recently, down to Emperor Ming, while he was alive there was no tomb chamber, and only after fifty days was he buried. How could it have been in thirty-six days?
units.literal: Recently, down to Emperor Ming, while he was alive there was no tomb chamber, and only after fifty days was he buried. How could it have been in thirty-six days?

units.zh: 此當時經學疏略，不師前聖之病也。
units.en: This was the fault of the classical learning of that time being careless and abbreviated, and not taking the former sages as teachers.
units.literal: This was the fault of the classical learning of that time being careless and abbreviated, and not taking the former sages as teachers.

units.zh: 魏氏革命，以既葬為節，合於古典，然不垂心諒闇，同譏前代。
units.en: When the Wei house changed the mandate, it took the time after burial as the limit, which accorded with the ancient models; yet it did not set its heart on liang'an, and so shares the criticism of earlier ages.
units.literal: When the Wei house changed the mandate, it took the time after burial as the limit, which accorded with the ancient models; yet it did not set its heart on liang'an, and so shares the criticism of earlier ages.

units.zh: 自泰始開元，陛下追尊諒闇之禮，慎終居篤，允臻古制，超絕于殷宗，天下歌德，誠非靖等所能原本也。
units.en: Since the opening of the Taishi era, Your Majesty has pursued and honored the ritual of liang'an, been careful at the end and dwelt in deep sincerity, truly reaching the ancient system and surpassing the Yin ancestor. All under Heaven sings of your virtue; this is truly not something Jing and the others can trace to its root.
units.literal: Since the opening of the Taishi era, Your Majesty has pursued and honored the ritual of liang'an, been careful at the end and dwelt in deep sincerity, truly reaching the ancient system and surpassing the Yin ancestor. All under Heaven sings of your virtue; this is truly not something Jing and the others can trace to its root.

units.zh: 天子諸侯之禮，當以具矣。
units.en: The rituals of the Son of Heaven and the feudal lords should thereby be complete.
units.literal: The rituals of the Son of Heaven and the feudal lords should thereby be complete.

units.zh: 諸侯惡其害己而削其籍，今其存者唯《士喪》一篇，戴聖之記雜錯其間，亦難以取正。
units.en: The feudal lords disliked what harmed themselves and cut it from their records; what now survives is only the one chapter "Mourning of an Officer," and Dai Sheng's records are mixed and confused within it, so they are also difficult to take as correct.
units.literal: The feudal lords disliked what harmed themselves and cut it from their records; what now survives is only the one chapter "Mourning of an Officer," and Dai Sheng's records are mixed and confused within it, so they are also difficult to take as correct.

units.zh: 天子之位至尊，萬機之政至大，群臣之眾至廣，不同之於凡人。
units.en: The position of the Son of Heaven is most honored, the government of the myriad mechanisms is most great, and the mass of assembled ministers is most broad; he is not the same as an ordinary person.
units.literal: The position of the Son of Heaven is most honored, the government of the myriad mechanisms is most great, and the mass of assembled ministers is most broad; he is not the same as an ordinary person.

units.zh: 故大行既葬，祔祭於廟，則因疏而除之。
units.en: Therefore, once the deceased emperor has been buried and the attached sacrifice made in the temple, he removes mourning in accordance with the loosening of kinship.
units.literal: Therefore, once the deceased emperor has been buried and the attached sacrifice made in the temple, he removes mourning in accordance with the loosening of kinship.

units.zh: 己不除則群臣莫敢除，故屈己以除之。
units.en: If he himself does not remove it, the assembled ministers do not dare remove it; therefore he bends himself and removes it.
units.literal: If he himself does not remove it, the assembled ministers do not dare remove it; therefore he bends himself and removes it.

units.zh: 而諒闇以終制，天下之人皆曰我王之仁也。
units.en: Yet he completes the system through liang'an, and all the people under Heaven say, "This is our king's humanity."
units.literal: Yet he completes the system through liang'an, and all the people under Heaven say, "This is our king's humanity."

units.zh: 屈己以從宜，皆曰我王之孝也。
units.en: He bends himself in order to follow what is fitting, and they all say, "This is our king's filial piety."
units.literal: He bends himself in order to follow what is fitting, and they all say, "This is our king's filial piety."

units.zh: 既除而心喪，我王猶若此之篤也。
units.en: After removing mourning, he still mourns in the heart, and they say, "Our king is still this sincere."
units.literal: After removing mourning, he still mourns in the heart, and they say, "Our king is still this sincere."

units.zh: 凡等臣子，亦焉得不自勉以崇禮。
units.en: For all ranks of ministers and sons, how could they not encourage themselves to honor ritual?
units.literal: For all ranks of ministers and sons, how could they not encourage themselves to honor ritual?

units.zh: 此乃聖制移風易俗之本，高宗所以致雍熙，豈惟衰裳而已哉！
units.en: This is the root by which the sage system changes customs and transforms habits, and the means by which Gaozong brought harmony and brightness. How could it be only mourning skirts!
units.literal: This is the root by which the sage system changes customs and transforms habits, and the means by which Gaozong brought harmony and brightness. How could it be only mourning skirts!

units.zh: 若如難者，更以權制自居，疑于屈伸厭降，欲以職事為斷，則父在為母期，父卒三年，此以至親屈於至尊之義也。
units.en: If, as the objectors say, one instead takes one's stand on an expedient rule, doubts the bending or extending and the lowering by suppression, and wants to make official duties the deciding line, then when the father is alive one mourns the mother for a year, and when the father has died one mourns for three years: this is the meaning of the closest kinship bending before the highest honor.
units.literal: If, as the objectors say, one instead takes one's stand on an expedient rule, doubts the bending or extending and the lowering by suppression, and wants to make official duties the deciding line, then when the father is alive one mourns the mother for a year, and when the father has died one mourns for three years: this is the meaning of the closest kinship bending before the highest honor.

units.zh: 出母之喪，以至親為屬，而長子不得有制，體尊之義，升降皆從，不敢獨也。
units.en: In mourning for a divorced mother, the closest kinship provides the relation, yet the eldest son cannot have a separate system. In the meaning that the body is honored, rising and lowering all follow from it, and one does not dare act alone.
units.literal: In mourning for a divorced mother, the closest kinship provides the relation, yet the eldest son cannot have a separate system. In the meaning that the body is honored, rising and lowering all follow from it, and one does not dare act alone.

units.zh: 《禮》：諸子之職，掌國子之倅。
units.en: The Li says: the office of the several sons is to oversee the deputies among the sons of the state.
units.literal: The Li says: the office of the several sons is to oversee the deputies among the sons of the state.

units.zh: 國有事則帥國子而致之太子，唯所用之。
units.en: When the state has affairs, they lead the sons of the state and deliver them to the crown prince, to be used as he sees fit.
units.literal: When the state has affairs, they lead the sons of the state and deliver them to the crown prince, to be used as he sees fit.

units.zh: 《傳》曰，「君行則守，有守則從，從曰撫軍，守曰監國」，不無事矣。
