units.en: The Commentary says, "When the ruler travels, there is one who guards; when there is one who guards, there is one who follows. Following is called guarding the army; guarding is called supervising the state." He is not without duties.
units.literal: The Commentary says, "When the ruler travels, there is one who guards; when there is one who guards, there is one who follows. Following is called guarding the army; guarding is called supervising the state." He is not without duties.

units.zh: 《喪服》母為長子，妻為夫，妾為主，皆三年。
units.en: The Mourning Garments says that a mother for her eldest son, a wife for her husband, and a concubine for her master all mourn for three years.
units.literal: The Mourning Garments says that a mother for her eldest son, a wife for her husband, and a concubine for her master all mourn for three years.

units.zh: 內宮之主，可謂無事、揆度漢制，孝文之喪，紅禫既畢，孝景即吉於未央，薄后、竇后必不得齊斬于別宮，此可知也。
units.en: Can it be said that the mistress of the inner palace has no duties? Measuring the Han system, at Emperor Xiaowen's mourning, once the red-tassel sacrifice was complete, Emperor Xiaojing immediately wore auspicious dress at Weiyang; Empress Bo and Empress Dou certainly could not have worn hemmed or unhemmed sackcloth in a separate palace. This can be known.
units.literal: Can it be said that the mistress of the inner palace has no duties? Measuring the Han system, at Emperor Xiaowen's mourning, once the red-tassel sacrifice was complete, Emperor Xiaojing immediately wore auspicious dress at Weiyang; Empress Bo and Empress Dou certainly could not have worn hemmed or unhemmed sackcloth in a separate palace. This can be known.

units.zh: 況皇太子配貳至尊，與國為體，固宜遠遵古禮，近同時制，屈除以寬諸下，協一代之成典。
units.en: How much more should the crown prince, who is paired as deputy to the Most Honored and forms one body with the state, surely follow ancient ritual from afar and match the system of the time nearby, bending to remove mourning in order to ease all below, and accord with the completed statute of one age.
units.literal: How much more should the crown prince, who is paired as deputy to the Most Honored and forms one body with the state, surely follow ancient ritual from afar and match the system of the time nearby, bending to remove mourning in order to ease all below, and accord with the completed statute of one age.

units.zh: 君子之于禮，有直而行，曲而殺；有經而等，有順而去之，存諸內而已。
units.en: For the gentleman in ritual, there are cases in which one proceeds straight and cases in which one reduces by bending; there are cases in which one grades by the constant and cases in which one follows circumstances and sets it aside. It is only preserved within.
units.literal: For the gentleman in ritual, there are cases in which one proceeds straight and cases in which one reduces by bending; there are cases in which one grades by the constant and cases in which one follows circumstances and sets it aside. It is only preserved within.

units.zh: 禮云非玉帛之謂，喪云唯衰麻之謂乎？
units.en: When ritual says it is not a matter of jade and silk, could mourning say it is only a matter of sackcloth and hemp?
units.literal: When ritual says it is not a matter of jade and silk, could mourning say it is only a matter of sackcloth and hemp?

units.zh: 此既臣等所謂經制大義，且即實近言，亦有不安。
units.en: This is already what we your servants call the great meaning of the classical system; moreover, speaking from the actual and immediate situation, there is also something uneasy.
units.literal: This is already what we your servants call the great meaning of the classical system; moreover, speaking from the actual and immediate situation, there is also something uneasy.

units.zh: 今皇太子至孝蒸蒸，發于自然，號咷之慕，匍匐殯宮，大行既奠，往而不反，必想像平故，彳旁徨寢殿。
units.en: Now the crown prince's utmost filial piety rises abundantly and issues from nature. In wailing longing, he crawls in the mortuary palace; after the deceased emperor has been placed, he will go and not return, surely imagining the ordinary past and wandering about the sleeping hall.
units.literal: Now the crown prince's utmost filial piety rises abundantly and issues from nature. In wailing longing, he crawls in the mortuary palace; after the deceased emperor has been placed, he will go and not return, surely imagining the ordinary past and wandering about the sleeping hall.

units.zh: 若不變從諒闇，則東宮臣僕，義不釋服。
units.en: If he does not change and follow liang'an, then the ministers and servants of the Eastern Palace, by duty, will not remove mourning dress.
units.literal: If he does not change and follow liang'an, then the ministers and servants of the Eastern Palace, by duty, will not remove mourning dress.

units.zh: 此為永福官屬，當獨衰麻從事，出入殿省，亦難以繼。
units.en: This would mean that the officials attached to Yongfu alone would have to conduct affairs in sackcloth and hemp, and entering and leaving the palace and departments would also be difficult to continue.
units.literal: This would mean that the officials attached to Yongfu alone would have to conduct affairs in sackcloth and hemp, and entering and leaving the palace and departments would also be difficult to continue.

units.zh: 今將吏雖蒙同二十五月之甯，至於大臣，亦奪其制。
units.en: Now although generals and officials receive the same twenty-five months of leave, when it comes to great ministers, even they are deprived of that system.
units.literal: Now although generals and officials receive the same twenty-five months of leave, when it comes to great ministers, even they are deprived of that system.

units.zh: 昔翟方進自以身為漢相，居喪三十六日，不敢逾國典，而況于皇太子？
units.en: In the past, Zhai Fangjin, because he himself was Han chancellor, remained in mourning thirty-six days and did not dare exceed the state statute. How much more for the crown prince?
units.literal: In the past, Zhai Fangjin, because he himself was Han chancellor, remained in mourning thirty-six days and did not dare exceed the state statute. How much more for the crown prince?

units.zh: 臣等以為皇太子宜如前奏，除服諒闇終制。
units.en: We your servants consider that the crown prince should follow the earlier memorial, remove mourning dress, and complete the system in liang'an.
units.literal: We your servants consider that the crown prince should follow the earlier memorial, remove mourning dress, and complete the system in liang'an.

units.zh: 於是太子遂以厭降之議，從國制除衰麻，諒闇終制。
units.en: On that basis the heir shed hemp under the expedient code and finished mourning in seclusion.
units.literal: Thereupon the crown prince, by the debate on suppressive lowering, followed state regulation removing frayed hemp and used silent seclusion to end the mourning regulation.

units.zh: 于時外內卒聞預異議，多怪之。
units.en: Court and camp alike thought Du Yu's view bizarre.
units.literal: At that time, inside and outside the court, upon hearing Yu's different opinion, most thought it strange.

units.zh: 或者乃謂其違禮以合時。
units.en: Some accused him of bending the canon to please fashion.
units.literal: Some even said he violated ritual to suit the times.

units.zh: 時預亦不自解說，退使博士段暢博采典籍，為之證據，令大義著明，足以垂示將來。
units.en: Du Yu said little himself but told Duan Chang to mine the classics for proofs that would settle the debate for later ages.
units.literal: At the time Yu also did not explain himself; he retired and ordered Erudite Duan Chang broadly to gather classics and canons as evidence for him, so that the great meaning would shine clearly and suffice to instruct posterity.

units.zh: 暢承預旨，遂撰集書傳舊文，條諸實事成言，以為定證，以弘指趣。
units.en: Duan Chang collated precedents and tagged each with a gloss to anchor Du Yu's thesis.
units.literal: Chang received Yu's intent, then compiled transmitted old texts, itemizing verified events into sayings, as fixed proofs, to broaden the purport.

units.zh: 其傳記有與今議同者，亦具列之，博舉二隅，明其會歸，以證斯事。
units.en: He cited parallels that matched the new rule and mapped how they converged on one conclusion.
units.literal: Wherever records agreed with today's debate, he likewise listed them in full—broadly raising two angles, clarifying their convergence, to prove this affair.

units.zh: 文多不載。
units.en: The compilation ran long and is omitted here.
units.literal: The text is extensive and is not recorded here.

units.zh: 武帝楊悼皇后既母養懷帝，后遇難時，懷帝尚幼，及即位，中詔述后恩愛。
units.en: Empress Yang had raised the future Emperor Huai; when she was killed he was still a child, and on enthronement he issued a palace rescript praising her care.
units.literal: Empress Yang Dao of Emperor Wu had already mother-nurtured Emperor Huai; when she later met violent death, Emperor Huai was still young; when he ascended, an inner edict recounted the empress's kindness and love.

units.zh: 及后祖載，群官議帝應為追制服，或以庶母慈己，依禮制小功五月，或以謂慈母服如母服齊衰者，眾議不同。
units.en: At her cortège the ministries split: some wanted retroactive weeds, some cited a nurturing concubine's xiao gong, some equated her to a legal mother in qi-cui.
units.literal: When later her funeral train departed, the many offices debated whether the emperor ought wear retroactive mourning—or some said because a concubine-mother had loved him, by ritual he should wear xiao gong five months—or some said foster-mother mourning like a mother's qi-cui—the many opinions differed.

units.zh: 閭丘沖議云：「楊后母養聖上，蓋以曲情。
units.en: Luqiu Chong debated: 'Empress Yang mother-nurtured the sage ascendant—generally out of special affection.
units.literal: Luqiu Chong debated: 'Empress Yang mother-nurtured the sage ascendant—generally out of special affection.

units.zh: 今以恩禮追崇，不配世祖廟。
units.en: Now by kindness and ritual we posthumously honor her—not pairing her in Emperor Shizu's temple.
units.literal: Now by kindness and ritual we posthumously honor her—not pairing her in Emperor Shizu's temple.

units.zh: 王者無慈養之服，謂宜祖載之日，可三朝素服發哀而已。」
units.en: For kings there is no garment for 'foster nurturing'; I say on the day of the funeral train, three court sessions in plain dress to raise mourning is enough.'
units.literal: For kings there is no garment for 'foster nurturing'; I say on the day of the funeral train, three court sessions in plain dress to raise mourning is enough.'

units.zh: 於是從之。
units.en: The throne accepted his view.
units.literal: Thereupon [the court] followed this.'"

units.zh: 康帝建元元年正月晦，成恭杜皇后周忌，有司奏，至尊期年應改服。
units.en: On the last day of the first month in the first year of Jianyuan under Emperor Kang, the full-year anniversary of Empress Chenggong Du arrived, and the responsible offices memorialized that after the full year the sovereign should change garments.
units.literal: On the last day of the first month in the first year of Jianyuan under Emperor Kang, the full-year anniversary of Empress Chenggong Du arrived, and the responsible offices memorialized that after the full year the sovereign should change garments.

units.zh: 詔曰：「君親，名教之重也，權制出於近代耳。」
units.en: The edict said: 'Lord and parent are what name-teaching esteems most heavily—expedient regulation arose only in recent generations.'
units.literal: The edict said: 'Lord and parent are what name-teaching esteems most heavily—expedient regulation arose only in recent generations.'

units.zh: 於是素服如舊，固非漢魏之典也，
units.en: He kept plain dress anyway—far from Han or Wei orthodoxy.
units.literal: Thereupon plain dress as before—indeed this is not Han-Wei canonical precedent.'"

units.zh: 興寧元年，哀帝章皇太妃薨，帝欲服重。
units.en: In the first year of Xingning, Emperor Ai's Grand Consort Zhang died, and he wanted the heaviest weeds.
units.literal: In the first year of Xingning, [The narrative continues:] The Honored Consort Zhang of Emperor Ai died; the emperor wished to wear heavy mourning.

units.zh: 江虨啟：「先王制禮，應在緦服。」
units.en: Jiang Pin presented: 'The former kings' ritual system—ought to be si-grade hemp.'
units.literal: Jiang Pin presented: 'The former kings' ritual system—ought to be si-grade hemp.'

units.zh: 詔欲降期，虨又啟：「厭屈私情，所以上嚴祖考。」
units.en: The edict wished to lower to qi [one full year]; Pin again presented: 'Suppressing and bending private feeling is thereby to give utmost respect to remote ancestors.'
units.literal: The edict wished to lower to qi [one full year]; Pin again presented: 'Suppressing and bending private feeling is thereby to give utmost respect to remote ancestors.'

units.zh: 於是制緦麻三月。
units.en: The court settled on three months of si hemp.
units.literal: Thereupon the system fixed si hemp for three months.'"

units.zh: 孝武甯康中，崇德太后褚氏崩。
units.en: During Ningkang, Empress Dowager Chongde of the Chu clan died.
units.literal: In Emperor Xiaowu's Ningkang era, Empress Dowager Chongde née Chu died.

units.zh: 后於帝為從嫂，或疑其服。
units.en: To the reigning emperor she was a sister-in-law, so ministers argued the garment.
units.literal: Toward the emperor she was his elder brother's wife—some doubted the mourning grade.

units.zh: 博士徐藻議，以為：「資父事君而敬同。
units.en: Erudite Xu Zao debated, holding that 'nurturing a father and serving a lord share the same reverence.
units.literal: Erudite Xu Zao debated, holding that 'nurturing a father and serving a lord share the same reverence.

units.zh: 又，禮，其夫屬父道者，其妻皆母道也。
units.en: Moreover by ritual: when a husband falls under the 'father's way,' his wives all fall under the 'mother's way.'
units.literal: Moreover by ritual: when a husband falls under the 'father's way,' his wives all fall under the 'mother's way.'

units.zh: 則夫屬君道，妻亦后道矣。
units.en: Then when the husband falls under the 'lord's way,' the wife likewise falls under the 'empress's way.'
units.literal: Then when the husband falls under the 'lord's way,' the wife likewise falls under the 'empress's way.'

units.zh: 服后宜以資母之義。
units.en: For the empress dowager one ought by the meaning of a nurturing mother.
units.literal: For the empress dowager one ought by the meaning of a nurturing mother.

units.zh: 魯譏逆祀，以明尊尊。
units.en: Lu reproached inverted sacrifice—to clarify honoring the honored.
units.literal: Lu reproached inverted sacrifice—to clarify honoring the honored.

units.zh: 今上躬奉康、穆、哀皇及靖后之祀，致敬同於所天。
units.en: Now the sovereign personally attends sacrifice to Emperors Kang, Mu, and Ai and to Empress Jing—pays utmost reverence the same as to Heaven.
units.literal: Now the sovereign personally attends sacrifice to Emperors Kang, Mu, and Ai and to Empress Jing—pays utmost reverence the same as to Heaven.

units.zh: 豈可敬之以君道，而服廢於本親。
units.en: How can one reverence her by the lord's way yet in garments cast off close kin.
units.literal: How can one reverence her by the lord's way yet in garments cast off close kin.

units.zh: 謂應服齊衰期。」
units.en: I say he ought wear qi-cui for one full cycle.'
units.literal: I say he ought wear qi-cui for one full cycle.'

units.zh: 於是帝制期服，
units.en: The throne adopted qi-cui mourning.
units.literal: Thereupon the emperor regulated qi-grade mourning.'"

units.zh: 隆安四年，孝武太皇太后李氏崩，疑所服。
units.en: In the fourth year of Long'an, when Grand Empress Dowager Li died, the court disputed the proper weeds.
units.literal: In the fourth year of Long'an, [The narrative continues:] Grand Empress Dowager Li of Xiaowu died—there was doubt about the garment.

units.zh: 尚書左僕射何澄、右僕射王雅、尚書車胤、孔安國、祠部郎徐廣議、太皇太后名位允正，體同皇極，理制備盡，情禮彌申。
units.en: He Cheng, Wang Ya, Che Yin, Kong Anguo, and Xu Guang argued her title was orthodox, her station matched the pole, and both law and sentiment demanded full mourning.
units.literal: Left Vice Minister He Cheng, right Vice Minister Wang Ya, ministers Che Yin, Kong Anguo, and Xu Guang of the Ritual Section debated: the grand empress dowager's title and rank are correct—her body matches the supreme pole—principle and system are complete, feeling and ritual further extend.

units.zh: 《陽秋》之義，母以子貴，既稱夫人，禮服從正。
units.en: The Zuo principle 'mother honored by son' means a titled consort takes the full garment schedule.
units.literal: The Spring and Autumn meaning: the mother is honored through the son—once she is titled lady, ritual garments follow correctness.

units.zh: 故成風顯夫人之號，文公服三年之喪。
units.en: Hence Duke Wen wore three years for Lady Chengfeng once she was titled mother.
units.literal: Therefore Cheng Feng bore the lady's title; Duke Wen observed three years' mourning.

units.zh: 子于父之所生，體尊義重。
units.en: A son owes the birth parent both dignity and deep obligation.
units.literal: The son toward the parent who bore him—body venerable, meaning heavy.

units.zh: 且禮，祖不厭孫，固宜遂服無屈，而緣情立制。
units.en: Ancestors do not override grandsons, so nothing in the canon forces a reduction, though feeling may shape the grade.
units.literal: Moreover by ritual the founding ancestor does not suppress the grandson—therefore it is fitting to follow the garment without bending, yet by feeling establish regulation.

units.zh: 若嫌明文不存，則疑斯從重，謂應同于為祖母后齊衰期。
units.en: Where scripture is unclear, choose the heavier rule—here that means qi-cui for a grandmother-empress.
units.literal: If one suspects the clear text does not survive, then in doubt follow the heavier—I say one ought match wearing qi-cui one cycle for a grandmother-empress.

units.zh: 永安皇后無服，但一舉哀，百官亦一期。」
units.en: Empress Yong'an had no garment—only once raised mourning; the hundred officials likewise one cycle.'
units.literal: Empress Yong'an had no garment—only once raised mourning; the hundred officials likewise one cycle.'

units.zh: 詔可。
units.en: The rescript said yes.
units.literal: The edict approved.'"

units.zh: 孝武帝太元十五年，淑媛陳氏卒，皇太子所生也。
units.en: In the fifteenth year of Taiyuan under Emperor Xiaowu, Honored Lady Chen died; she was the birth mother of the crown prince.
units.literal: In the fifteenth year of Taiyuan under Emperor Xiaowu, Honored Lady Chen died; she was the birth mother of the crown prince.

units.zh: 有司參詳母以子貴，贈淑媛為夫人，置家令典喪事。
units.en: the ministries invoked 'mother honored by son,' raised her to Lady, and assigned a household steward for the funeral.
units.literal: The offices deliberated in detail: the mother is honored through the son—posthumously honored the Honored Lady as lady—established a household steward to manage funeral affairs.

units.zh: 太子前衛率徐邈議：「《喪服傳》稱與尊者為體，則不服其私親。
units.en: Former crown-prince guard commander Xu Miao debated: "The Mourning Garments Commentary states that when one forms one body with the honored person, then one does not wear mourning for one's private kin.
units.literal: Former crown-prince guard commander Xu Miao debated: "The Mourning Garments Commentary states that when one forms one body with the honored person, then one does not wear mourning for one's private kin.

units.zh: 又，君父所不服，子亦不敢服。
units.en: Moreover, what lord and father does not wear, the son likewise dare not wear.
units.literal: Moreover, what lord and father does not wear, the son likewise dare not wear.

units.zh: 故王公妾子服其所生母練冠麻衣，既葬而除，非五服之常，則謂之無服。」
units.en: Therefore royal lords' sons by concubines wear for their birth mothers lien cap and hemp cloth—once buried then remove—not among the five garments' constant norms—then it is called having no garment."
units.literal: Therefore royal lords' sons by concubines wear for their birth mothers lien cap and hemp cloth—once buried then remove—not among the five garments' constant norms—then it is called having no garment."

units.zh: 從之，
units.en: The court accepted his reading.
units.literal: This was followed.

units.zh: 太元二十一年，孝武帝崩，孝武太后制三年之服。
units.en: In the twenty-first year of Taiyuan, Emperor Xiaowu died, and Empress Dowager Xiaowu established three-year mourning dress.
units.literal: In the twenty-first year of Taiyuan, Emperor Xiaowu died, and Empress Dowager Xiaowu established three-year mourning dress.

units.zh: 惠帝太安元年三月，皇太孫尚薨。
units.en: In the third month of the first year of Taian under Emperor Hui, the imperial grandson-heir Shang died.
units.literal: In the third month of the first year of Taian under Emperor Hui, the imperial grandson-heir Shang died.

units.zh: 有司奏，御服齊衰期。
units.en: The authorities asked that the emperor observe qi-cui mourning for the standard one-year term.
units.literal: The offices memorialized that the sovereign should wear qi-cui for one full year (qi).

units.zh: 詔下通議。
units.en: The throne sent down an edict for the whole bureaucracy to debate the matter.
units.literal: An edict ordered general court deliberation.

units.zh: 散騎常侍謝衡以為：「諸侯之太子，誓與未誓，尊卑體殊。
units.en: Cavalier attendant-in-ordinary Xie Heng held: "For a feudal lord's heir apparent, sworn presentation versus not yet sworn—the honored base and bodily tie differ.
units.literal: Cavalier attendant-in-ordinary Xie Heng held: "For a feudal lord's heir apparent, sworn presentation versus not yet sworn—the honored base and bodily tie differ.

units.zh: 《喪服》云為嫡子長殤，謂未誓也，已誓則不殤也。」
units.en: The Mourning Garments [canon] states mourning for the eldest legitimate son's long shang means not yet sworn; once sworn then it is not [counted as] shang."
units.literal: The Mourning Garments [canon] states mourning for the eldest legitimate son's long shang means not yet sworn; once sworn then it is not [counted as] shang."

units.zh: 中書令卞粹曰：「太子始生，故已尊重，不待命誓。
units.en: Minister of the Secretariat Bian Cui said: "The heir apparent from birth is therefore already honored high—does not await mandate-swearing.
units.literal: Minister of the Secretariat Bian Cui said: "The heir apparent from birth is therefore already honored high—does not await mandate-swearing.

units.zh: 若衡議已誓不殤，則無服之子當斬衰三年；
units.en: If by Xie's debate sworn means not shang, then the son for whom there is no [shang-scale] garment ought wear zhan-cui three years;
units.literal: If by Xie's debate sworn means not shang, then the son for whom there is no [shang-scale] garment ought wear zhan-cui three years;

units.zh: 未誓而殤，則雖十九當大功九月。
units.en: not sworn and [dies as] shang, then though age nineteen ought wear da gong nine months.
units.literal: not sworn and [dies as] shang, then though age nineteen ought wear da gong nine months.

units.zh: 誓與未誓，其為升降也微；
units.en: Sworn and not sworn—the rise and fall therein is slight;
units.literal: Sworn and not sworn—the rise and fall therein is slight;

units.zh: 斬衰與大功，其為輕重也遠。
units.en: zhan-cui and da gong—the light and heavy therein is far apart.
units.literal: zhan-cui and da gong—the light and heavy therein is far apart.

units.zh: 而今注云『諸侯不降嫡殤重』。
units.en: Yet now the commentary states 'feudal lords do not lower the weight of legitimate-son shang.'
units.literal: Yet now the commentary states 'feudal lords do not lower the weight of legitimate-son shang.'

units.zh: 嫌于無服，以大功為重嫡之服，則雖誓，無復有三年之理明矣。
units.en: Loath to [say] no garment, taking da gong as the garment weighting the legitimate heir—then though sworn, there is no longer principle for three years—this is clear.
units.literal: Loath to [say] no garment, taking da gong as the garment weighting the legitimate heir—then though sworn, there is no longer principle for three years—this is clear.

units.zh: 男能衛社稷，女能奉婦道，以可成之年而有已成之事，故可無殤，非孩齔之謂也。
units.en: When a male can guard altars of soil and grain and a female can uphold the wifely way—in years when completion is possible yet matters already accomplished—therefore may be without shang—it does not mean infant teeth.
units.literal: When a male can guard altars of soil and grain and a female can uphold the wifely way—in years when completion is possible yet matters already accomplished—therefore may be without shang—it does not mean infant teeth.

units.zh: 為殤後者尊之如父，猶無所加而止殤服，況以天子之尊，而為無服之殤行成人之制邪！
units.en: One who succeeds a shang [decedent] honors him like a father—still adds nothing and stops at shang garment—how much more with Heaven's Son's honor to enact adult norms for a shang without garment!
units.literal: One who succeeds a shang [decedent] honors him like a father—still adds nothing and stops at shang garment—how much more with Heaven's Son's honor to enact adult norms for a shang without garment!

units.zh: 凡諸宜重之殤，皆士大夫不加服，而令至尊獨居其重，未之前聞也。」
units.en: All shangs that ought be weighted—great officers add no garment—yet to make the supremacy alone bear the weight—never before heard."
units.literal: All shangs that ought be weighted—great officers add no garment—yet to make the supremacy alone bear the weight—never before heard."

units.zh: 博士蔡克同粹。
units.en: Court erudite Cai Ke sided with Bian Cui.
units.literal: Erudite Cai Ke agreed with Bian Cui.

units.zh: 秘書監摯虞云：「太子初生，舉以成人之禮，則殤理除矣。
units.en: Director of the Palace Library Zhi Yu said: "The heir apparent from birth is raised with adult rites—then shang principle is removed.
units.literal: Director of the Palace Library Zhi Yu said: "The heir apparent from birth is raised with adult rites—then shang principle is removed.

units.zh: 太孫亦體君傳重，由位成而服，全非以年也。
units.en: The grand heir likewise forms one body with the lord and transmits weight—garments follow from position achieved, wholly not by age.
units.literal: The grand heir likewise forms one body with the lord and transmits weight—garments follow from position achieved, wholly not by age.

units.zh: 天子無服殤之義，絕期故也。」
units.en: The Son of Heaven has no principle of wearing [mourning for] shang—because [such ties] are cut off at one full cycle (qi)."
units.literal: The Son of Heaven has no principle of wearing [mourning for] shang—because [such ties] are cut off at one full cycle (qi)."

units.zh: 於是從之。
units.en: The court adopted this view.
units.literal: Thereupon [the court] followed this.

units.zh: 魏氏故事，國有大喪，群臣凶服，以帛為綬囊，以布為劍衣。
units.en: Under Wei dynasty usage, a dynastic funeral saw ministers in mourning garb with silk pouches for seal cords and cloth wrappers for swords.
units.literal: Wei-house precedent: when the state had great mourning, many ministers wore funeral dress—silk for seal-cord pouches, cloth for sword sheaths.

units.zh: 新禮，以《傳》稱「去喪無所不佩」，明在喪則無佩也，更制齊斬之喪不佩劍綬。
units.en: The New Rites, because the Commentary states 'upon leaving mourning nothing is not suspended,' clarifies that in mourning there is no suspension—reformed so qi-cui and zhan-cui mourning do not suspend sword and seal cord.
units.literal: The New Rites, because the Commentary states 'upon leaving mourning nothing is not suspended,' clarifies that in mourning there is no suspension—reformed so qi-cui and zhan-cui mourning do not suspend sword and seal cord.

units.zh: 摯虞以為「《周禮》武賁氏，士大夫之職也，皆以兵守王宮，國有喪故，則衰葛執戈楯守門，葬則從車而哭。
units.en: Zhi Yu held that "the Zhou Rites' Wu-ben guards—great officers' duty—all with arms guard the royal palace; when the state has mourning cause, then [wear] frayed robe and kudzu, grasp halberd and shield guarding gates; at burial then follow carts and wail.
units.literal: Zhi Yu held that "the Zhou Rites' Wu-ben guards—great officers' duty—all with arms guard the royal palace; when the state has mourning cause, then [wear] frayed robe and kudzu, grasp halberd and shield guarding gates; at burial then follow carts and wail.

units.zh: 又，成王崩，太保命諸大夫以干戈內外警設。
units.en: Moreover, when King Cheng died, Grand Protect ordered various great officers with shields and halberds to set inner and outer vigil.
units.literal: Moreover, when King Cheng died, Grand Protect ordered various great officers with shields and halberds to set inner and outer vigil.

units.zh: 明喪故之際，蓋重宿衛之防。
units.en: This clarifies that at mourning's crisis one esteems night-watch defense.
units.literal: This clarifies that at mourning's crisis one esteems night-watch defense.

units.zh: 去喪無所不佩，謂服飾之事，不謂防禦之用。
units.en: 'Upon leaving mourning nothing not suspended' speaks of adornment matters—not defense uses.
units.literal: 'Upon leaving mourning nothing not suspended' speaks of adornment matters—not defense uses.

units.zh: 宜定新禮布衣劍如舊，其餘如新制。」
units.en: It is fitting to fix the New Rites: cloth garment and sword as of old—the rest as new regulation."
units.literal: It is fitting to fix the New Rites: cloth garment and sword as of old—the rest as new regulation."

units.zh: 詔從之。
units.en: An edict accepted his recommendation.
units.literal: An edict followed this.

units.zh: 漢魏故事，將葬，設吉凶鹵簿，皆以鼓吹。
units.en: Han and Wei practice paired auspicious and funeral halberd escorts at burial, both complete with military music.
units.literal: Han-Wei precedent: nearing burial, set auspicious and inauspicious halberd-escort arrays—all used drum-and-pipe.

units.zh: 新禮以禮無吉駕導從之文，臣子不宜釋其衰麻以服玄黃，除吉駕鹵簿。
units.en: The New Rites argued classical texts never sanctioned festive carriages and outriders for a burial, so ministers should not strip mourning hemp for court blacks—and struck the auspicious half of the halberd escort.
units.literal: The New Rites held the rites lack text for auspicious carriages with outriders—ministers and sons ought not shed their frayed hemp to wear black-and-yellow—removed auspicious-carriage halberd escort.

units.zh: 又，凶事無樂，遏密八音，除凶服之鼓吹。
units.en: Funerals should silence every instrument, they added, so drum-and-pipe bands had to go from the mourning procession as well.
units.literal: Moreover, inauspicious affairs have no music—suppress and silence the eight tones—removed drum-and-pipe from funeral dress [processions].

units.zh: 摯虞以為：「葬有祥車曠左，則今之容車也。
units.en: Zhi Yu held: "Burial has auspicious cart with empty left seat—that is today's appearance cart.
units.literal: Zhi Yu held: "Burial has auspicious cart with empty left seat—that is today's appearance cart.

units.zh: 既葬，日中反虞，逆神而還。
units.en: Once buried, at midday perform returning yu, welcome the spirit back.
units.literal: Once buried, at midday perform returning yu, welcome the spirit back.

units.zh: 《春秋傳》，鄭大夫公孫蠆卒，天子追賜大路，使以行。
units.en: The Spring and Autumn Commentary: Zheng grand officer Gongsun Chai died—the Son of Heaven posthumously granted great road-chariot, ordering it used for the procession.
units.literal: The Spring and Autumn Commentary: Zheng grand officer Gongsun Chai died—the Son of Heaven posthumously granted great road-chariot, ordering it used for the procession.

units.zh: 《士喪禮》，葬有稿車乘車，以載生之服。
units.en: The Gentlemen's Mourning Rites: burial has straw cart and riding cart—to carry garb [used] in life.
units.literal: The Gentlemen's Mourning Rites: burial has straw cart and riding cart—to carry garb [used] in life.

units.zh: 此皆不唯載柩，兼有吉駕之明文也。
units.en: These all not only bear the coffin—together they have explicit text for auspicious carriages.
units.literal: These all not only bear the coffin—together they have explicit text for auspicious carriages.

units.zh: 既設吉駕，則宜有導從，以象平生之容，明不致死之義。
units.en: Once auspicious carriages are set, then fittingly there should be outriders—to image deportment in life, clarifying the meaning of not treating [the deceased] as utterly dead.
units.literal: Once auspicious carriages are set, then fittingly there should be outriders—to image deportment in life, clarifying the meaning of not treating [the deceased] as utterly dead.

units.zh: 臣子衰麻不得為身而釋，以為君父則無不可。
units.en: Ministers and sons in frayed hemp may not for themselves shed—for lord and father then nothing impermissible.
units.literal: Ministers and sons in frayed hemp may not for themselves shed—for lord and father then nothing impermissible.

units.zh: 《顧命》之篇足以明之。
units.en: The 'Charge at Gu' piece suffices to clarify this.
units.literal: The 'Charge at Gu' piece suffices to clarify this.

units.zh: 宜定新禮設吉服導從如舊，其凶服鼓吹宜除。」
units.en: It is fitting to fix the New Rites to set auspicious-garment outriders as of old—the funeral drum-and-pipe ought be removed."
units.literal: It is fitting to fix the New Rites to set auspicious-garment outriders as of old—the funeral drum-and-pipe ought be removed."

units.zh: 詔從之。
units.en: The throne agreed.
units.literal: An edict followed this.

units.zh: 漢魏故事，大喪及大臣之喪，執紼者輓歌。
units.en: Han and Wei custom had catafalque bearers chant pulling-dirges at imperial funerals and at those of great ministers.
units.literal: Han-Wei precedent: great mourning and great ministers' mourning—those holding tow-ropes sang dirges.

units.zh: 新禮以為輓歌出於漢武帝役人之勞歌，聲哀切，遂以為送終之禮。
units.en: The New Rites traced those laments to corvée labor songs under Emperor Wu—voices sharp with grief—and showed how they had hardened into funeral practice.
units.literal: The New Rites held dirges arose from Han Emperor Wu's corvée people's labor songs—sound mournful and piercing—thereupon taken as seeing-off-the-end rite.

units.zh: 雖音曲摧愴，非經典所制，違禮設銜枚之義。
units.en: However wrenching the tunes, they are nowhere mandated in the classics and violate the spirit of biting wooden gag-bits to keep silence.
units.literal: Though melody is crushing-grief—not fashioned by classics—contravenes the rites' meaning of mouth-plugs.

units.zh: 方在號慕，不宜以歌為名。
units.en: Mid-wail for the dead, nothing should parade under the label of "song."
units.literal: Just now in wailing longing—not fitting to take 'song' as name.

units.zh: 除，不輓歌。
units.en: The reform abolished pulling-dirges altogether.
units.literal: Removed—no dirges.

units.zh: 摯虞以為：「輓歌因倡和而為摧愴之聲，銜枚所以全哀，此亦以感眾。
units.en: Zhi Yu held: "Dirges through lead-and-chorus become crushing sounds—mouth-plugs thereby preserve mourning—this too thereby moves the crowd.
units.literal: Zhi Yu held: "Dirges through lead-and-chorus become crushing sounds—mouth-plugs thereby preserve mourning—this too thereby moves the crowd.

units.zh: 雖非經典所載，是歷代故事。
units.en: Though not carried in classics—it is successive dynasties' precedent.
units.literal: Though not carried in classics—it is successive dynasties' precedent.

units.zh: 《詩》稱『君子作歌，惟以告哀』，以歌為名，亦無所嫌。
units.en: The Odes state 'the gentleman makes song—only to declare grief'—to take song as name—also nothing blameworthy.
units.literal: The Odes state 'the gentleman makes song—only to declare grief'—to take song as name—also nothing blameworthy.

units.zh: 宜定新禮如舊。」
units.en: It is fitting to fix the New Rites as of old."
units.literal: It is fitting to fix the New Rites as of old."

units.zh: 詔從之，
units.en: The court accepted his opinion.
units.literal: An edict followed this.

units.zh: 咸寧二年，安平穆王薨，無嗣，以母弟敦上繼獻王後，移太常問應何服。
units.en: In the second year of Xianning, when Prince Mu of Anping died without issue, his full brother Sima Dun was promoted to continue Prince Xian's line; the matter went to the Chamberlain for Ceremonials to settle the proper mourning grades.
units.literal: In the second year of Xianning, [Text joins prior clause;] Prince Mu of Anping died—no heir—his uterine younger brother Dun was elevated to continue Prince Xian's line—the case was referred to the Chamberlain for Ceremonials asking what mourning ought apply.

units.zh: 博士張靖答，宜依魯僖服閔三年例。
units.en: Erudite Zhang Jing answered that the parallel was Duke Xi of Lu wearing three years' mourning for Duke Min.
units.literal: Erudite Zhang Jing replied—it should follow Duke Xi of Lu's mourning Duke Min three-year precedent.

units.zh: 尚書符詰靖：「穆王不臣敦，敦不繼穆，與閔僖不同。」
units.en: The Secretariat issued a writ pressing Jing: "Prince Mu did not treat Dun as subject—Dun does not succeed Mu—this differs from Min and Xi."
units.literal: The Secretariat issued a writ pressing Jing: "Prince Mu did not treat Dun as subject—Dun does not succeed Mu—this differs from Min and Xi."

units.zh: 孫毓、宋昌議，以穆王不之國，敦不仕諸侯，不應三年。
units.en: Sun Yu and Song Chang countered that because Prince Mu never took up his fief and Dun had never served as a feudal officer, full three-year mourning was out of the question.
units.literal: Sun Yu and Song Chang debated that because Prince Mu never went to his fief and Dun never served feudal lords, three years should not apply.

units.zh: 以義處之，敦宜服本服，一期而除，主穆王喪祭三年畢，乃吉祭獻王。
units.en: On principle, Dun should wear only his own proper grade—doffing it after the one-year term—yet still oversee Prince Mu's mortuary rites through three years before he may offer auspicious sacrifices to Prince Xian.
units.literal: Judging by right principle, Dun ought wear his proper garment—remove after one full cycle (qi)—preside over Prince Mu's mourning sacrifices completing three years—then perform auspicious sacrifice to Prince Xian.

units.zh: 毓云：「《禮》，君之子孫所以臣諸兄者，以臨國故也。
units.en: Sun Yu said: "By the Rites, why lord's descendants treat elder brothers as lord—because they face the state.
units.literal: Sun Yu said: "By the Rites, why lord's descendants treat elder brothers as lord—because they face the state.

units.zh: 《禮》又與諸侯為兄弟服斬者，謂鄰國之臣於鄰國之君，有猶君之義故也。
units.en: The Rites moreover [say] wearing zhan-cui for feudal-lord brothers means neighboring state's ministers toward neighboring state's lord—because there is quasi-lord meaning.
units.literal: The Rites moreover [say] wearing zhan-cui for feudal-lord brothers means neighboring state's ministers toward neighboring state's lord—because there is quasi-lord meaning.

units.zh: 今穆王既不之國，不臣兄弟，敦不仕諸侯，無鄰臣之義，異于閔僖，如符旨也。
units.en: Now Prince Mu neither went to state nor treated brothers as subjects—Dun never served feudal lords—no neighboring-minister meaning—differs from Min and Xi—as the writ's intent [states].
units.literal: Now Prince Mu neither went to state nor treated brothers as subjects—Dun never served feudal lords—no neighboring-minister meaning—differs from Min and Xi—as the writ's intent [states].

units.zh: 但喪無主，敦既奉詔紹國，受重主喪，典其祭祀。
units.en: But mourning lacked a master—Dun having received edict to continue the state—received weight and presided mourning—administers its sacrifices.
units.literal: But mourning lacked a master—Dun having received edict to continue the state—received weight and presided mourning—administers its sacrifices.

units.zh: 『大功者主人之喪，有三年者則必為之再祭』。
units.en: 'For da gong [mourning] the master's mourning—if there is one with three years then must perform for him twice the sacrifice.'
units.literal: 'For da gong [mourning] the master's mourning—if there is one with three years then must perform for him twice the sacrifice.'

units.zh: 鄭氏《注》云，『謂死者之從父昆弟來為喪主也。」
units.en: Zheng's Commentary states: '[This] means the deceased's father's brothers' sons who come as mourning master.
units.literal: Zheng's Commentary states: '[This] means the deceased's father's brothers' sons who come as mourning master.

units.zh: 有三年者，謂妻若子幼少也』。
units.en: [Text joins prior quotation;] 'those who have three years' refers to wife or young children (close of Zheng Xuan gloss).
units.literal: [Text joins prior quotation;] 'those who have three years' refers to wife or young children (close of Zheng Xuan gloss).

units.zh: 『再祭，謂大小祥也』。
units.en: 'Twice sacrifice means great and small xiang.'
units.literal: 'Twice sacrifice means great and small xiang.'

units.zh: 穆妃及國臣於禮皆當三年，此為有三年者，敦當為之主大小兩祥祭也。
units.en: Prince Mu's consort and his household ministers each owe three years of mourning; they are the "three-year" parties for whom Dun must preside over both xiang ceremonies.
units.literal: Prince Mu's consort and state ministers by rites all ought three years—these are those with three years—Dun ought for them preside both great- and small-xiang sacrifices.

units.zh: 且哀樂不相雜，吉凶不相干。
units.en: Moreover grief must not mingle with celebration, nor mourning with felicity.
units.literal: Moreover grief and joy do not mix—inauspicious and auspicious do not cross.

units.zh: 凶服在宮，哭泣未絕。
units.en: Funeral weeds still fill the palace and wails have not fallen silent.
units.literal: Funeral dress in the palace—wailing not ceased.

units.zh: 敦遽主穆王之喪，而國制未除，則不得以己本親服除而吉祭獻王也。」，
units.en: Dun hastily presides Prince Mu's mourning—yet state regulation not removed—then may not with his own kin garment removed perform auspicious sacrifice to Prince Xian."
units.literal: Dun hastily presides Prince Mu's mourning—yet state regulation not removed—then may not with his own kin garment removed perform auspicious sacrifice to Prince Xian."

units.zh: 陳留國上，燕公是王之父，王出奉明帝祀，今于王為從父，有司奏應服期，不以親疏尊卑為降。
units.en: Chenliu memorialized that the Duke of Yan was the king's natural father; once the king had been given to continue Emperor Ming's line, the duke counted only as a congfu relative. Officials proposed qi-grade mourning with no reduction for intimacy or rank.
units.literal: [Text joins prior clause;] Chenliu state reported—the Duke of Yan is the king's father—the king went out to serve Emperor Ming's sacrifices—now toward the king [the duke] is congfu kin—the offices memorialized [the duke] ought wear qi (one full cycle) mourning—not lowering by kin distance or honor base.

units.zh: 詔曰：「王奉魏氏，所承者重，不得服其私親。」
units.en: Edict stated: "The king carries Wei house—the inheritance is weighty—may not wear for private kin."
units.literal: Edict stated: "The king carries Wei house—the inheritance is weighty—may not wear for private kin."

units.zh: 穆帝時，東海國言，哀王薨逾年，嗣王乃來繼，不復追服，群臣皆已反吉，國妃亦宜同除。
units.en: Later, under Emperor Mu, Donghai argued that King Ai had been dead more than a year before the heir arrived, so no retroactive mourning was worn; ministers had all returned to felicity garb, and the princess-consort should shed weeds as well.
units.literal: Under Emperor Mu, Donghai state reported—King Ai died over a year—then the successor king came to continue—did not retroactively wear mourning—all ministers already returned auspicious—the state's royal consort likewise ought remove together.

units.zh: 詔曰：「朝廷所以從權制者，以王事奪之，非為變禮也。
units.en: Edict stated: "Why the court followed expedient regulation—because royal affairs seized them—not to alter the rites.
units.literal: Edict stated: "Why the court followed expedient regulation—because royal affairs seized them—not to alter the rites.

units.zh: 婦人傳重義大，若從權制，義將安托！」
units.en: Women's transmitting weight—right meaning is great—if following expedient regulation—where will right rest!"
units.literal: Women's transmitting weight—right meaning is great—if following expedient regulation—where will right rest!"

units.zh: 於是國妃終三年之禮。
units.en: The princess-consort therefore observed the full three-year mourning.
units.literal: Thereupon the state's royal consort completed three years' rites.

units.zh: 孫盛以為：「廢三年之禮，開偷薄之源，漢魏失之大者也。
units.en: Sun Sheng held: "Abolishing three years' rites—opens source of stingy thinness—Han-Wei's great failure.
units.literal: Sun Sheng held: "Abolishing three years' rites—opens source of stingy thinness—Han-Wei's great failure.

units.zh: 今若以大夫宜奪以王事。
units.en: Now if holding great officers ought be seized by royal affairs.
units.literal: Now if holding great officers ought be seized by royal affairs.

units.zh: 婦人可終本服，是吉凶之儀雜陳于宮寢，彩素之制乖異於內外，無乃情禮俱違，哀樂失所乎！」，
units.en: women may complete proper garment—is this not auspicious and inauspicious observances mixed in palace chambers—bright and plain regulations contrary inner and outer—surely emotion and rites both violated—grief and joy lose their place!"
units.literal: women may complete proper garment—is this not auspicious and inauspicious observances mixed in palace chambers—bright and plain regulations contrary inner and outer—surely emotion and rites both violated—grief and joy lose their place!"

units.zh: 太元十七年，太常車胤上言：「謹案《喪服禮經》，庶子為母緦麻三月。
units.en: In the seventeenth year of Taiyuan, Che Yin, Chamberlain for Ceremonials, submitted a statement, saying, "I respectfully examine the Mourning Garments ritual canon: a concubine-born son mourns his mother with three months of fine hemp.
units.literal: In the seventeenth year of Taiyuan, Che Yin, Chamberlain for Ceremonials, submitted a statement, saying, "I respectfully examine the Mourning Garments ritual canon: a concubine-born son mourns his mother with three months of fine hemp.

units.zh: 《傳》曰：『何以緦麻？
units.en: The Commentary states: 'Why si?
units.literal: The Commentary states: 'Why si?

units.zh: 以尊者為體，不敢服其私親也。』
units.en: Because one forms body with the honored—dare not wear for private kin.'
units.literal: Because one forms body with the honored—dare not wear for private kin.'

units.zh: 此《經》《傳》之明文，聖賢之格言。
units.en: This is classic and commentary's clear text—sages' model words.
units.literal: This is classic and commentary's clear text—sages' model words.

units.zh: 而自頃開國公侯，至於卿士，庶子為後，各肆私情，服其庶母，同之於嫡。
units.en: Yet from recently enfeoffed dukes and marquises down to ministers—sons by concubine who became heirs—each indulged private feeling—wore mourning for concubine-mothers—equating to legitimate mother.
units.literal: Yet from recently enfeoffed dukes and marquises down to ministers—sons by concubine who became heirs—each indulged private feeling—wore mourning for concubine-mothers—equating to legitimate mother.

units.zh: 此末俗之弊，溺情傷教，縱而不革，則流遁忘返矣。
units.en: This is late custom's harm—drowning feeling injures teaching—if indulged and not reformed—then drift astray unable return.
units.literal: This is late custom's harm—drowning feeling injures teaching—if indulged and not reformed—then drift astray unable return.

units.zh: 且夫尊尊親親，雖禮之大本，然厭親于尊，由來尚矣。
units.en: Moreover honoring honor and kinning kin—though rites' great root—yet subordinating kin to honor—from antiquity esteemed.
units.literal: Moreover honoring honor and kinning kin—though rites' great root—yet subordinating kin to honor—from antiquity esteemed.

units.zh: 《禮記》曰，『為父後，出母無服也者，不祭故也』。
units.en: The Record of Rites states: 'Acting as father's heir—divorced mother no garment—because [one does] not sacrifice [to her] thereby.'
units.literal: The Record of Rites states: 'Acting as father's heir—divorced mother no garment—because [one does] not sacrifice [to her] thereby.'

units.zh: 又，禮，天子父母之喪，未葬，越紼而祭天地社稷。
units.en: Moreover, by rites—Son of Heaven's father-mother mourning—not yet buried—step over rope-coffin and sacrifice to Heaven Earth soil and grain.
units.literal: Moreover, by rites—Son of Heaven's father-mother mourning—not yet buried—step over rope-coffin and sacrifice to Heaven Earth soil and grain.

units.zh: 斯皆崇嚴至敬，不敢以私廢尊也。
units.en: These all exalt stern utmost reverence—dare not with private discard honor.
units.literal: These all exalt stern utmost reverence—dare not with private discard honor.

units.zh: 今身承祖宗之重，而以庶母之私，廢烝嘗之事。
units.en: Now personally bearing ancestors' weight—yet with concubine-mother's private—abolish zheng-offering and chang-offering affairs.
units.literal: Now personally bearing ancestors' weight—yet with concubine-mother's private—abolish zheng-offering and chang-offering affairs.

units.zh: 五廟闕祀，由一妾之終，求之情禮，失莫大焉。
units.en: Five temples lack sacrifice—because one concubine's end—seek in emotion and rites—failure none greater.
units.literal: Five temples lack sacrifice—because one concubine's end—seek in emotion and rites—failure none greater.

units.zh: 舉世皆然，莫之裁貶。
units.en: Whole age thus—none trims or faults it.
units.literal: Whole age thus—none trims or faults it.

units.zh: 就心不同，而事不敢異。
units.en: In heart disagree—but in deed dare not differ.
units.literal: In heart disagree—but in deed dare not differ.

units.zh: 故正禮遂穨，而習非成俗。
units.en: Hence correct rites thus crumble—and habit wrong becomes custom.
units.literal: Hence correct rites thus crumble—and habit wrong becomes custom.

units.zh: 此《國風》所以思古，《小雅》所以悲歎。
units.en: This is why Airs of the States longs for antiquity—why Lesser Odes laments.
units.literal: This is why Airs of the States longs for antiquity—why Lesser Odes laments.

units.zh: 當今九服漸甯，王化惟新，誠宜崇明禮訓，以一風俗。
units.en: Now the nine domains gradually pacified—kingly transformation anew—truly fitting exalt bright ritual instruction—to unify customs.
units.literal: Now the nine domains gradually pacified—kingly transformation anew—truly fitting exalt bright ritual instruction—to unify customs.

units.zh: 請臺省考修經典，式明王度。」
units.en: I request that the central departments examine and revise the classics, so as to make the royal standards clear.”
units.literal: I request that the central departments examine and revise the classics, so as to make the royal standards clear.”

units.zh: 不答。
units.en: The throne let the matter drop without answering.
units.literal: [Closing the edict;] there was no reply.

units.zh: 十八年，胤又上言：「去年上，自頃開國公侯，至於卿士，庶子為後者，服其庶母，同之於嫡，違禮犯制，宜加裁抑。
units.en: In the eighteenth year Che Yin again memorialized: "Since last year's memorial, from recently enfeoffed dukes and marquises down to senior ministers, heirs born of concubines have worn mourning for concubine-mothers equal to a legal parent—this breaches ritual and statute and ought to be curbed.
units.literal: In the eighteenth year Che Yin again memorialized: "Since last year's memorial, from recently enfeoffed dukes and marquises down to senior ministers, heirs born of concubines have worn mourning for concubine-mothers equal to a legal parent—this breaches ritual and statute and ought to be curbed.

units.zh: 事上經年，未被告報，未審朝議以何為疑。
units.en: The matter has been on high a full year without returned report—I do not know what doubt the court's deliberation still harbors.
units.literal: The matter has been on high a full year without returned report—I do not know what doubt the court's deliberation still harbors.

units.zh: 若以所陳或謬，則經有文；
units.en: If what I stated is mistaken, then the classics still contain explicit text.
units.literal: If what I stated is mistaken, then the classics still contain explicit text.

units.zh: 若以古今不同，則晉有成典。
units.en: If ancient and modern differ, then Jin itself already has established precedent.
units.literal: If ancient and modern differ, then Jin itself already has established precedent.

units.zh: 升平四年，故太宰武陵王所生母喪，表求齊衰三年，詔聽依昔樂安王故事，制大功九月，
units.en: In the fourth year of Shengping, when the late grand preceptor the Prince of Wuling lost his birth mother, he asked for qi-cui three years; an edict allowed him to follow the former Prince of Le'an precedent and fixed da gong nine months.
units.literal: In the fourth year of Shengping, when the late grand preceptor the Prince of Wuling lost his birth mother, he asked for qi-cui three years; an edict allowed him to follow the former Prince of Le'an precedent and fixed da gong nine months.

units.zh: 興甯三年，故梁王㻱又所生母喪，亦求三年。
units.en: In the third year of Xingning, [The narrative continues:] When the late Prince of Liang Zhen likewise lost his birth mother, he again requested three years.
units.literal: In the third year of Xingning, [The narrative continues:] When the late Prince of Liang Zhen likewise lost his birth mother, he again requested three years.

units.zh: 《庚子詔書》依太宰故事，同服大功。
units.en: The Gengzi edict followed the grand preceptor precedent and likewise prescribed da gong.
units.literal: The Gengzi edict followed the grand preceptor precedent and likewise prescribed da gong.

units.zh: 若謹案周禮，則緦麻三月；
units.en: If one consults the Zhou Rites, the grade is si hemp for three months.
units.literal: If one consults the Zhou Rites, the grade is si hemp for three months.

units.zh: 若奉晉制，則大功九月。
units.en: If one follows Jin statute, it is da gong for nine months.
units.literal: If one follows Jin statute, it is da gong for nine months.

units.zh: 古禮今制，並無居廬三年之文，而頃年已來，各申私情，更相擬襲，漸以成俗。
units.en: Neither old rite nor current law ever authorized three years in the mourning hut—yet lately each house pleads private feeling and copies the next until it has hardened into custom.
units.literal: Neither old rite nor current law ever authorized three years in the mourning hut—yet lately each house pleads private feeling and copies the next until it has hardened into custom.

units.zh: 縱而不禁，則聖典滅矣。
units.en: If indulged and never forbidden, the sage canons are undone.
units.literal: If indulged and never forbidden, the sage canons are undone.

units.zh: 夫尊尊親親，立人之本，王化所由，二端而已。
units.en: Honoring superiors and cherishing kin are the twin roots of becoming human; kingly transformation flows from these two channels alone.
units.literal: Honoring superiors and cherishing kin are the twin roots of becoming human; kingly transformation flows from these two channels alone.

units.zh: 故先王設教，務弘其極，尊郊社之敬，制越紼之禮，嚴宗廟之祀，厭庶子之服，所以經緯人文，化成天下。
units.en: Therefore former kings framed instruction to carry each principle to its height: they magnified suburban-altar awe, regulated the rite of vaulting the burial cord, tightened ancestral sacrifice, and suppressed mourning for concubine-mothers—by these they ordered civilization and transformed the realm.
units.literal: Therefore former kings framed instruction to carry each principle to its height: they magnified suburban-altar awe, regulated the rite of vaulting the burial cord, tightened ancestral sacrifice, and suppressed mourning for concubine-mothers—by these they ordered civilization and transformed the realm.

units.zh: 夫屈家事于王道，厭私恩於祖宗，豈非上行乎下，父行乎子！
units.en: Bending household duty to the kingly way and subordinating private grace to the ancestors—is this not the sovereign setting the pattern below and fathers doing the same for sons?
units.literal: Bending household duty to the kingly way and subordinating private grace to the ancestors—is this not the sovereign setting the pattern below and fathers doing the same for sons?

units.zh: 若尊尊之心有時而替，宜厭之情觸事而申，祖宗之敬微，而君臣之禮虧矣。
units.en: If reverence for rank ever falters and the feeling that ought to be suppressed surges at every turn, respect for ancestors thins and the rite between lord and minister collapses.
units.literal: If reverence for rank ever falters and the feeling that ought to be suppressed surges at every turn, respect for ancestors thins and the rite between lord and minister collapses.

units.zh: 嚴恪微於祖宗，致敬虧於事上，而欲俗安化隆，不亦難乎！
units.en: When awe before ancestors grows slight and reverence toward superiors fails, expecting customs to mend and transformation to flourish—is that not difficult!
units.literal: When awe before ancestors grows slight and reverence toward superiors fails, expecting customs to mend and transformation to flourish—is that not difficult!

units.zh: 區區所惜，實在於斯。
units.en: What your humble servant cherishes lies precisely here.
units.literal: What your humble servant cherishes lies precisely here.

units.zh: 職之所司，不敢不言。
units.en: What my office oversees—I dare not keep silent.
units.literal: What my office oversees—I dare not keep silent.

units.zh: 請臺參詳。」
units.en: I ask the central departments to deliberate in detail."
units.literal: I ask the central departments to deliberate in detail."

units.zh: 尚書奏：「案如辭輒下主者詳尋。
units.en: The Ministry memorialized: "As the wording states, send it down to the supervisor to investigate in detail.
units.literal: The Ministry memorialized: "As the wording states, send it down to the supervisor to investigate in detail.

units.zh: 依禮，庶子與尊者為體，不敢服其私親，此尊祖敬宗之義。
units.en: By ritual a son by concubine who is ritually one with the exalted may not wear mourning for a private parent—this is the meaning of revering ancestors and respecting the lineage.
units.literal: By ritual a son by concubine who is ritually one with the exalted may not wear mourning for a private parent—this is the meaning of revering ancestors and respecting the lineage.

units.zh: 自頃陵遲，斯禮遂廢。
units.en: From recent decline this rite has been cast aside.
units.literal: From recent decline this rite has been cast aside.

units.zh: 封國之君廢五廟之重，士庶匹夫闕烝嘗之禮，習成穨俗，宜被革正。
units.en: Enfeoffed lords toss away the weight of five shrines; gentlemen and commoners skip winter and autumn offerings—habit has slid into decay and ought to be corrected.
units.literal: Enfeoffed lords toss away the weight of five shrines; gentlemen and commoners skip winter and autumn offerings—habit has slid into decay and ought to be corrected.

units.zh: 輒內外參詳，謂宜聽胤所上，可依樂安王大功為正。
units.en: We inner and outer offices have deliberated in detail and deem it fitting to accept what Yin submitted: take the Prince of Le'an's da gong as the correct standard.
units.literal: We inner and outer offices have deliberated in detail and deem it fitting to accept what Yin submitted: take the Prince of Le'an's da gong as the correct standard.

units.zh: 請為告書如左，班下內外，以定永制，普令依承，事可奉行。」
units.en: Request that a proclamation be drafted as below, circulated inside and outside, to fix a perpetual rule so all may comply—the measure can then be enforced."
units.literal: Request that a proclamation be drafted as below, circulated inside and outside, to fix a perpetual rule so all may comply—the measure can then be enforced."

units.zh: 詔可。
units.en: The throne agreed.
units.literal: The edict approved."

units.zh: 《禮》，王為三公六卿錫衰，為大夫士疑衰，首服弁絰。
units.en: Sovereigns don xi-cui for top ministers, yi-cui for lower ranks, capped with mourning ties.
units.literal: The Rites prescribe that the king wears xi-cui for the Three Dukes and six ministers, yi-cui for great officers and gentlemen, with cap-band and zhui cord.

units.zh: 天子諸侯皆為貴臣貴妾服三月。
units.en: Rulers mourn favorite ministers and concubines three months by the same rule.
units.literal: Son of Heaven and feudal lords alike observe three months for honored ministers and honored concubines.

units.zh: 漢為大臣制服無聞焉。
units.en: Han sources never spell out court weeds for ministers.
units.literal: I have not heard that Han prescribed mourning garments for great ministers.

units.zh: 漢明帝時，東海恭王薨，帝出幸津門亭發哀。
units.en: Han Mingdi rode to Jinmen kiosk to wail for his brother.
units.literal: When Emperor Ming of Han mourned the Prince Gong of Donghai, the sovereign went out to Jinmen pavilion to raise the lament.

units.zh: 及武帝十一月，詔「諸王公大臣薨，應三朝發哀者，逾月不舉樂，其一朝發哀者，三日不舉樂也」。
units.en: Under Emperor Wu in the eleventh month an edict read: "When princes, dukes, or great ministers die, those who owe three audiences of mourning shall have no music for over a month; those who owe one audience shall have no music for three days."
units.literal: Under Emperor Wu in the eleventh month an edict read: "When princes, dukes, or great ministers die, those who owe three audiences of mourning shall have no music for over a month; those who owe one audience shall have no music for three days."

units.zh: 元帝姨廣昌鄉君喪，未葬，中丞熊遠表云：「案《禮》『君于卿大夫，比葬不食肉，比卒哭不舉樂』，惻隱之心未忍行吉事故也。
units.en: When Emperor Yuan's maternal aunt the Lady of Guangchang village died, before burial Palace Secretary Xiong Yuan memorialized: "The Rites say the lord toward ministers and great officers—before burial does not eat meat, before the end of wailing does not raise music—because pitying hearts cannot yet bear auspicious business.
units.literal: When Emperor Yuan's maternal aunt the Lady of Guangchang village died, before burial Palace Secretary Xiong Yuan memorialized: "The Rites say the lord toward ministers and great officers—before burial does not eat meat, before the end of wailing does not raise music—because pitying hearts cannot yet bear auspicious business.

units.zh: 被尚書符，冬至後二日小會。
units.en: A Secretariat directive scheduled a small court gathering two days after the winter solstice.
units.literal: A Secretariat directive scheduled a small court gathering two days after the winter solstice.

units.zh: 臣以為廣昌鄉君喪殯日，聖恩垂悼。
units.en: Your servant holds that on the Lady of Guangchang's encoffining day sagely grace should show condolence.
units.literal: Your servant holds that on the Lady of Guangchang's encoffining day sagely grace should show condolence.

units.zh: 禮，大夫死，廢一時之祭。
units.en: By ritual, when a great officer dies, one season's sacrifice is suspended.
units.literal: By ritual, when a great officer dies, one season's sacrifice is suspended.

units.zh: 祭猶可廢，而況餘事。
units.en: If sacrifice may be suspended, how much more other affairs.
units.literal: If sacrifice may be suspended, how much more other affairs.

units.zh: 冬至唯可群下奉賀而已，未便小會。」
units.en: Winter solstice may only be an occasion for subordinates to offer congratulations—it is not yet fitting to convene a small assembly."
units.literal: Winter solstice may only be an occasion for subordinates to offer congratulations—it is not yet fitting to convene a small assembly."

units.zh: 詔以遠表示賀循，又曰：「武皇帝故事云『王公大臣薨，三朝發哀，逾月不舉樂，其一朝發哀，三日不舉樂』，此舊事明文。」
units.en: The edict forwarded Xiong's statement to He Xun and added: "Emperor Wu's precedent reads: 'When princes, dukes, or great ministers die—three audiences of mourning, then no music for over a month; one audience, then no music for three days'—that old text is explicit."
units.literal: The edict forwarded Xiong's statement to He Xun and added: "Emperor Wu's precedent reads: 'When princes, dukes, or great ministers die—three audiences of mourning, then no music for over a month; one audience, then no music for three days'—that old text is explicit."

units.zh: 賀循答曰：「案《禮·雜記》，『君于卿大夫之喪，比葬不食肉，比卒哭不舉樂』。
units.en: He Xun replied: "Reviewing the Rites, Miscellaneous Records: 'The lord toward a minister's or great officer's mourning—before burial does not eat meat, before the end of wailing does not raise music.
units.literal: He Xun replied: "Reviewing the Rites, Miscellaneous Records: 'The lord toward a minister's or great officer's mourning—before burial does not eat meat, before the end of wailing does not raise music.

units.zh: 古者君臣義重，雖以至尊之義，降而無服，三月之內，猶錫衰以居，不接吉事。
units.en: In antiquity the bond between lord and minister was weighty: though the utmost honoring rites lowered the sovereign so he wore no full mourning, within three months he still dwelt in xi-cui and undertook no auspicious affairs.
units.literal: In antiquity the bond between lord and minister was weighty: though the utmost honoring rites lowered the sovereign so he wore no full mourning, within three months he still dwelt in xi-cui and undertook no auspicious affairs.

units.zh: 故春秋晉大夫智悼子未葬，平公作樂，為屠蒯所譏。
units.en: Therefore the Spring and Autumn records that while Jin minister Zhi Ying lay unburied, Duke Ping ordered music and was rebuked by the blind musician Tu Kui.
units.literal: Therefore the Spring and Autumn records that while Jin minister Zhi Ying lay unburied, Duke Ping ordered music and was rebuked by the blind musician Tu Kui.

units.zh: 如遠所答，合于古義。
units.en: Xiong Yuan's answer matches ancient meaning.
units.literal: Xiong Yuan's answer matches ancient meaning.

units.zh: 咸寧詔書雖不會經典，然隨時立宜，以為定制，誠非群下所得稱論。」，
units.en: The Xianning edict may not tally with every classic, yet it set workable law for its day and became fixed statute—not something subordinates should reopen at will."
units.literal: The Xianning edict may not tally with every classic, yet it set workable law for its day and became fixed statute—not something subordinates should reopen at will."

units.zh: 升平元年，帝姑廬陵公主未葬，符問太常，冬至小會應作樂不。
units.en: In Shengping 1, while Princess Luling still awaited burial, an official inquiry asked whether the winter-solstice dinner could have music.
units.literal: In Shengping 1, the emperor's aunt, Princess Luling, had not yet been buried, and an official note asked the Chamberlain for Ceremonials whether music should be performed at the small winter-solstice gathering.

units.zh: 博士胡訥議云：「君于卿大夫，比卒哭不舉樂。
units.en: Erudite Hu Na argued: "The lord toward ministers and great officers does not raise music before the end of wailing.
units.literal: Erudite Hu Na argued: "The lord toward ministers and great officers does not raise music before the end of wailing.

units.zh: 公主有骨肉之親，宜闕樂。」
units.en: The princess shares flesh-and-bone closeness—music ought to be omitted."
units.literal: The princess shares flesh-and-bone closeness—music ought to be omitted."

units.zh: 太常王彪之云：「案武帝詔，三朝舉哀，三旬乃舉樂；
units.en: Chamberlain Wang Biaozhi said: "Reviewing Emperor Wu's edict—three audiences of mourning, then music only after three decad-days;
units.literal: Chamberlain Wang Bianzhi said: "Reviewing Emperor Wu's edict—three audiences of mourning, then music only after three decad-days;

units.zh: 其一朝舉哀者，三日則舉樂。
units.en: those who hold one audience of mourning may raise music after three days.
units.literal: those who hold one audience of mourning may raise music after three days.

units.zh: 泰始十年春，長樂長公主薨，太康七年秋，扶風王駿薨，武帝並舉哀三日而已。
units.en: In spring of the tenth year of Taishi, the Senior Princess of Changle died; in autumn of the seventh year of Taikang, Prince Jun of Fufeng died. For both, Emperor Wu held mourning for only three days.
units.literal: In spring of the tenth year of Taishi, the Senior Princess of Changle died; in autumn of the seventh year of Taikang, Prince Jun of Fufeng died. For both, Emperor Wu held mourning for only three days.

units.zh: 中興已後，更參論不改此制。
units.en: Since the Eastern Restoration courts have debated again and never altered that system.
units.literal: Since the Eastern Restoration courts have debated again and never altered that system.

units.zh: 今小會宜作樂。」
units.en: Therefore the small assembly ought use music."
units.literal: Therefore the small assembly ought use music."

units.zh: 二議竟不知所取。
units.en: The ministries left the contradiction unresolved.
units.literal: Between the two opinions the court never settled which to follow.

units.zh: 《喪服記》，公為所寓，齊衰三月。
units.en: Classical text still gives three months of qi-cui for a refugee lord and his patron.
units.literal: The Mourning Garments Record states that a lord for a host to whom he lodges wears qi-cui three months.

units.zh: 新禮以今無此事，除此一章。
units.en: Jin's New Rites dropped the chapter as obsolete.
units.literal: The New Rites deleted this chapter because the circumstance no longer occurs today.

units.zh: 摯虞以為：「《周禮》作于刑厝之時，而著荒政十二。
units.en: Zhi Yu argued: "The Zhou Rites were compiled when punishments were laid aside, yet they still list twelve famine policies.
units.literal: Zhi Yu argued: "The Zhou Rites were compiled when punishments were laid aside, yet they still list twelve famine policies.

units.zh: 禮備制待物，不以時衰而除盛典，世隆而闕衰教也。
units.en: Rites complete their regulations to meet every contingency—they do not discard great ceremonies because the age declines, nor omit teachings on decline because the world prospers.
units.literal: Rites complete their regulations to meet every contingency—they do not discard great ceremonies because the age declines, nor omit teachings on decline because the world prospers.

units.zh: 曩者王司徒失守播越，自稱寄公。
units.en: When former Director Wang lost his command and wandered, calling himself a guest lord.
units.literal: When former Director Wang lost his command and wandered, calling himself a guest lord.

units.zh: 是時天下又多此比，皆禮之所及。
units.en: At that time many under Heaven were in the same case—all fell within ritual's reach.
units.literal: At that time many under Heaven were in the same case—all fell within ritual's reach.

units.zh: 宜定新禮自如舊經。」
units.en: The New Rites should restore this chapter as in the old classic."
units.literal: The New Rites should restore this chapter as in the old classic."

units.zh: 詔從之。
units.en: The throne agreed.
units.literal: The edict followed his view."

units.zh: 漢魏故事無五等諸侯之制，公卿朝士服喪，親疏各如其親。
units.en: Han and Wei let mourning follow blood, not rank.
units.literal: Han and Wei precedent had no five-rank feudal system; dukes, ministers, and court gentlemen wore mourning close or distant according to true kinship.

units.zh: 新禮王公五等諸侯成國置卿者，及朝廷公孤之爵，皆傍親絕期，而旁親為之服斬衰，卿校位從大夫者皆絕緦。
units.en: Jin's code tried to sever collateral ties for great nobles while still demanding zhan-cui from cousins—a tangle Han never used.
units.literal: The New Rites hold that princes and dukes of the five ranks who have completed a state and installed ministers, together with court duke-and-guardian titles, all cut collateral mourning at qi, yet require collateral kin to wear zhan-cui for them, while ministers ranked with great officers cut si entirely.

units.zh: 摯虞以為：「古者諸侯君臨其國，臣諸父兄，今之諸侯未同于古。
units.en: Zhi Yu held: "Ancient feudal lords ruled their states and treated paternal uncles as subjects; today's nobles are not the same as antiquity.
units.literal: Zhi Yu held: "Ancient feudal lords ruled their states and treated paternal uncles as subjects; today's nobles are not the same as antiquity.

units.zh: 未同于古，則其尊未全，不宜便從絕期之制，而令傍親服斬衰之重也。
units.en: Because they are not the same as antiquity, their ritual supremacy is incomplete—it is not fitting to follow outright the rule that cuts qi while forcing collateral kin into zhan-cui.
units.literal: Because they are not the same as antiquity, their ritual supremacy is incomplete—it is not fitting to follow outright the rule that cuts qi while forcing collateral kin into zhan-cui.

units.zh: 諸侯既然，則公孤之爵亦宜如舊。
units.en: Feudal lords being so, duke-and-guardian titles should likewise follow the old pattern.
units.literal: Feudal lords being so, duke-and-guardian titles should likewise follow the old pattern.

units.zh: 昔魏武帝建安中已曾表上，漢朝依古為制，事與古異，皆不施行，施行者著在魏科。
units.en: Wei Emperor Wu in the Jian'an era already memorialized for Han to legislate by antiquity; because affairs differed from antiquity, nothing was enacted, while what was enacted appears in Wei code.
units.literal: Wei Emperor Wu in the Jian'an era already memorialized for Han to legislate by antiquity; because affairs differed from antiquity, nothing was enacted, while what was enacted appears in Wei code.

units.zh: 大晉采以著令，宜定新禮皆如舊。」
units.en: Great Jin adopted those entries into promulgated law—the New Rites ought everywhere to match the old statute."
units.literal: Great Jin adopted those entries into promulgated law—the New Rites ought everywhere to match the old statute."

units.zh: 詔從之。
units.en: The rescript accepted Zhi Yu.
units.literal: The edict followed this."

units.zh: 《喪服》無弟子為師服之制，新禮弟子為師齊衰三月。
units.en: The revision added three months of qi-cui for masters.
units.literal: Mourning Garments contains no rule for disciples mourning teachers; the New Rites prescribe qi-cui three months for a teacher.

units.zh: 摯虞以為：「自古無師服之制，故仲尼之喪，門人疑于所服。
units.en: Zhi Yu held: "From antiquity there was no teacher-mourning code—therefore at Confucius's death disciples were unsure what to wear.
units.literal: Zhi Yu held: "From antiquity there was no teacher-mourning code—therefore at Confucius's death disciples were unsure what to wear.

units.zh: 子貢曰：『昔夫子之喪顏回，若喪子而無服，請喪夫子若喪父而無服。』
units.en: Zigong said: 'When the Master mourned Yan Hui, it was like mourning a son but without mourning garments; I ask to mourn the Master like mourning a father but without mourning garments.'"
units.literal: Zigong said: 'When the Master mourned Yan Hui, it was like mourning a son but without mourning garments; I ask to mourn the Master like mourning a father but without mourning garments.'"

units.zh: 遂心喪三年。
units.en: Thereupon they observed heart mourning three years.
units.literal: Thereupon they observed heart mourning three years.

units.zh: 此則懷三年之哀，而無齊衰之制也。
units.en: That harbors three years of grief yet lacks a qi-cui regulation.
units.literal: That harbors three years of grief yet lacks a qi-cui regulation.

units.zh: 群居，入則絰，出則否，所謂弔服加麻也。
units.en: When assembled they wore zhui ties indoors but not outdoors—what is called adding hemp to condolence dress.
units.literal: When assembled they wore zhui ties indoors but not outdoors—what is called adding hemp to condolence dress.

units.zh: 先聖為禮，必易從而可傳。
units.en: Former sages made ritual easy to follow and possible to transmit.
units.literal: Former sages made ritual easy to follow and possible to transmit.

units.zh: 師徒義誠重，而服制不著，歷代相襲，不以為缺。
units.en: Teacher-disciple duty is weighty, yet garment rules were never written down—later ages followed one another and did not treat that as a defect.
units.literal: Teacher-disciple duty is weighty, yet garment rules were never written down—later ages followed one another and did not treat that as a defect.

units.zh: 且尋師者以彌高為得，故屢遷而不嫌；
units.en: Moreover those who seek teachers take 'ever higher' as their gain—therefore they change masters repeatedly without scruple;
units.literal: Moreover those who seek teachers take 'ever higher' as their gain—therefore they change masters repeatedly without scruple;

units.zh: 修業者以日新為益，故舍舊而不疑。
units.en: those who pursue learning take 'daily renewal' as profit—therefore they cast aside the old without hesitation.
units.literal: those who pursue learning take 'daily renewal' as profit—therefore they cast aside the old without hesitation.

units.zh: 仲尼稱『三人行，必有我師焉』。
units.en: Zhongni said, 'In a party of three walking, there must be my teacher among them.'"
units.literal: Zhongni said, 'In a party of three walking, there must be my teacher among them.'"

units.zh: 子貢云，『夫何常師之有』。
units.en: Zigong said, 'What constant teacher is there?'"
units.literal: Zigong said, 'What constant teacher is there?'"

units.zh: 淺學之師，暫學之師，不可皆為之服。
units.en: Shallow teachers and brief teachers cannot all receive mourning.
units.literal: Shallow teachers and brief teachers cannot all receive mourning.

units.zh: 義有輕重，服有廢興，則臧否由之而起，是非因之而爭，愛惡相攻，悔吝生焉。
units.en: When rightness has light and heavy and garments wax and wane, praise and blame arise, yes and no contend, love and hate clash, and regret is born.
units.literal: When rightness has light and heavy and garments wax and wane, praise and blame arise, yes and no contend, love and hate clash, and regret is born.

units.zh: 宜定新禮無服如舊。」
units.en: The New Rites should leave teacher mourning absent, as in antiquity."
units.literal: The New Rites should leave teacher mourning absent, as in antiquity."

units.zh: 詔從之。
units.en: The court agreed.
units.literal: The edict followed this."

units.zh: 古者天子諸侯葬禮粗備，漢世又多變革，魏晉以下世有改變，大體同漢之制。
units.en: In antiquity, the burial rites of Sons of Heaven and feudal lords were roughly complete. In the Han age there were again many changes, and from Wei and Jin downward each generation had alterations, but in broad outline they followed the Han system.
units.literal: In antiquity, the burial rites of Sons of Heaven and feudal lords were roughly complete. In the Han age there were again many changes, and from Wei and Jin downward each generation had alterations, but in broad outline they followed the Han system.

units.zh: 而魏武以禮送終之制，襲稱之數，繁而無益，俗又過之，豫自制送終衣服四篋，題識其上，春秋冬夏，日有不諱，隨時以斂。
units.en: Cao Cao loathed wasteful obsequies and packed four seasonal shrouds against an unlucky day.
units.literal: Yet Wei Wu held that the rites of sending off the dead and tallies of condolence gifts were excessive without benefit; vulgar practice exceeded them still—so he prepared in advance four chests of burial clothes, labeled for spring, summer, autumn, and winter, to be donned according to whichever season death came.

units.zh: 金珥珠玉銅鐵之物，一不得送。
units.en: He banned metal and gems from the pit.
units.literal: Gold, pearls, jade, copper, and iron were forbidden grave goods altogether.

units.zh: 文帝遵奉，無所增加。
units.en: Cao Pi kept his father's frugal will.
units.literal: Emperor Wen followed this and added nothing.

units.zh: 及受禪，刻金璽，追加尊號，不敢開埏，乃為石室，藏璽埏首，以示陵中無金銀諸物也。
units.en: Cao Pi sealed a gold seal in a stone niche to prove the mound stayed bare of treasure.
units.literal: When accepting abdication he carved a gold seal and added honor titles yet dared not open the tunnel—so he built a stone chamber at the passage mouth to store the seal, showing the tomb held no gold or silver.

units.zh: 漢禮明器甚多，自是皆省之矣。
units.en: Opulent Han figurines gave way to leaner Wei practice.
units.literal: Han burials had been rich in mingqi grave goods—from this point onward all were reduced.

units.zh: 魏文帝黃初三年，又自作終制曰：「禮，國君即位為椑，存不忘亡也。
units.en: In the third year of Huangchu under Emperor Wen of Wei, he also personally composed final regulations, saying, "According to ritual, when a ruler of a state takes the throne, he prepares an outer coffin; while alive, he does not forget death.
units.literal: In the third year of Huangchu under Emperor Wen of Wei, he also personally composed final regulations, saying, "According to ritual, when a ruler of a state takes the throne, he prepares an outer coffin; while alive, he does not forget death.

units.zh: 壽陵因山為體，無封樹，無立寢殿，造園邑，通神道。
units.en: His Shou mausoleum follows the mountain's contour—no mound, no trees, no resting hall, no park district, no spirit road opened.
units.literal: His Shou mausoleum follows the mountain's contour—no mound, no trees, no resting hall, no park district, no spirit road opened.

units.zh: 夫葬者藏也，欲人之不得見也。
units.en: Burial means hiding—wishing men not to see.
units.literal: Burial means hiding—wishing men not to see.

units.zh: 禮不墓祭，欲存亡不黷也。
units.en: Ritual forbids sacrifice at the grave—wishing the living and dead not to profane one another.
units.literal: Ritual forbids sacrifice at the grave—wishing the living and dead not to profane one another.

units.zh: 皇后及貴人以下不隨王之國者，有終沒，皆葬澗西，前又已表其處矣。」
units.en: Empresses and honored ladies who do not follow the prince to his fief and who die in the end are all buried west of the Jian River; I have already marked the ground."
units.literal: Empresses and honored ladies who do not follow the prince to his fief and who die in the end are all buried west of the Jian River; I have already marked the ground."

units.zh: 此詔藏之宗廟，副在尚書、秘書、三府。
units.en: Copies of the will rested in the temple and chief ministries.
units.literal: This edict was deposited in the ancestral temple; copies went to the Masters of Writing, Palace Library, and the Three Offices."

units.zh: 明帝亦遵奉之。
units.en: Cao Rui obeyed the same will.
units.literal: Ming-di likewise followed it.

units.zh: 明帝性雖崇奢，然未遽營陵墓之制也。
units.en: Even the lavish Cao Rui held back on tomb scale.
units.literal: Though Ming-di's nature inclined to luxury, he still did not rush to build an extravagant mausoleum system.

units.zh: 宣帝豫自于首陽山為土藏，不填不樹，作《顧命終制》，斂以時服，不設明器。
units.en: Sima Yi dug a plain shaft on Shouyang, left the hill unmarked, and left written orders for everyday clothes and no grave goods.
units.literal: Emperor Xuan in advance prepared an earthen burial chamber on Mount Shouyang—no mound, no trees—and composed the 'Charge at Gu' end testament: shroud in seasonal clothes only, with no ming vessels.

units.zh: 景、文皆謹奉成命，無所加焉。
units.en: Sima Shi and Sima Zhao kept Sima Yi's austere burial instructions to the letter.
units.literal: Emperor Jing and Emperor Wen both scrupulously obeyed the completed testament and added nothing to it.

units.zh: 景帝崩，喪事制度又依宣帝故事。
units.en: Sima Shi's obsequies copied Sima Yi's lean model.
units.literal: When Emperor Jing died, the funeral regulations again followed Emperor Xuan's precedent.

units.zh: 武帝泰始四年，文明王皇后崩，將合葬，開崇陽陵，使太尉司馬望奉祭，進皇帝密璽綬于便房神坐。
units.en: In the fourth year of Taishi under Emperor Wu, when Empress Wenming Wang died and was about to be jointly buried, Chongyang Mausoleum was opened, Grand Commandant Sima Wang was sent to present sacrifice, and the emperor's sealed jade seal and cords were advanced to the spirit seat in the side chamber.
units.literal: In the fourth year of Taishi under Emperor Wu, when Empress Wenming Wang died and was about to be jointly buried, Chongyang Mausoleum was opened, Grand Commandant Sima Wang was sent to present sacrifice, and the emperor's sealed jade seal and cords were advanced to the spirit seat in the side chamber.

units.zh: 魏氏金璽，此又儉矣。
units.en: Even the golden seal bespoke restraint.
units.literal: Wei's gold seal—another mark of frugality.

units.zh: 江左初，元、明崇儉，且百度草創，山陵奉終，省約備矣。
units.en: When the court fled across the Yangzi, Sima Rui and Sima Shao kept burials modest while institutions were new.
units.literal: Early in the southward court, Emperors Yuan and Ming prized simplicity; the hundred offices were still being founded, so imperial tombs stayed spare yet adequate.

units.zh: 成帝咸康七年，皇后杜氏崩。
units.en: Empress Du of Cheng passed in 341.
units.literal: In the seventh Xiankang year of Emperor Cheng, Empress Du died.

units.zh: 詔外官五日一入臨，內官旦一入而已，過葬虞祭禮畢止。
units.en: Courtiers could wail only on that thin schedule until the post-burial service closed mourning.
units.literal: An edict ordered outer officials to enter condolence only once every five days and inner staff once at dawn, ending once burial and the Yu rite were finished.

units.zh: 有司奏，大行皇后陵所作凶門柏歷門，號顯陽端門。
units.en: The ministry wanted a formal death-gate and cypress lintel named like a palace portal.
units.literal: The offices proposed building a funeral gate and cypress "calendar" portal for the late empress's mound, to be named the Xianyang gate.

units.zh: 詔曰：「門如所處。
units.en: The edict read: "Let the gate stand where proposed.
units.literal: The edict read: "Let the gate stand where proposed.

units.zh: 凶門柏歷，大為煩費，停之。」
units.en: Funeral gates and cypress calendars are extravagantly costly—suspend them."
units.literal: Funeral gates and cypress calendars are extravagantly costly—suspend them."

units.zh: 案蔡謨說，以二瓦器盛始死之祭，繫於木，裹以葦席，置庭中，近南，名為重，今之凶門是其象也。
