units.en: Cai Mo traced the "death gate" to the temporary chong bundle hung south of the yard.
units.literal: Cai Mo explains that two earthen jars holding the first-death offerings were lashed to a frame, wrapped in reed matting, and set in the courtyard toward the south as a chong; today's funeral gate imitates that form.

units.zh: 禮，既虞而作主，今未葬，未有主，故以重當之。
units.en: Until the tablet existed, the chong served as the spirit's lodging.
units.literal: By ritual one fashions the spirit tablet after the Yu rite; before burial there is no tablet, so the chong stands in for it.

units.zh: 禮稱為主道，此其義也。
units.en: Classical glosses treat the chong as the spirit's interim path.
units.literal: The canon calls this the "lord-of-the-spirit path"—that is the idea.

units.zh: 范堅又曰：「凶門非禮，禮有懸重，形似凶門。
units.en: Fan Jian adds: "The funeral gate is not canonical; ritual only suspends a chong that merely resembles a gate.
units.literal: Fan Jian adds: "The funeral gate is not canonical; ritual only suspends a chong that merely resembles a gate.

units.zh: 後人出之門外以表喪，俗遂行之。
units.en: Later generations moved it outside the gate to advertise mourning, and vulgar custom adopted it.
units.literal: Later generations moved it outside the gate to advertise mourning, and vulgar custom adopted it.

units.zh: 薄帳，即古弔幕之類也。」
units.en: Thin curtains belong to the ancient class of mourning screens."
units.literal: Thin curtains belong to the ancient class of mourning screens."

units.zh: 是時，又詔曰：「重壤之下，豈宜崇飾無用，陵中唯潔掃而已。」
units.en: Another edict then declared: "Beneath double layers of earth one should not lavish useless ornament; only sweep the vault clean."
units.literal: Another edict then declared: "Beneath double layers of earth one should not lavish useless ornament; only sweep the vault clean."

units.zh: 有司又奏，依舊選公卿以下六品子弟六十人為挽郎，詔又停之。
units.en: Officials wanted sixty noble sons as rope-pullers; the throne again said no.
units.literal: The offices again asked to conscript sixty youths of sixth rank and below as catafalque pullers, as of old; the edict again refused.

units.zh: 孝武帝太元四年九月，皇后王氏崩。
units.en: In the ninth month of the fourth year of Taiyuan under Emperor Xiaowu, Empress Wang died.
units.literal: In the ninth month of the fourth year of Taiyuan under Emperor Xiaowu, Empress Wang died.

units.zh: 詔曰：「終事唯從儉速。」
units.en: An edict said: "Finish everything frugally and quickly."
units.literal: An edict said: "Finish everything frugally and quickly."

units.zh: 又詔：「遠近不得遣山陵使。」
units.en: Another edict said, “Neither near nor distant officials may send envoys to the imperial tombs.”
units.literal: Another edict said, “Neither near nor distant officials may send envoys to the imperial tombs.”

units.zh: 有司奏選挽郎二十四人，詔停之。
units.en: Even twenty-four rope-boys were denied.
units.literal: When the ministry asked for twenty-four pullers, the edict stopped that as well.

units.zh: 古無墓祭之禮。
units.en: The classics never sanctioned grave-side worship.
units.literal: Antiquity knew no sacrifices at the tomb itself.

units.zh: 漢承秦，皆有園寢。
units.en: Han kept Qin's tomb parks and resting halls.
units.literal: Han continued Qin and maintained park-like resting shrines at every imperial mound.

units.zh: 正月上丁，祠南郊禮畢，次北郊、明堂、高廟、世祖廟，謂之五供。
units.en: The capital's spring round moved from the southern altar through the northern rites in fixed order.
units.literal: On the upper ding day of the first month, after the southern suburban sacrifice, the court in sequence offered at the northern suburb, the Bright Hall, the High Temple, and Emperor Shizu's shrine—the so-called five offerings.

units.zh: 魏武葬高陵，有司依漢立陵上祭殿。
units.en: Wei still raised a tomb-shrine over Gaoling, aping Han.
units.literal: Cao Cao was buried at Gaoling; the ministry, following Han, built a sacrificial hall atop the tumulus.

units.zh: 至文帝黃初三年，乃詔曰：「先帝躬履節儉，遺詔省約。
units.en: In the third year of Huangchu under Emperor Wen, he then issued an edict, saying, "The late emperor personally practiced frugality, and his final edict was sparing and restrained.
units.literal: In the third year of Huangchu under Emperor Wen, he then issued an edict, saying, "The late emperor personally practiced frugality, and his final edict was sparing and restrained.

units.zh: 子以述父為孝，臣以繫事為忠。
units.en: The son expresses filial piety by carrying out the father's words; the minister shows loyalty by continuing his tasks.
units.literal: The son expresses filial piety by carrying out the father's words; the minister shows loyalty by continuing his tasks.

units.zh: 古不墓祭，皆設於廟。
units.en: The ancients never sacrificed at graves—everything was set in the ancestral temple.
units.literal: The ancients never sacrificed at graves—everything was set in the ancestral temple.

units.zh: 高陵上殿皆毀壞，車馬還廄，衣服藏府，以從先帝儉德之志。」
units.en: Destroy the upper halls at Gaoling; return carriages and horses to the stables and store garments in the treasury, to match the late emperor's wish for thrift."
units.literal: Destroy the upper halls at Gaoling; return carriages and horses to the stables and store garments in the treasury, to match the late emperor's wish for thrift."

units.zh: 文帝自作終制，又曰「壽陵無立寢殿，造園邑」，自後園邑寢殿遂絕。
units.en: Emperor Wen personally made his final regulations and further said, “At Shouling do not establish a resting hall or build a tomb settlement”; from then on tomb settlements and resting halls ceased.
units.literal: Emperor Wen personally made his final regulations and further said, “At Shouling do not establish a resting hall or build a tomb settlement”; from then on tomb settlements and resting halls ceased.

units.zh: 齊王在位九年，始一謁高平陵而曹爽誅，其後遂廢，終於魏世。
units.en: Cao Fang's single visit to Gaoling ended with Cao Shuang's purge, and Wei rulers stopped touring tombs.
units.literal: The prince of Qi reigned nine years before he once visited Gaoling; after Cao Shuang's execution the practice was abandoned for the rest of Wei.

units.zh: 及宣帝，遺詔「子弟群官皆不得謁陵」。
units.en: Emperor Xuan's testament commanded that "sons, younger kin, and all officials must not visit the imperial tombs."
units.literal: Emperor Xuan's testament commanded that "sons, younger kin, and all officials must not visit the imperial tombs."

units.zh: 於是景、文遵旨。
units.en: Sima Shi and Sima Zhao complied.
units.literal: Jing and Wen obeyed that order.

units.zh: 至武帝，猶再謁崇陽陵，一謁峻平陵，然遂不敢謁高原陵，至惠帝復止也。
units.en: Sima Yan still visited the Chongyang mausoleum twice and the Junping mausoleum once, yet never dared visit the Gaoyuan mausoleum; under Hui the visits stopped again.
units.literal: Emperor Wu still visited Chongyang twice and Junping once, yet never dared approach Gaoling; under Emperor Hui the custom lapsed again.

units.zh: 逮于江左，元帝崩後，諸公始有謁陵辭告之事。
units.en: Eastern Jin nobles only began tomb pilgrimages after Sima Rui's death.
units.literal: After the move south of the Yangzi, not until Emperor Yuan died did high nobles begin visiting mausoleums to announce their leave-takings.

units.zh: 蓋由眷同友執，率情而舉，非洛京之舊也。
units.en: The practice sprang from camaraderie's impulse, not old capital law.
units.literal: They acted from private friendship among peers, not from Luoyang precedent.

units.zh: 成帝時，中宮亦年年拜陵，議者以為非禮，於是遂止，以為永制。
units.en: Cheng's harem stopped annual tomb trips once ritualists objected.
units.literal: Under Emperor Cheng the inner palace yearly visited tombs until critics called it uncanonical; the court then banned it permanently.

units.zh: 至穆帝時，褚太后臨朝，又拜陵，帝幼故也。
units.en: Mu's regent mother revived the visits while the sovereign was a child.
units.literal: Under Emperor Mu, Empress Dowager Chu regent, tombs were visited again because the boy emperor was young.

units.zh: 至孝武崩，驃騎將軍司馬道子曰：「今雖權制釋服，至於朔望諸節，自應展情陵所，以一周為斷。」
units.en: After Xiaowu died, Sima Daozi said: "Though we have shortened mourning by expedient rule, on new and full moons and festivals we should still show feeling at the tomb—take one round as the limit."
units.literal: After Xiaowu died, Sima Daozi said: "Though we have shortened mourning by expedient rule, on new and full moons and festivals we should still show feeling at the tomb—take one round as the limit."

units.zh: 於是至陵，變服單衣，煩黷無準，非禮意也。
units.en: The result was slovenly dress and chaotic etiquette at every visit.
units.literal: Thereupon courtiers went to the tombs in thin single garments—endless fuss with no standard, contrary to ritual intent.

units.zh: 及安帝元興元年，尚書左僕射桓謙奏：「百僚拜陵，起于中興，非晉舊典，積習生常，遂為近法。
units.en: In the first year of Yuanxing under Emperor An, Huan Qian, Left Vice Director of the Secretariat, memorialized, "The hundred officials paying respects at the mausoleum began with the Restoration and was not an old Jin statute. Accumulated practice produced a norm, and it consequently became a recent rule.
units.literal: In the first year of Yuanxing under Emperor An, Huan Qian, Left Vice Director of the Secretariat, memorialized, "The hundred officials paying respects at the mausoleum began with the Restoration and was not an old Jin statute. Accumulated practice produced a norm, and it consequently became a recent rule.

units.zh: 尋武皇帝詔，乃不使人主諸王拜陵，豈唯百僚！
units.en: Consider Emperor Wu's edict: he forbade even the sovereign and princes from tomb visits—let alone mere officials!
units.literal: Review Emperor Wu's edict: he forbade even the sovereign and princes from tomb visits—let alone mere officials!

units.zh: 謂宜遵奉。」
units.en: We ought to obey that precedent."
units.literal: We ought to obey that precedent."

units.zh: 於是施行。
units.en: The ban took effect.
units.literal: The measure was implemented.

units.zh: 及義熙初，又復江左之舊，
units.en: Yixi reopened tomb pilgrimages for a time.
units.literal: Early in the Yixi era the southern custom briefly returned.

units.zh: 太康七年，大鴻臚鄭默母喪，既葬，當依舊攝職，固陳不起，於是始制大臣得終喪三年。
units.en: In the seventh year of Taikang, Zheng Mo's refusal to leave mourning forced Jin to grant grandees full three-year leave.
units.literal: In the seventh year of Taikang, [The narrative continues:] When Chief Herald Zheng Mo's mother died, he should by precedent have returned to duty after burial, but he refused to rise; then the court first allowed great ministers to complete three years of mourning.

units.zh: 然元康中，陳準、傅咸之徒，猶以權奪，不得終禮，自茲已往，以為成比也，
units.en: Even after the rule, Yuankang ministers were "urged" back early, and the exception became norm.
units.literal: Yet during Yuankang, Chen Zhun, Fu Xian, and others were still pressed by state business and could not finish ritual; thereafter that became the precedent.

units.zh: 東平王楙上言，相王昌父毖，本居長沙，有妻息，漢末使入中國，值吳叛，仕魏為黃門郎，與前妻息死生隔絕，更娶昌母。
units.en: Sima Mao introduced Wang Bi: a Changsha household cut off by war who remarried in Wei and fathered Wang Chang.
units.literal: [The narrative continues:] Prince Mao of Dongping reported: Chancellor Wang Chang's father Wang Bi had lived in Changsha with wife and children; late Han sent him inland, he met Wu's rebellion, served Wei as a Yellow Gate gentleman, and lost contact with his first family, then married Chang's mother.

units.zh: 今江表一統，昌聞前母久喪，言疾求平議。
units.en: With the south pacified, Wang Chang asked how to mourn a first wife presumed dead for decades.
units.literal: Now that the lands south of the Yangzi are reunited, Wang Chang, learning that his first wife died long ago, pleads illness and seeks a neutral court ruling.

units.zh: 守博士謝衡議曰：「雖有二妻，蓋有故而然，不為害於道，議宜更相為服。」
units.en: Acting erudite Xie Heng argued: "Though there were two wives, there was good cause; it does not harm the Way—they should wear mutual mourning."
units.literal: Acting erudite Xie Heng argued: "Though there were two wives, there was good cause; it does not harm the Way—they should wear mutual mourning."

units.zh: 守博士許猛以為「地絕，又無前母之制，正以在前非沒則絕故也。
units.en: Acting erudite Xu Meng held: "Land cut-off means there is no rite for a former wife—the prior bond ends because she was not dead yet was severed.
units.literal: Acting erudite Xu Meng held: "Land cut-off means there is no rite for a former wife—the prior bond ends because she was not dead yet was severed.

units.zh: 前母雖在，猶不應服。」
units.en: Even if the first wife still lived, Chang should not wear mourning for her."
units.literal: Even if the first wife still lived, Chang should not wear mourning for her."

units.zh: 段暢、秦秀、騶沖從猛。
units.en: A bloc followed Xu Meng.
units.literal: Duan Chang, Qin Xiu, and Zou Chong sided with Xu Meng.

units.zh: 散騎常侍劉智安議：「禮為常事制，不為非常設也。
units.en: Cavalier attendant Liu Zhi'an said: "Ritual governs the normal, not the extreme; the canon does not list parents whose fate is unknown.
units.literal: Cavalier attendant Liu Zhi'an said: "Ritual governs the normal, not the extreme; the canon does not list parents whose fate is unknown.

units.zh: 亡父母不知其死生者，不著於禮。
units.en: For parents whose death is unknown, the classics set down no mourning rule.
units.literal: For parents whose death is unknown, the classics set down no mourning rule.

units.zh: 平生不相見，去其加隆，以期為斷。」
units.en: If they never met in life, drop the heaviest grades and stop at the one-year term."
units.literal: If they never met in life, drop the heaviest grades and stop at the one-year term."

units.zh: 都令史虞溥議曰：「臣以為禮不二嫡，所以重正，非徒如前議者防妒忌而已。
units.en: Capital clerk Yu Pu said: "Ritual forbids two principal wives to secure orthodoxy—not merely to prevent jealousy.
units.literal: Capital clerk Yu Pu said: "Ritual forbids two principal wives to secure orthodoxy—not merely to prevent jealousy.

units.zh: 故曰『一與之齊，終身不改』，未有遭變而二嫡。
units.en: Hence the line 'once pledged together for life, never to change'—there is no provision for two lawful consorts after upheaval."
units.literal: Hence the line 'once pledged together for life, never to change'—there is no provision for two lawful consorts after upheaval."

units.zh: 苟不二，則昌父更娶之辰，是前妻義絕之日也。
units.en: If bigamy is forbidden, the day Bi remarried was the day his first wife's tie ended in law.
units.literal: If bigamy is forbidden, the day Bi remarried was the day his first wife's tie ended in law.

units.zh: 使昌父尚存，二妻俱在，必不使二嫡專堂，兩婦執祭，同為之齊也。」
units.en: Had Bi lived with both wives present, the law would never let two matrons share the hall or both lead sacrifice as equals."
units.literal: Had Bi lived with both wives present, the law would never let two matrons share the hall or both lead sacrifice as equals."

units.zh: 秦秀議：「二妾之子，父命令相慈養，而便有三年之恩，便同所生。
units.en: Qin Xiu argued: "When a father orders concubines' sons to foster one another, three years of grace appear—yet that equals birth only by decree.
units.literal: Qin Xiu argued: "When a father orders concubines' sons to foster one another, three years of grace appear—yet that equals birth only by decree.

units.zh: 昌父何義不命二嫡依此禮乎！
units.en: Why should Bi not order two principals to follow the same rule if that is so righteous!
units.literal: Why should Bi not order two principals to follow the same rule if that is so righteous!

units.zh: 父之執友有如子之禮，況事兄之母乎！」
units.en: A father's sworn friend receives almost filial rites—how much more a brother's mother!"
units.literal: A father's sworn friend receives almost filial rites—how much more a brother's mother!"

units.zh: 許猛又議：「夫少婦稚，則不可許以改娶更適矣。
units.en: Xu Meng rejoined: "You cannot let a young wife and infant be cast off for remarriage elsewhere.
units.literal: Xu Meng rejoined: "You cannot let a young wife and infant be cast off for remarriage elsewhere.

units.zh: 今妻在許以更聘，夫存而妻得改醮者，非絕而何。」
units.en: If a living husband may take another match while the wife remains, that is nothing but severance."
units.literal: If a living husband may take another match while the wife remains, that is nothing but severance."

units.zh: 侍中領博士張惲議：「昔舜不告而娶，婚禮蓋闕，故《堯典》以釐降二女為文，不殊嫡媵。
units.en: Attendant and Erudites Director Zhang Yun proposed: “Formerly Shun married without announcing it, so the marriage rite was probably lacking; therefore the Canon of Yao speaks of the two daughters being sent down in marriage and does not distinguish principal wife from secondary wife.
units.literal: Attendant and Erudites Director Zhang Yun proposed: “Formerly Shun married without announcing it, so the marriage rite was probably lacking; therefore the Canon of Yao speaks of the two daughters being sent down in marriage and does not distinguish principal wife from secondary wife.

units.zh: 傳記以妃夫人稱之，明不立正后也。
units.en: Later texts call them consorts and ladies, showing no principal empress was installed.
units.literal: Later texts call them consorts and ladies, showing no principal empress was installed.

units.zh: 夫以聖人之弘，帝者嫡子，猶權事而變，以定典禮。
units.en: Even sages and imperial heirs adjusted ritual to circumstance to fix the code.
units.literal: Even sages and imperial heirs adjusted ritual to circumstance to fix the code.

units.zh: 黃昌之告新妻使避正室，時論許之。
units.en: Huang Chang ordering his new wife to vacate the main chamber was praised in his day.
units.literal: Huang Chang ordering his new wife to vacate the main chamber was praised in his day.

units.zh: 推姬氏之讓，執黃卿之決，宜使各自服其母。」
units.en: Extrapolating from the Ji woman’s deference and upholding Huang Qing’s decision, each should mourn his own mother.”
units.literal: Extrapolating from the Ji woman’s deference and upholding Huang Qing’s decision, each should mourn his own mother.”

units.zh: 黃門侍郎崔諒、荀悝、中書監荀勖、領中書令和嶠、侍郎夏侯湛皆如溥議。
units.en: A majority backed Yu Pu's bigamy reading.
units.literal: Cui Liang, Xun Kui, Xun Xu, He Qiao, and Xia Hou Zhan concurred with Yu Pu.

units.zh: 侍郎山雄、兼侍郎著作陳壽以為：「溥駁一與之齊，非大夫也，禮無二嫡，不可以並耳。
units.en: Shan Xiong and Chen Shou replied that Yu Pu misread "once pledged"—the rule forbids two principals at once, not sequential marriages.
units.literal: Shan Xiong and Chen Shou replied that Yu Pu misread "once pledged"—the rule forbids two principals at once, not sequential marriages.

units.zh: 若昌父及二母於今各存者，則前母不廢，已有明徵也。
units.en: If Bi and both mothers were alive today, the first wife would not be dismissed—that is already clear proof.
units.literal: If Bi and both mothers were alive today, the first wife would not be dismissed—that is already clear proof.

units.zh: 設令昌父將前母之子來入中國尚在者，當從出母之服。
units.en: Were Bi to bring the first wife's son inland while she lived, the son would follow "divorced mother" mourning.
units.literal: Were Bi to bring the first wife's son inland while she lived, the son would follow "divorced mother" mourning.

units.zh: 苟昌父無棄前妻之命，昌兄有服母之理，則昌無疑於不服。」
units.en: If Bi never repudiated the first wife and the elder brother owes a mother's mourning, Wang Chang need not doubt that he wears none."
units.literal: If Bi never repudiated the first wife and the elder brother owes a mother's mourning, Wang Chang need not doubt that he wears none."

units.zh: 賊曹屬卞粹議：「昌父當莫審之時而娶後妻，則前妻同之于死而義不絕。
units.en: Bian Cui of the thieves section argued: "Bi wed his second wife in ignorance of the first's fate, so the first wife is as if dead yet the bond is not morally cut.
units.literal: Bian Cui of the thieves section argued: "Bi wed his second wife in ignorance of the first's fate, so the first wife is as if dead yet the bond is not morally cut.

units.zh: 若生相及而後妻不去，則妾列於前志矣。
units.en: If both lived and the second did not leave, she ranked as concubine in earlier law.
units.literal: If both lived and the second did not leave, she ranked as concubine in earlier law.

units.zh: 死而會乎，則同祔於葬，無並嫡之實。
units.en: If they died and were buried together, joint burial annexes her without making two principals.
units.literal: If they died and were buried together, joint burial annexes her without making two principals.

units.zh: 必欲使子孫於沒世之後，追計二母隔絕之時，以為並嫡，則背違死父，追出亡母。
units.en: Forcing later generations to call both principals after decades apart would betray the dead father and expel the vanished mother.
units.literal: Forcing later generations to call both principals after decades apart would betray the dead father and expel the vanished mother.

units.zh: 議者以為禮無前母之服者，可謂以文害意。
units.en: Critics who say ritual lacks a former-wife garment harm the meaning with dry text.
units.literal: Critics who say ritual lacks a former-wife garment harm the meaning with dry text.

units.zh: 愚以為母之不親而服三年，非一無異於前母也。
units.en: In my humble view, wearing three years for a distant mother is not the same as none for a prior wife.
units.literal: In my humble view, wearing three years for a distant mother is not the same as none for a prior wife.

units.zh: 倉曹屬衛恆議：「或云，嫡不可二，前妻宜絕。
units.en: Wei Heng of the granary section said: "Some say two principals cannot stand—the first must be cut off.
units.literal: Wei Heng of the granary section said: "Some say two principals cannot stand—the first must be cut off.

units.zh: 此為奪舊與新，違母從子，禮律所不許，人情所未安也。
units.en: That seizes the old for the new and makes the son annul his mother—ritual law and human feeling both forbid it.
units.literal: That seizes the old for the new and makes the son annul his mother—ritual law and human feeling both forbid it.

units.zh: 或云，絕與死同，無嫌二嫡，據其相及，欲令有服。
units.en: Others equate severance with death and allow two principals, then argue both alive to impose mourning—principal logic dies while garment logic lives, contradicting itself.
units.literal: Others equate severance with death and allow two principals, then argue both alive to impose mourning—principal logic dies while garment logic lives, contradicting itself.

units.zh: 此為論嫡則死，議服則生，還自相伐，理又不通。
units.en: Some argue that when debating principal rank she counts as dead, yet when discussing garments they treat her as alive—those positions undercut each other and cannot both stand.
units.literal: Some argue that when debating principal rank she counts as dead, yet when discussing garments they treat her as alive—those positions undercut each other and cannot both stand.

units.zh: 愚以為地絕死絕，誠無異也，宜一如前母，不復追服。」
units.en: I hold land-severance and death-severance are the same: treat her like a former wife and do not impose retroactive mourning."
units.literal: I hold land-severance and death-severance are the same: treat her like a former wife and do not impose retroactive mourning."

units.zh: 主簿劉卞議：「毖在南為邦族，於北為羈旅，以此名分言之，前妻為元妃，後婦為繼室。
units.en: Chief clerk Liu Bian said: "In the south Bi was a clansman, in the north a traveler—by that status the first wife was primary consort, the later a successor chamber.
units.literal: Chief clerk Liu Bian said: "In the south Bi was a clansman, in the north a traveler—by that status the first wife was primary consort, the later a successor chamber.

units.zh: 何至王路既通，更當逐其今妻，廢其嫡子！
units.en: How, once imperial roads reopened, could we expel the present wife and disinherit her son!
units.literal: How, once imperial roads reopened, could we expel the present wife and disinherit her son!

units.zh: 不書姜氏，絕不為親，以其犯至惡也。
units.en: The Spring and Autumn omits Jiang because severance means no kin—she committed supreme evil.
units.literal: The Spring and Autumn omits Jiang because severance means no kin—she committed supreme evil.

units.zh: 趙姬雖貴，必推叔隗；
units.en: Though Lady Zhao was honored, she insisted on yielding precedence to Shu Wei;
units.literal: Though Lady Zhao was honored, she yielded to Shu Ji; though Yuan Tong was favored, Xuan Meng stayed principal.

units.zh: 原同雖寵，必嫡宣孟。
units.en: though Yuan Tong was favored, she insisted on making Xuan Meng the principal heir.
units.literal: If we violate ritual for a specious compromise, how does that match what the Spring and Autumn praises!

units.zh: 若違禮苟讓，何則《春秋》所當善也！
units.en: If we violate ritual for a specious deference, how could the Spring and Autumn praise it!
units.literal: Debaters cite land cut-off to say feeling could never cross.

units.zh: 論者謂地絕，其情終已不得往來。
units.en: Debaters say the land was cut off, so feelings could never pass back and forth.
units.literal: Now the land is linked—why insist on severance!

units.zh: 今地既通，何為故當追而絕之邪！
units.en: Now that the land is open, why should we retroactively sever her!
units.literal: Huang Chang is praised as a recent parallel worth imitating.

units.zh: 黃昌見美，斯又近世之明比。」
units.en: Huang Chang was praised for this—a clear precedent from recent times."
units.literal: Minister of Works Prince of Qi Sima You cited the Record of Rites: "Those born too late to reach grandparents, paternal uncles, or elder brothers—when the father eases mourning, they do not"—the ru all explain that the father, for some other reason, bore the son in a distant land and did not return in time to see these kin alive; though the father may don eased mourning, the son does not follow the easing—not demanding favor out of season."

units.zh: 司空齊王攸議：「《禮記》『生不及祖父母、諸父昆弟，而父稅喪，己則否』，諸儒皆以為父以他故子生異域，不及此親存時歸見之，父雖追服，子不從稅，不責非時之恩也。
units.en: Sima You, Prince of Qi and Minister of Works, deliberated, "The Liji says, 'If while alive one did not meet grandparents, paternal uncles, or elder and younger brothers, and the father performs delayed mourning, the self does not.' The scholars all take this to mean that when, because of other circumstances, the father's son was born in a different region and did not return to see these relatives while they survived, even though the father later wears mourning, the son does not follow in delayed mourning; it does not demand grace outside the proper time."
units.literal: Sima You, Prince of Qi and Minister of Works, deliberated, "The Liji says, 'If while alive one did not meet grandparents, paternal uncles, or elder and younger brothers, and the father performs delayed mourning, the self does not.' The scholars all take this to mean that when, because of other circumstances, the father's son was born in a different region and did not return to see these relatives while they survived, even though the father later wears mourning, the son does not follow in delayed mourning; it does not demand grace outside the proper time."

units.zh: 但不相見，尚不服其先終，而況前母非親所生，義不逾祖，莫往莫來，恩絕殊隔，而令追服，殆非稱情立文之謂也。
units.en: If one never met them, one still does not mourn those who died earlier; how much less a former mother who did not bear him, whose claim does not exceed a grandparent's, with no coming or going and the bond cut off by distance. To order retroactive mourning hardly fits making rites that match feeling.
units.literal: He concluded that Wang Chang ought not pursue retroactive mourning.

units.zh: 以為昌不宜追服。」
units.en: He held that Wang Chang should not wear retroactive mourning."
units.literal: Minister of Education Li Yin argued: "When Bi served as Yellow Gate Gentleman, south of the Yangzi had already rebelled."

units.zh: 司徒李胤議：「毖為黃門侍郎，江南已叛。
units.en: Minister of Education Li Yin argued: "When Bi served as Yellow Gate Gentleman, the region south of the Yangzi had already rebelled.
units.literal: Shi Hou joined the plot—great righteousness may destroy kin—how much more under Bi's circumstances can she be treated as a lawful wife!

units.zh: 石厚與焉，大義滅親，況於毖之義，可得以為妻乎！」
units.en: Shi Hou joined the plot—great righteousness may destroy kin—how much more under Wang Bi's moral position can she be treated as a lawful wife!'
units.literal: Shi Hou joined the plot—great righteousness may destroy kin—how much more under Wang Bi's moral position can she be treated as a lawful wife!'

units.zh: 大司馬騫不議，太尉充、撫軍大將軍汝南王亮皆從主者。
units.en: Grand Marshal Sima Qian offered no opinion; Grand Commandant Jia Chong, Commander-in-chief General of the Guard the Prince of Runan, Liang, and others all followed the supervisor's recommendation.'
units.literal: Grand Marshal Sima Qian offered no opinion; Grand Commandant Jia Chong, Commander-in-chief General of the Guard the Prince of Runan, Liang, and others all followed the supervisor's recommendation.'

units.zh: 溥又駁粹曰：「喪從甯戚，謂喪事尚哀耳，不使服非其親也。
units.en: Yu Pu again refuted Bian Cui: "Mourning follows easing grief—it means funerals esteem sorrow, not that one wears mourning for someone who is not kin.
units.literal: Yu Pu again refuted Bian Cui: "Mourning follows easing grief—it means funerals esteem sorrow, not that one wears mourning for someone who is not kin.

units.zh: 夫死者終也，終事已故無絕道。
units.en: Death is the end; once the affair is finished there is no principle of endless tie.
units.literal: Death is the end; once the affair is finished there is no principle of endless tie.

units.zh: 分居兩存，則離否由人。
units.en: If the two households live apart and both survive, then separation or union lies in human choice.
units.literal: If the two households live apart and both survive, then separation or union lies in human choice.

units.zh: 夫婦以判合為義，今土隔人殊，則配合理絕。
units.en: Husband and wife join by ritual union; now earth divides them and persons differ—then the match is logically severed.
units.literal: Husband and wife join by ritual union; now earth divides them and persons differ—then the match is logically severed.

units.zh: 彼已更娶代己，安得自同於死婦哉！
units.en: The other party has remarried in her place—how can she equate herself with a dead wife!
units.literal: The other party has remarried in her place—how can she equate herself with a dead wife!

units.zh: 伯夷讓孤竹，不可以為後王法也。
units.en: Boyi yielding Guzhu cannot be taken as precedent for later kings.
units.literal: Boyi yielding Guzhu cannot be taken as precedent for later kings.

units.zh: 且既已為嫡後服，復云為妾，生則或貶或離，死則同祔于葬，妻專一以事夫，夫懷貳以接己，開偽薄之風，傷貞信之教，於以純化篤俗，不亦難乎！
units.en: Moreover, having already worn mourning as principal heir, to say one is still a concubine—alive she may be demoted or divorced, dead buried together—while the wife serves one husband faithfully and the husband keeps two hearts toward her—this opens hypocrisy, wounds faithful teaching, and makes pure custom hard indeed!
units.literal: Moreover, having already worn mourning as principal heir, to say one is still a concubine—alive she may be demoted or divorced, dead buried together—while the wife serves one husband faithfully and the husband keeps two hearts toward her—this opens hypocrisy, wounds faithful teaching, and makes pure custom hard indeed!

units.zh: 今昌二母雖土地殊隔，據同時並存，何得為前母后母乎！
units.en: Now Wang Chang's two mothers, though lands divide them, existed at the same time—how can you call one former and one later!
units.literal: Now Wang Chang's two mothers, though lands divide them, existed at the same time—how can you call one former and one later!

units.zh: 設使昌母先亡，以嫡合葬，而前母不絕，遠聞喪問，當復相為制何服邪！
units.en: Suppose Chang's mother died first and was buried as principal while the first wife's line never ended—news of mourning arrives from afar—what garment rule would then apply between them!
units.literal: Suppose Chang's mother died first and was buried as principal while the first wife's line never ended—news of mourning arrives from afar—what garment rule would then apply between them!

units.zh: 夫制不應禮，動而愈失。
units.en: Regulations that violate ritual move further from right the more they are used.
units.literal: Regulations that violate ritual move further from right the more they are used.

units.zh: 夫孝子不納親於不義，貞婦不昧進而苟容。
units.en: A filial son does not admit kin into unrighteousness; a chaste wife does not advance by conniving tolerance.
units.literal: A filial son does not admit kin into unrighteousness; a chaste wife does not advance by conniving tolerance.

units.zh: 今同前嫡於死婦，使後妻居正而或廢，於二子之心，曾無恧乎！
units.en: Now you equate the former principal with a dead woman while letting the later wife hold orthodox rank or be cast aside—could the two sons feel no shame!
units.literal: Now you equate the former principal with a dead woman while letting the later wife hold orthodox rank or be cast aside—could the two sons feel no shame!

units.zh: 而云誣父棄母，恐此文致之言，難以定臧否也。
units.en: To speak of slandering father and abandoning mother is probably prosecutorial language—hard to use it to judge guilt.
units.literal: To speak of slandering father and abandoning mother is probably prosecutorial language—hard to use it to judge guilt.

units.zh: 禮，違諸侯適天子，不服舊君，然則昌父絕前君矣，更納後室，廢舊妻矣，又何取於宜誅宜撫乎！
units.en: By ritual, when a feudal lord goes to the Son of Heaven he does not wear mourning for his old lord—then Wang Chang's father had already cut ties with his former prince, taken a new chamber, and dismissed the first wife—why cite cases fit for execution or clemency!
units.literal: By ritual, when a feudal lord goes to the Son of Heaven he does not wear mourning for his old lord—then Wang Bi's father had already cut ties with his former prince, taken a new chamber, and dismissed the first wife—why cite cases fit for execution or clemency!

units.zh: 且婦人之有惡疾，乃慈夫之所愍也，而在七出，誠以在人理應絕故也。
units.en: Moreover, when a wife has vile disease it is what a kind husband pities—yet it is listed among the seven expulsions because human principle demands severance.
units.literal: Moreover, when a wife has vile disease it is what a kind husband pities—yet it is listed among the seven expulsions because human principle demands severance.

units.zh: 今夫婦殊域，與無妻同，方之惡疾，理無以異。
units.en: Now husband and wife live in different realms—no different from having no wife—compared with vile disease there is no distinction in principle.
units.literal: Now husband and wife live in different realms—no different from having no wife—compared with vile disease there is no distinction in principle.

units.zh: 據己更娶，有絕前之證。
units.en: According to his own remarriage there is proof the first tie was cut.
units.literal: According to his own remarriage there is proof the first tie was cut.

units.zh: 而云應服，于義何居！」
units.en: Yet you say he should wear mourning—where is the rightness in that!"
units.literal: Yet you say he should wear mourning—where is the rightness in that!"

units.zh: 尚書八座以為「設令有人于此，父為敦煌太守，而子後任于洛，若父娶妻，非徒不見，乃可不知，及其死亡，不得不服。
units.en: The Eight Seats of the Masters of Writing held: "Suppose someone here whose father was governor of Dunhuang while the son later serves in Luoyang: if the father remarries, not only might the son never see her—he might not even know; when she dies he must still wear mourning.
units.literal: The Eight Seats of the Masters of Writing held: "Suppose someone here whose father was governor of Dunhuang while the son later serves in Luoyang: if the father remarries, not only might the son never see her—he might not even know; when she dies he must still wear mourning.

units.zh: 但鞠養已者情哀，而不相見名制，雖戚念之心殊，而為之服一也。
units.en: Yet toward the one who nursed him he feels grief, while toward the unseen stranger only name and ritual apply—though the stir of feeling differs, the garment grade is one.
units.literal: Yet toward the one who nursed him he feels grief, while toward the unseen stranger only name and ritual apply—though the stir of feeling differs, the garment grade is one.

units.zh: 又，兩后匹嫡，自謂違禮，不謂非常之事而以常禮處之也。
units.en: Moreover, two empresses ranking as principals was itself deemed contrary to ritual—not an extraordinary case to handle with everyday rubrics.
units.literal: Moreover, two empresses ranking as principals was itself deemed contrary to ritual—not an extraordinary case to handle with everyday rubrics.

units.zh: 昔子思哭出母於廟，其門人曰：『庶氏之女死，何為哭于孔氏之廟！』
units.en: Formerly Zisi wailed for his divorced mother inside the temple; his disciples said, 'When a daughter of the Shu line died, why wail in Kong's temple!'
units.literal: Formerly Zisi wailed for his divorced mother inside the temple; his disciples said, 'When a daughter of the Shu line died, why wail in Kong's temple!'

units.zh: 子思懼，改哭於他室。
units.en: Zisi feared and shifted his wailing to another chamber.
units.literal: Zisi feared and shifted his wailing to another chamber.

units.zh: 若昌不制服，不得不告其父祖，掘其前母之尸，徙之他地。
units.en: If Chang wears no mourning, he would have to tell his father and grandfather, exhume the first mother's corpse, and move it elsewhere.
units.literal: If Chang wears no mourning, he would have to tell his father and grandfather, exhume the first mother's corpse, and move it elsewhere.

units.zh: 若其不徙，昌為罪人。
units.en: If they do not move her, Chang becomes a criminal.
units.literal: If they do not move her, Chang becomes a criminal.

units.zh: 何則？
units.en: Why?
units.literal: Why?

units.zh: 異族之女不得祔于先姑，藏其墓次故也。
units.en: Because a woman of another clan may not be buried with a mother-in-law—that is why she cannot share the tomb row.
units.literal: Because a woman of another clan may not be buried with a mother-in-law—that is why she cannot share the tomb row.

units.zh: 且夫婦人牽夫，猶有所尊，趙姬之舉，禮得權通，故先史詳之，不譏其事耳。
units.en: Moreover, a wife follows her husband yet still has superiors to honor—Lady Zhao's promotion was a sanctioned expedient, which is why earlier historians recorded it without blame.
units.literal: Moreover, a wife follows her husband yet still has superiors to honor—Lady Zhao's promotion was a sanctioned expedient, which is why earlier historians recorded it without blame.

units.zh: 今昌之二母，各已終亡，尚無並主輕重之事也。
units.en: Now Chang's two mothers are both dead—there is no longer a question of two living principals.
units.literal: Now Chang's two mothers are both dead—there is no longer a question of two living principals.

units.zh: 昌之前母，宜依叔隗為比。
units.en: Chang's first mother should be compared to Shu Wei.
units.literal: Chang's first mother should be compared to Shu Ji.

units.zh: 若亡在昌未生之前者，則昌不應復服。
units.en: If she died before Chang was born, Chang need not wear mourning.
units.literal: If she died before Chang was born, Chang need not wear mourning.

units.zh: 生及母存，自應如禮以名服三年。
units.en: If she was alive when he was born, he follows the canonical three-year term by name.
units.literal: If she was alive when he was born, he follows the canonical three-year term by name.

units.zh: 輒正定為文，章下太常報楙奉行。」
units.en: They therefore fixed the text in writing and sent it down to the Chamberlain for Ceremonials for Mao to execute.'
units.literal: They therefore fixed the text in writing and sent it down to the Chamberlain for Ceremonials for Mao to execute.'

units.zh: 制曰：「凡事有非常，當依準舊典，為之立斷。
units.en: The edict said: "Whenever an affair is extraordinary, one must rely on old canons and render a decision.
units.literal: The edict said: "Whenever an affair is extraordinary, one must rely on old canons and render a decision.

units.zh: 今議此事，稱引趙姬、叔隗者粗是也。
units.en: Now in debating this matter, citing Lady Zhao and Shu Wei is roughly right.
units.literal: Now in debating this matter, citing Lady Zhao and Shu Ji is roughly right.

units.zh: 然後狄與晉和，故姬氏得迎叔隗而下之。
units.en: But then the Di made peace with Jin, so the Ji lady could welcome Shu Wei and rank her below herself.
units.literal: But then the Di made peace with Jin, so the Ji lady could welcome Shu Ji and rank her below herself.

units.zh: 吳寇隔塞，毖與前妻，終始永絕。
units.en: Wu rebels blocked the roads—Wang Bi and his first wife were forever severed.
units.literal: Wu rebels blocked the roads—Wang Bi and his first wife were forever severed.

units.zh: 必義無兩嫡，則趙衰可以專制隗氏。
units.en: If righteousness forbids two principals, then Zhao Shuai could have monopolized the Lady of the Di line.
units.literal: If righteousness forbids two principals, then Zhao Dun could have monopolized the Lady of the Di line.

units.zh: 昌為人子，豈得擅替其母。
units.en: As a son, how could Chang on his own replace his mother!
units.literal: As a son, how could Chang on his own replace his mother!

units.zh: 且毖二妻並以絕亡，其子猶後母之子耳，昌故不應制服也。」
units.en: Moreover, both of Bi's wives are dead; the sons are children of the later mother only—Chang therefore should not wear mourning for the first.'
units.literal: Moreover, both of Bi's wives are dead; the sons are children of the later mother only—Chang therefore should not wear mourning for the first.'

units.zh: 太興初，著作郎干寶論之曰：「禮有經有變有權，王毖之事，有為為之也。
units.en: At the beginning of Taixing, Editorial Director Gan Bao reflected: "Ritual has constant, adaptive, and expedient levels—Wang Bi's affair was handled with motive.
units.literal: At the beginning of Taixing, Editorial Director Gan Bao reflected: "Ritual has constant, adaptive, and expedient levels—Wang Bi's affair was handled with motive.

units.zh: 有不可責以始終之義，不可求以循常之文，何群議之紛錯！
units.en: Some cases cannot be judged by rules from cradle to grave, nor squeezed into ordinary text—why so many tangled opinions!
units.literal: Some cases cannot be judged by rules from cradle to grave, nor squeezed into ordinary text—why so many tangled opinions!

units.zh: 同產者無嫡側之別，而先生為兄；
units.en: Those born of the same mother have no distinction of principal versus secondary—yet the elder is called brother;
units.literal: Those born of the same mother have no distinction of principal versus secondary—yet the elder is called brother;

units.zh: 諸侯同爵無等級之差，而先封為長。
units.en: Among feudal lords of equal rank there is no gradation—yet the first enfeoffed is treated as senior.
units.literal: Among feudal lords of equal rank there is no gradation—yet the first enfeoffed is treated as senior.

units.zh: 今二妻之入，無貴賤之禮，則宜以先後為秩，順序義也。
units.en: Now when two wives enter a house without ritual ranking of noble versus base, precedence should follow order of entry—this matches orderly rightness.
units.literal: Now when two wives enter a house without ritual ranking of noble versus base, precedence should follow order of entry—this matches orderly rightness.

units.zh: 今生而同室者寡，死而同廟者眾，及其神位，固有上下也。
units.en: In life few today share one roof; in death many share one temple—so for spirit tablets there is naturally an upper and lower.
units.literal: In life few today share one roof; in death many share one temple—so for spirit tablets there is naturally an upper and lower.

units.zh: 故《春秋》賢趙姬遭禮之變而得禮情也。
units.en: Therefore the Spring and Autumn praises Lady Zhao for meeting a ritual anomaly with humane feeling.
units.literal: Therefore the Spring and Autumn praises Lady Zhao for meeting a ritual anomaly with humane feeling.

units.zh: 且夫吉凶哀樂，動乎情者也，五禮之制，所以敘情而即事也。
units.en: Moreover, auspicious and inauspicious, grief and joy, are stirred by feeling; the five rites exist to order feeling and fit the affair.
units.literal: Moreover, auspicious and inauspicious, grief and joy, are stirred by feeling; the five rites exist to order feeling and fit the affair.

units.zh: 今二母者，本他人也，以名來親，而恩否于時，敬不及生，愛不及喪，夫何追服之道哉！
units.en: Now the two mothers were originally strangers; they became 'kin' only by name, while affection waxed or waned with the hour—reverence never reached them in life, love never reached them in death—what principle demands retroactive mourning!"
units.literal: Now the two mothers were originally strangers; they became 'kin' only by name, while affection waxed or waned with the hour—reverence never reached them in life, love never reached them in death—what principle demands retroactive mourning!"

units.zh: 張惲、劉卞，得其先後之節，齊王、衛恆，通於服絕之制，可以斷矣。
units.en: Zhang Yun and Liu Bian grasped the precedence of first and last; the Prince of Qi and Wei Heng understood when mourning rightly ends—on that the case may be decided.
units.literal: Zhang Yun and Liu Bian grasped the precedence of first and last; the Prince of Qi and Wei Heng understood when mourning rightly ends—on that the case may be decided.

units.zh: 朝廷於此，宜導之以趙姬，齊之以詔命，使先妻恢含容之德，後妻崇卑讓之道，室人達長少之序，百姓見變禮之中。
units.en: The court here should guide them with Lady Zhao's example, align them with edicts, let the first wife practice tolerant virtue, the later wife practice yielding humility, household members grasp senior and junior order, and the people see adaptation within change.
units.literal: The court here should guide them with Lady Zhao's example, align them with edicts, let the first wife practice tolerant virtue, the later wife practice yielding humility, household members grasp senior and junior order, and the people see adaptation within change.

units.zh: 若此，可以居生，又況於死乎！
units.en: If that can govern the living, how much more the dead!
units.literal: If that can govern the living, how much more the dead!

units.zh: 古之王者，有以師友之禮待其臣，而臣不敢自尊。
units.en: Ancient kings treated ministers with teacher-and-friend courtesy, yet ministers dared not presume on it.
units.literal: Ancient kings treated ministers with teacher-and-friend courtesy, yet ministers dared not presume on it.

units.zh: 今令先妻以一體接後，而後妻不敢抗，及其子孫交相為服，禮之善物也。
units.en: Now let the first wife receive the later wife as one body, while the later wife dares not resist; let their grandsons exchange mourning garments—this is ritual's finest fruit.
units.literal: Now let the first wife receive the later wife as one body, while the later wife dares not resist; let their grandsons exchange mourning garments—this is ritual's finest fruit.

units.zh: 然則王昌兄弟相得之日，蓋宜祫祭二母，等其禮饋，序其先後，配以左右，兄弟肅雍，交酬奏獻，上以恕先父之志，中以高二母之德，下以齊兄弟之好，使義風弘于王教，慈讓洽乎急難，不亦得禮之本乎！」
units.en: Then on days when Wang Chang's brothers gather, they should jointly sacrifice to both mothers, equalize offerings, order precedence, seat tablets left and right; brothers in harmony would alternate toasts, satisfying the late father's intent, honoring both mothers' virtue, and knitting brotherly affection—spreading dutiful custom through royal instruction and kindly yielding through crisis—is that not ritual's root!"
units.literal: Then on days when Wang Chang's brothers gather, they should jointly sacrifice to both mothers, equalize offerings, order precedence, seat tablets left and right; brothers in harmony would alternate toasts, satisfying the late father's intent, honoring both mothers' virtue, and knitting brotherly affection—spreading dutiful custom through royal instruction and kindly yielding through crisis—is that not ritual's root!"

units.zh: 是時，沛國劉仲武先娶毌丘氏，生子正舒、正則二人。
units.en: At that time Liu Zhongwu of Pei first married a daughter of the Guqiu clan and bore sons Zhengshu and Zhengzhe.'
units.literal: At that time Liu Zhongwu of Pei first married a daughter of the Guqiu clan and bore sons Zhengshu and Zhengzhe.'

units.zh: 毌丘儉反敗，仲武出其妻，娶王氏，生陶，仲武為毌丘氏別舍而不告絕。
units.en: When Guqiu Jian rebelled and fell, Zhongwu cast out his wife and married Lady Wang, bearing Tao; he housed the Guqiu separately but never formally severed ties.'
units.literal: When Guqiu Jian rebelled and fell, Zhongwu cast out his wife and married Lady Wang, bearing Tao; he housed the Guqiu separately but never formally severed ties.'

units.zh: 及毌丘氏卒，正舒求祔葬焉，而陶不許。
units.en: When Guqiu died, Zhengshu asked to bury her by attachment, but Tao refused.'
units.literal: When Guqiu died, Zhengshu asked to bury her by attachment, but Tao refused.'

units.zh: 舒不釋服，訟於上下，泣血露骨，縗裳綴絡，數十年弗得從，以至死亡。
units.en: Shu refused to shed mourning, sued up and down, wept blood and exposed bone, patching hemp for decades until death without winning his suit.'
units.literal: Shu refused to shed mourning, sued up and down, wept blood and exposed bone, patching hemp for decades until death without winning his suit.'

units.zh: 時吳國朱某娶妻陳氏，生子東伯。
units.en: In Wu, a man Zhu took wife Chen and bore Dongbo.'
units.literal: In Wu, a man Zhu took wife Chen and bore Dongbo.'

units.zh: 入晉，晉賜妻某氏，生子綏伯。
units.en: Entering Jin, Jin granted him another wife and bore Suibo.'
units.literal: Entering Jin, Jin granted him another wife and bore Suibo.'

units.zh: 太康之中，某已亡，綏伯將母以歸邦族，兄弟交愛敬之道，二母篤先後之序，雍雍人無間焉。
units.en: In Taikang, when the first had died, Suibo brought his mother home to the lineage; brothers practiced mutual love and respect, the two mothers honored order of seniority, and the household was harmonious without rancor.'
units.literal: In Taikang, when the first had died, Suibo brought his mother home to the lineage; brothers practiced mutual love and respect, the two mothers honored order of seniority, and the household was harmonious without rancor.'

units.zh: 及其終也，二子交相為服，君子以為賢。
units.en: When they died, the two sons wore mourning for each other's mothers—gentleman deemed them worthy.'
units.literal: When they died, the two sons wore mourning for each other's mothers—gentleman deemed them worthy.'

units.zh: 安豐太守程諒先已有妻，後又娶，遂立二嫡。
units.en: Cheng Liang, prefect of Anfeng, already had a wife, then married again, thus setting up two principals.'
units.literal: Cheng Liang, prefect of Anfeng, already had a wife, then married again, thus setting up two principals.'

units.zh: 前妻亡，後妻子勳疑所服。
units.en: When the first wife died, the later wife's son Xun doubted what to wear.'
units.literal: When the first wife died, the later wife's son Xun doubted what to wear.'

units.zh: 中書令張華造甲乙之問曰：「甲娶乙為妻，後又娶丙，匿不說有乙，居家如二嫡，無有貴賤之差。
units.en: Prefect of the Masters of Writing Zhang Hua posed a paired question: "A took B as wife, later took C, hiding that B existed—he lived as if with two principals of equal rank.
units.literal: Prefect of the Masters of Writing Zhang Hua posed a paired question: "A took B as wife, later took C, hiding that B existed—he lived as if with two principals of equal rank.

units.zh: 乙亡，丙之子當何服？
units.en: When B died, what should C's son wear?
units.literal: When B died, what should C's son wear?

units.zh: 本實並列，嫡庶不殊，雖二嫡非正，此失在先人，人子何得專制析其親也。
units.en: In truth both stood coequal; principal and secondary were not distinguished—though two principals are irregular, the fault lies with the elders; how may a child on his own sever kin!
units.literal: In truth both stood coequal; principal and secondary were not distinguished—though two principals are irregular, the fault lies with the elders; how may a child on his own sever kin!

units.zh: 若為庶母服，又不成為庶。
units.en: If he wears mourning for a concubine-mother, he cannot really be a concubine son.
units.literal: If he wears mourning for a concubine-mother, he cannot really be a concubine son.

units.zh: 進退不知所從。」
units.en: He cannot decide whether to advance or retreat.'
units.literal: He cannot decide whether to advance or retreat.'

units.zh: 太傅鄭沖議曰：「甲失禮於家，二嫡並在，誠非人子所得正。
units.en: Grand Tutor Zheng Chong answered: "A failed ritual at home—two principals present—is not something a child may correct.
units.literal: Grand Tutor Zheng Chong answered: "A failed ritual at home—two principals present—is not something a child may correct.

units.zh: 則乙丙之子並當三年，禮疑從重。」
units.en: Then sons of both B and C should wear three years; when ritual doubts, follow the heavier.'
units.literal: Then sons of both B and C should wear three years; when ritual doubts, follow the heavier.'

units.zh: 車騎賈充、侍中少傅任愷議略與鄭同。
units.en: General of Chariots and Cavalry Jia Chong and Palace Attendant Junior Tutor Ren Kai largely agreed with Zheng.'
units.literal: General of Chariots and Cavalry Jia Chong and Palace Attendant Junior Tutor Ren Kai largely agreed with Zheng.'

units.zh: 太尉荀顗議曰：「《春秋》並后匹嫡，古之明典也。
units.en: Grand Commandant Xun Yi answered: "The Spring and Autumn treats two coequal empresses as a clear mirror of error.
units.literal: Grand Commandant Xun Yi answered: "The Spring and Autumn treats two coequal empresses as a clear mirror of error.

units.zh: 今不可以犯禮並立二妻，不別尊卑而遂其失也。
units.en: Today one cannot break ritual to keep two wives; one must not blur noble and base and perpetuate the fault.
units.literal: Today one cannot break ritual to keep two wives; one must not blur noble and base and perpetuate the fault.

units.zh: 故當斷之以禮，先至為嫡，後至為庶。
units.en: Therefore ritual must decide: first arrival is principal, later is secondary.
units.literal: Therefore ritual must decide: first arrival is principal, later is secondary.

units.zh: 丙子宜以嫡母服乙，乙子宜以庶母事丙。
units.en: C's son should mourn B as principal mother; B's son should serve C as secondary mother.
units.literal: C's son should mourn B as principal mother; B's son should serve C as secondary mother.

units.zh: 昔屈建去芰，古人以為違禮而得禮。
units.en: Formerly Qu Jian cast aside water caltrop—ancients thought him wrong on the letter yet right on ritual.
units.literal: Formerly Qu Jian cast aside water caltrop—ancients thought him wrong on the letter yet right on ritual.

units.zh: 丙子非為抑其親，斯自奉禮先後貴賤順敘之義也。」
units.en: C's son is not belittling kin—he follows the sequence of ritual precedence.'
units.literal: C's son is not belittling kin—he follows the sequence of ritual precedence.'

units.zh: 中書監荀勖議曰：「昔鄉里鄭子群娶陳司空從妹，後隔呂布之亂，不復相知存亡，更娶鄉里蔡氏女。
units.en: Director of the Palace Secretariat Xun Xu answered: "Formerly Zheng Ziqun of the village married a cousin of Director Chen; later, separated by Lu Bu's chaos, he could not learn whether she lived, and remarried a Cai woman in the village.
units.literal: Director of the Palace Secretariat Xun Xu answered: "Formerly Zheng Ziqun of the village married a cousin of Director Chen; later, separated by Lu Bu's chaos, he could not learn whether she lived, and remarried a Cai woman in the village.

units.zh: 徐州平定，陳氏得還，遂二妃並存。
units.en: When Xuzhou was pacified, the Chen lady returned—then both consorts coexisted.
units.literal: When Xuzhou was pacified, the Chen lady returned—then both consorts coexisted.

units.zh: 蔡氏之子字元釁，為陳氏服嫡母之服，事陳公以從舅之禮。
units.en: The Cai son, styled Yuanxin, wore principal mourning for the Chen lady and served Director Chen by the courtesy due a maternal uncle.
units.literal: The Cai son, styled Yuanxin, wore principal mourning for the Chen lady and served Director Chen by the courtesy due a maternal uncle.

units.zh: 族兄宗伯曾責元釁，謂抑其親，鄉里先達以元釁為合宜。
units.en: A senior kinsman once reproached Yuanxin for belittling kin, yet village worthies approved him.
units.literal: A senior kinsman once reproached Yuanxin for belittling kin, yet village worthies approved him.

units.zh: 不審此事粗相似否。」，
units.en: He asked whether the present case is broadly similar.'
units.literal: He asked whether the present case is broadly similar.'

units.zh: 建武元年，以溫嶠為散騎侍郎，嶠以母亡值寇，不臨殯葬，欲營改葬，固讓不拜。
units.en: In Jianwu 1, Wen Jiao was made Cavalier Attendant-in-ordinary; because his mother had died during bandit troubles and he had not attended the encoffining and burial, he wished to arrange a reburial and firmly declined without accepting appointment.
units.literal: In Jianwu 1, Wen Jiao was made Cavalier Attendant-in-ordinary; because his mother had died during bandit troubles and he had not attended the encoffining and burial, he wished to arrange a reburial and firmly declined without accepting appointment.

units.zh: 元帝詔曰：「溫嶠不拜，以未得改卜葬送，朝議又頗有異同。
units.en: Emperor Yuan's edict said: "Wen Jiao has not accepted appointment because he has not yet been able to divine a new burial site and conduct the funeral; court discussion has also differed considerably.
units.literal: Emperor Yuan's edict said: "Wen Jiao has not accepted appointment because he has not yet been able to divine a new burial site and conduct the funeral; court discussion has also differed considerably.

units.zh: 為審由此邪？
units.en: Is it truly for this reason?
units.literal: Is it truly for this reason?

units.zh: 天下有闕塞，行禮制物者當使理可經通。
units.en: When the realm has obstructions and blockages, those who apply ritual and regulate affairs should make principle capable of practical passage.
units.literal: When the realm has obstructions and blockages, those who apply ritual and regulate affairs should make principle capable of practical passage.

units.zh: 古人之制三年，非情之所盡，蓋存亡有斷，不以死傷生耳。
units.en: The ancient three-year mourning system did not exhaust feeling; rather, it set a boundary between the living and the dead, so that the dead would not injure the living.
units.literal: The ancient three-year mourning system did not exhaust feeling; rather, it set a boundary between the living and the dead, so that the dead would not injure the living.

units.zh: 要絰而服金革之役者，豈營官邪？
units.en: Those who gird on mourning cords and serve in campaigns of armor and weapons, are they seeking office?
units.literal: Those who gird on mourning cords and serve in campaigns of armor and weapons, are they seeking office?

units.zh: 隨王事之緩急也。
units.en: They follow the urgency or slackness of royal affairs.
units.literal: They follow the urgency or slackness of royal affairs.

units.zh: 今桀逆未梟，平陽道斷，奉迎諸軍猶未得徑進，嶠特一身，于何濟其私艱，而以理閡自疑，不服王命邪！
units.en: Now the cruel rebel has not been beheaded, the road to Pingyang is cut, and the armies sent to escort the court still cannot advance directly; what help can Jiao, one man alone, give to his private difficulty, that he should obstruct himself with ritual principle and doubt whether to obey the royal command?
units.literal: Now the cruel rebel has not been beheaded, the road to Pingyang is cut, and the armies sent to escort the court still cannot advance directly; what help can Jiao, one man alone, give to his private difficulty, that he should obstruct himself with ritual principle and doubt whether to obey the royal command?

units.zh: 其令三司八座、門下三省、外內群臣，詳共通議如嶠比，吾將親裁其中。」
units.en: Let the Three Excellencies, the Eight Seats, the three Chancellery bureaus, and all inner and outer ministers carefully deliberate together on cases like Jiao's; I will personally judge the proper middle."
units.literal: Let the Three Excellencies, the Eight Seats, the three Chancellery bureaus, and all inner and outer ministers carefully deliberate together on cases like Jiao's; I will personally judge the proper middle."

units.zh: 於是太宰、西陽王羕，司徒臨潁公組，驃騎將軍、即丘子導，侍中紀瞻，尚書周顗，散騎常侍荀邃等議，以「昔伍員挾弓去楚，為吳行人以謀楚，誠志在報仇，不苟滅身也。
units.en: Thereupon the Grand Steward, Prince Yang of Xiyang; Situ Zu, Duke of Linying; General of Agile Cavalry Dao, Baron of Jiqiu; Palace Attendant Ji Zhan; Minister Zhou Yi; Palace Attendant Cavalier Xun Sui; and others deliberated, taking the view, "Formerly Wu Yuan carried his bow and left Chu, became envoy for Wu, and thereby plotted against Chu. His sincere intent lay in avenging wrong; he did not lightly destroy himself.
units.literal: Thereupon the Grand Steward, Prince Yang of Xiyang; Situ Zu, Duke of Linying; General of Agile Cavalry Dao, Baron of Jiqiu; Palace Attendant Ji Zhan; Minister Zhou Yi; Palace Attendant Cavalier Xun Sui; and others deliberated, taking the view, "Formerly Wu Yuan carried his bow and left Chu, became envoy for Wu, and thereby plotted against Chu. His sincere intent lay in avenging wrong; he did not lightly destroy himself.

units.zh: 溫嶠遭難，昔在河朔，日尋干戈，志刷讎惡，萬里投身，歸赴朝廷，將欲因時竭力，憑賴王威，以展其情，此乃嶠之志也。
units.en: When Wen Jiao suffered calamity, north of the Yellow River he daily took up arms, intent on wiping out his foe; he crossed ten thousand li to reach court, wishing to seize the moment and exhaust his strength, trusting royal majesty to vent his heart—that was Jiao's intent.
units.literal: When Wen Jiao suffered calamity, north of the Yellow River he daily took up arms, intent on wiping out his foe; he crossed ten thousand li to reach court, wishing to seize the moment and exhaust his strength, trusting royal majesty to vent his heart—that was Jiao's intent.

units.zh: 無緣道路未通，師旅未進，而更中辭王事，留志家巷也。
units.en: It is not that roads were still blocked and armies had not marched, yet he set aside royal business midcourse and fixed his mind on home lanes.
units.literal: It is not that roads were still blocked and armies had not marched, yet he set aside royal business midcourse and fixed his mind on home lanes.

units.zh: 以為誠宜如明詔。」
units.en: They held it truly fitting to follow the clear edict.'
units.literal: They held it truly fitting to follow the clear edict.'

units.zh: 於是有司奏曰：「案如眾議，去建武元年九月下辛未令書，依禮文，父喪未葬，唯喪主不除。
units.en: Thereupon the offices memorialized: "Reviewing the discussion, the edict issued in Jianwu 1, ninth month, on xinwei said that, according to ritual texts, when a father's funeral is not complete, only the chief mourner does not remove mourning.
units.literal: Thereupon the offices memorialized: "Reviewing the discussion, the edict issued in Jianwu 1, ninth month, on xinwei said that, according to ritual texts, when a father's funeral is not complete, only the chief mourner does not remove mourning.

units.zh: 以他故未葬，人子之情，不可居殯而除，故期於畢葬，無遠近之斷也。
units.en: When burial has not taken place for some other reason, a son's feeling cannot permit him to remove mourning while the coffin remains in state; therefore the term waits until burial is completed, with no cutoff based on distance.
units.literal: When burial has not taken place for some other reason, a son's feeling cannot permit him to remove mourning while the coffin remains in state; therefore the term waits until burial is completed, with no cutoff based on distance.

units.zh: 若亡遇賊難，喪靈無處，求索理絕，固應三年而除，不得故從未葬之例也。
units.en: But if the deceased met bandit troubles, the spirit of the dead has no resting place, and searching is impossible in principle, then mourning should certainly be removed after three years; one may not deliberately follow the precedent for an unburied corpse.
units.literal: But if the deceased met bandit troubles, the spirit of the dead has no resting place, and searching is impossible in principle, then mourning should certainly be removed after three years; one may not deliberately follow the precedent for an unburied corpse.

units.zh: 若骨肉殲於寇害，死亡漫于中原，而繼以遺賊未滅，亡者無收殯之實，存者又闕於奔赴之禮，而人子之情，哀痛無斷，輒依未葬之義，久而不除，若遂其情，則人居無限之喪，非有禮無時不得之義也。
units.en: If one's flesh and blood are destroyed by enemy harm, death spreads across the Central Plains, the remaining rebels are still not extinguished, the dead cannot actually be collected and encoffined, and the living also lack the rites of hurrying to the funeral, then filial feeling and grief have no cutoff. Yet if one therefore relies on the principle of unburied mourning and does not remove it for a long time, and if feeling is allowed to run its course, people will dwell in mourning without limit; this is not the ritual principle that there is no time when it may not be done.
units.literal: If one's flesh and blood are destroyed by enemy harm, death spreads across the Central Plains, the remaining rebels are still not extinguished, the dead cannot actually be collected and encoffined, and the living also lack the rites of hurrying to the funeral, then filial feeling and grief have no cutoff. Yet if one therefore relies on the principle of unburied mourning and does not remove it for a long time, and if feeling is allowed to run its course, people will dwell in mourning without limit; this is not the ritual principle that there is no time when it may not be done.

units.zh: 諸如此，皆依東關故事，限行三年之禮畢而除也。
units.en: Cases such as these all follow the precedent from Dongguan: when the prescribed three-year rites have been completed, mourning is removed.
units.literal: Cases such as these all follow the precedent from Dongguan: when the prescribed three-year rites have been completed, mourning is removed.

units.zh: 唯二親生離，吉凶未分，服喪則凶事未據，從吉則疑於不存，心憂居素，出自人情，有如此者，非官制之所裁。
units.en: Only when one is separated from both parents in life and it is unknown whether they are alive or dead—mourning would rest on an unconfirmed death, while living normally raises doubt about their absence—does one keep an anxious, plain life out of natural feeling; such cases are not for official regulation to decide.
units.literal: Only when two relatives are separated, the good and bad are not divided. When mourning, the bad things are not confirmed. When the good is good, there is doubt about the absence. The heart is worried and it is out of human feelings. Such people are not ruled by the official system.

units.zh: 今嶠以未得改卜奔赴，累設疾辭。
units.en: Now Jiao, because he has not yet been able to divine a new burial site and hasten to the funeral, has repeatedly pleaded illness to decline.
units.literal: Today, Qiao has not been able to change the divination and rushed to it, leaving many excuses.

units.zh: 案辛未之制，已有成斷，皆不得復遂其私情，不服王命，以虧法憲。
units.en: Under the xinwei regulation a settled ruling already exists: none may again indulge private feeling, disobey the royal command, and so damage the laws.
units.literal: The system of the case Xinwei has been concluded, and no one can resume his personal relationship, disobey the king's order, and violate the law and the constitution.

units.zh: 參議可如前詔嶠受拜，重告以中丞司徒，諸如嶠比者，依東關故事辛未令書之制。」
units.en: We propose that, as in the previous edict, Jiao accept the appointment, and that the Palace Assistant Secretary and the Situ be informed again; all cases like Jiao's should follow the Dongguan precedent and the xinwei ordinance."
units.literal: The counselor can be worshiped like the previous imperial edict to Qiao, and then report to the Zhongcheng Situ again, such as Qiao Bi, according to the Dongguan Story Xinwei Order.'

units.zh: 嶠不得已，乃拜。
units.en: Jiao had no choice but to accept the appointment.
units.literal: Qiao had no choice but to worship.

units.zh: 是時中原喪亂，室家離析，朝廷議二親陷沒寇難，應制服不。
units.en: At that time the Central Plains were in turmoil and families were scattered; the court debated whether one should wear mourning when both parents had been lost to bandits.
units.literal: At that time, the Central Plains was in chaos and the family was separated. The court discussed whether the two relatives should be subdued if they were trapped by the bandits.

units.zh: 太常賀循曰：二親生離，吉凶未分，服喪則凶事未據，從吉則疑於不存，心憂居素，允當人情。」
units.en: Chamberlain for Ceremonials He Xun said: "When one is separated from both parents in life and it is unknown whether they are alive or dead, wearing mourning would rest on an unconfirmed death, while living normally raises doubt about their absence; keeping an anxious, plain life truly fits human feeling."
units.literal: Taichang congratulated Xun and said: Two relatives are separated at birth, and the good and bad are not divided. If you are in mourning, the bad things will not be confirmed. If you follow the good luck, you will doubt that it will not exist. If you are worried, you should accept it as a favor.”

units.zh: 元帝令以循議為然，
units.en: Emperor Yuan ordered that He Xun's opinion be adopted.
units.literal: Emperor Yuan’s order was based on the discussion,

units.zh: 太興二年，司徒荀組云：「二親陷沒寇難，萬無一冀者，宜使依王法，隨例行喪。」
units.en: In the second year of Taixing, Situ Xun Zu said, "When both parents have fallen into bandit troubles and there is not one chance in ten thousand to hope for them, one should have the person rely on royal law and carry out mourning according to precedent."
units.literal: In the second year of Taixing, Situ Xun Zu said, "When both parents have fallen into bandit troubles and there is not one chance in ten thousand to hope for them, one should have the person rely on royal law and carry out mourning according to precedent."

units.zh: 庾蔚之云：「二親為戎狄所破，存亡未可知者，宜盡尋求之理。
units.en: Yu Weizhi said: "When both parents have been overrun by the Rong and Di and it is unknown whether they survive, one should exhaust every means of searching for them.
units.literal: Yu Wei said: "The two relatives were destroyed by the Rong and Di, and their survival is unknown. It is best to seek the truth.

units.zh: 尋求之理絕，三年之外，便宜婚宦，胤嗣不可絕，王政不可廢故也。
units.en: When searching is no longer possible, after three years one may marry and take office, because the line of heirs must not be cut off and royal government must not be abandoned.
units.literal: The truth to be sought is that within three years, a cheap marriage can be arranged, the heir cannot be cut off, and the king's government cannot be abolished.

units.zh: 猶宜以哀素自居，不豫吉慶之事，待中壽而服之也。
units.en: Still, one should live in grief and plainness, take no part in festivities, and put on mourning when the parents would have reached a middle lifespan.
units.literal: It is better to regard oneself as mourning, not to hesitate about auspicious things, but to wait for a long life and obey them.

units.zh: 若境內賊亂清平，肆眚之後，尋覺無蹤跡者，便宜制服。」，
units.en: If the region is cleared of bandits and, after an amnesty, a search still finds no trace, one may then wear mourning."
units.literal: If there is chaos in the territory and there is no trace of the thieves, they can be subdued easily. "

units.zh: 咸康二年，零陵李繁姊先適南平郡陳詵為妻，產四子而遭賊。
units.en: In Xiankang 2, Li Fan's elder sister of Lingling, wife of Chen Shen of Nanping and mother of four, was caught in a bandit attack.
units.literal: In Xiankang 2, Li Fan's elder sister of Lingling had first married Chen Shen of Nanping Commandery as his wife, had borne four sons, and encountered bandits.

units.zh: 姊投身于賊，請活姑命，賊略將姊去。
units.en: She threw herself before the bandits to save her mother-in-law; they seized her instead and carried her off.
units.literal: The elder sister threw herself before the bandits and begged them to spare her mother-in-law's life; the bandits seized the sister and took her away.

units.zh: 詵更娶嚴氏，生三子。
units.en: Shen remarried a woman of the Yan clan, who bore three sons.
units.literal: Shengen married the Yan family and had three sons.

units.zh: 繁後得姊消息，往迎還詵，詵籍注領二妻。
units.en: Later Li Fan learned news of his elder sister and went to bring her back to Shen; Shen's household register listed two wives.
units.literal: After Fan got news about her sister, she went to welcome Shen back, and Shen's family was registered to take over his second wife.

units.zh: 及李亡，詵疑制服，以事言征西大將軍庾亮府平議，時議亦往往異同。
units.en: When Li died, Shen was uncertain about the mourning rules and reported the matter to the headquarters of Yu Liang, General Who Campaigns in the West, for deliberation; opinions at the time also differed here and there.
units.literal: When Li died, Shen was uncertain about the mourning rules and reported the matter to the headquarters of Yu Liang, General Who Campaigns in the West, for deliberation; opinions at the time also differed here and there.

units.zh: 司馬王愆期議曰：「案禮不二嫡，故惠西元妃孟子，孟子卒，繼室以聲子。
units.en: Adjutant Wang Qianqi proposed: "Examining the rites, there cannot be two principal wives. Thus Duke Hui of Lu had Mengzi as his first wife; when Mengzi died, Shengzi became the successor wife.
units.literal: Sima Wang Qianqi proposed: “Examining the rites, there cannot be two principal wives. Thus Duke Hui of Lu had Mengzi as his first wife; when Mengzi died, Shengzi became the successor wife.

units.zh: 諸侯猶爾，況庶人乎！
units.en: This was so even among feudal lords; how much more among commoners!
units.literal: This was so even among feudal lords; how much more among commoners!

units.zh: 《士喪禮》曰，繼母本實繼室，故稱繼母，事之如嫡，故曰如母也。
units.en: The Shi sang li says that a stepmother is in fact a successor wife, and is therefore called stepmother; one serves her as one would the principal mother, and therefore the text says “like a mother.”
units.literal: The Shi sang li says that a stepmother is in fact a successor wife, and is therefore called stepmother; one serves her as one would the principal mother, and therefore the text says “like a mother.”

units.zh: 詵不能遠慮避難，以亡其妻，非犯七出見絕於詵。
units.en: Shen failed to plan far ahead and avoid danger, and thereby lost his wife; she did not commit one of the seven grounds for dismissal and was not cut off by Shen.
units.literal: Shen failed to plan far ahead and avoid danger, and thereby lost his wife; she did not commit one of the seven grounds for dismissal and was not cut off by Shen.

units.zh: 始不見絕，終又見迎，養姑于堂，子為首嫡，列名黃籍，則詵之妻也。
units.en: She was never cut off at the start and was finally welcomed back; she cared for her mother-in-law in the hall, her son is the eldest principal heir, and her name is in the yellow register—so she is Shen's wife.
units.literal: At first, she didn't see Jue, but finally she met again. She raised a aunt in the hall, and her son was the first direct descendant. She was listed as Huang Ji, so she was Shen's wife.

units.zh: 為詵也妻，則為暉也母，暉之制服無所疑矣。
units.en: If she is Shen's wife, then she is Hui's mother. There is no doubt about Hui's uniform.
units.literal: If she is Shen's wife, then she is Hui's mother. There is no doubt about Hui's uniform.

units.zh: 禮為繼母服而不為前母服者，如李比類，曠世所希。
units.en: Ritual prescribes mourning for a stepmother but not for a former mother because cases like Li's are almost unheard of in any age.
units.literal: Those who follow the etiquette for their stepmother but not for their former mother, such as Li Bi, are the only ones in the world.

units.zh: 前母既終，乃有繼母，後子不及前母，故無制服之文。
units.en: When the former mother has died and only then a stepmother comes, the later sons never knew the former mother, so there is no text prescribing mourning.
units.literal: After the death of the first mother, there is a stepmother. The second son is not as good as the first mother, so there is no uniform document.

units.zh: 然礿祠蒸嘗，未有不以前母為母者，亡猶母之，況其存乎！
units.en: Yet in the seasonal sacrifices no one fails to treat the former mother as mother; if she is treated as mother even in death, how much more while alive!
units.literal: However, when the temple is steamed and tasted, there is no one who is not the mother of the previous mother. She died like her mother, how much less does she exist!

units.zh: 詵有老母，不可以莫之養，妻無歸期，納妾可也。
units.en: Shen had an aged mother who could not go without care, and his wife had no date of return; taking a concubine would have been acceptable.
units.literal: Shen has an old mother who cannot be taken care of. There is no date of return for his wife, so he can take concubines.

units.zh: 李雖沒賊，尚有生冀，詵尋求之理不盡，而便娶妻，誠詵之短也。
units.en: Although Li was lost to the bandits, there was still hope she lived; Shen did not exhaust the search before remarrying—truly a fault in Shen.
units.literal: Although Li had no thieves, he still had hopes for life, and Shen's pursuit of truth was incomplete, so he married a wife, which was a shortcoming of his sincerity.

units.zh: 然隴畝之夫，不達禮義，考之傳記不勝。
units.en: But he was a peasant of the fields who did not understand ritual and propriety; in the commentaries and records such cases are beyond counting.
units.literal: However, the husband of Longmu was not upholding etiquette and righteousness, and his biography was inconclusive.

units.zh: 有施孝叔之妻失身于郤犨而不棄者，以非其罪也。
units.en: Shi Xiaoshu's wife lost her chastity to Xi Chou yet was not cast off, because the fault was not hers.
units.literal: If Uncle Shi Xiao's wife loses her virginity to Queji and never abandons her, it is not a crime.

units.zh: 詵有兩妻，非故犯法。
units.en: Shen's having two wives was not a deliberate breach of law.
units.literal: Shen had two wives and broke the law without any reason.

units.zh: 李鄙野人，而能臨危請活姑命，險不忘順，可謂孝婦矣。
units.en: Li was a rustic woman, yet in danger she begged for her mother-in-law's life and did not forget duty even at risk—she may be called a filial wife.
units.literal: Li Bi is a wild man, but she can ask for her life in the face of danger and never forget to obey. She can be called a filial woman.

units.zh: 議者欲令在沒略之中，必全苦操，有隕無二，是望凡人皆為宋伯姬也。
units.en: Those who would require that a captive woman keep perfect chastity, dying rather than yielding, expect every ordinary person to be Song Boji.
units.literal: Those who want to make an order without any strategy must work hard, and there will be no difference. I hope that everyone will be Song Boji.

units.zh: 詵雖不應娶妻，要以嚴為妻，妻則繼室，本非嫡也。
units.en: Although Shen ought not to have married again, Yan must still count as his wife; as a wife she is the successor, never the principal.
units.literal: Although Shen should not marry a wife, he should be strict with his wife. The wife will be the successor to the wife, and she is not the direct descendant.

units.zh: 雖云非嫡，義在始終，寧可以詵不應二妻而己涉二庭乎！
units.en: Though she is said not to be the principal wife, her bond holds from beginning to end; how could she, merely because Shen ought not to have had two wives, be made to pass into a second household!
units.literal: Even though they are not direct relatives, righteousness is always there. I would rather blame the second wife and get involved in the second court!

units.zh: 若能下之，則趙姬之義。
units.en: If Yan can defer to Li, that would be the righteousness of Zhao Ji.
units.literal: If you can do it, it will be Zhao Ji's duty.

units.zh: 若云不能，官當有制。
units.en: If she cannot, the officials should regulate it.
units.literal: If it is not possible, the officials should have some control over it.

units.zh: 先嫡後繼，有自來矣。
units.en: Principal first, successor after—this has long been the rule.
units.literal: First the direct descendants and then the successors have their own way.

units.zh: 眾議貶譏太峻，故略序異懷。」
units.en: The majority's censure is too harsh, so I briefly set out a different view."
units.literal: Many people think that it is too harsh to be ridiculed, so the preface is slightly different."

units.zh: 亮從愆期議定。
units.en: Yu Liang settled the matter following Wang Qianqi's opinion.
units.literal: Liang agreed from the period of guilt.

units.zh: 《五經通義》以為有德則諡善，無德則諡惡，故雖君臣可同。
units.en: The Comprehensive Meaning of the Five Classics holds that the virtuous receive good posthumous titles and those without virtue bad ones, so ruler and minister may share the same title.
units.literal: "Tongyi of the Five Classics" holds that if one is virtuous, the posthumous title will be good, and if there is no virtue, the posthumous title will be evil, so although the emperor and his ministers can be the same.

units.zh: 魏朝初諡''『宣帝為文侯，景王為武侯』''，文王表不宜與二祖同，於是改諡宣文、忠武。
units.en: At first the Wei court gave posthumous titles making Emperor Xuan "Marquis Wen" and King Jing "Marquis Wu"; King Wen memorialized that these should not duplicate the titles of the two founders, so they were changed to Xuanwen and Zhongwu.
units.literal: At the beginning of the Wei Dynasty, the posthumous titles were ""Emperor Xuan was Marquis Wen, and King Jing was Marquis Wu". It was inappropriate for King Wen to have the same title as his second ancestor, so the posthumous titles were changed to Xuanwen and Zhongwu.

units.zh: 至文王受晉王之號，魏帝又追命宣文為宣王，忠武為景王。
units.en: When King Wen received the title King of Jin, the Wei emperor further posthumously named Xuanwen as King Xuan and Zhongwu as King Jing.
units.literal: When King Wen received the title of King of Jin, Emperor Wei also appointed Xuanwen as King Xuan and Zhongwu as King Jing.

units.zh: 太康八年十月，太常上諡故太常平陵男郭奕為景侯。
units.en: In the tenth month of the eighth year of Taikang, the Taichang proposed the posthumous title Marquis Jing for the late Taichang Guo Yi, Baron of Pingling.
units.literal: In the eighth year of Taikang, in October, Taichang was given the posthumous title, so Guo Yi, the man from Pingling, Taichang, was given the title of Marquis of Jing.

units.zh: 有司奏云：「晉受命以來，祖宗號諡群下未有同者，故郭奕為景，與景皇同，不可聽，宜諡曰穆。」
units.en: The officials memorialized: "Since Jin received the Mandate, no subject has shared a title with the ancestral emperors; Guo Yi titled Jing would match Emperor Jing, which cannot be allowed—he should be titled Mu."
units.literal: An official report said: "Since the Jin Dynasty, there has been no one with the same posthumous title for his ancestors. Therefore, Guo Yi is the king of Jing, and he is the same as Emperor Jing. It is not acceptable to listen to him, so it is appropriate to give him the posthumous title Mu."

units.zh: 王濟、羊璞等並云：「夫無窮之祚，名諡不一，若皆相避，于制難全。
units.en: Wang Ji, Yang Pu, and the others all said: “In an endless imperial blessing, personal names and posthumous titles are not all the same; if all are mutually avoided, the system is hard to complete.
units.literal: Wang Ji, Yang Pu, and the others all said: “In an endless imperial blessing, personal names and posthumous titles are not all the same; if all are mutually avoided, the system is hard to complete.

units.zh: 如悉不避，復非推崇事尊之禮。
units.en: If none are avoided, that again is not the rite of exalting and serving the honored.
units.literal: If none are avoided, that again is not the rite of exalting and serving the honored.

units.zh: 宜依諱名之義，但及七廟祖宗而已，不及遷毀之廟。」
units.en: It is fitting to follow the meaning of name taboo only as far as the ancestors in the seven temples, and not extend it to temples whose tablets have been moved out or destroyed.”
units.literal: It is fitting to follow the meaning of name taboo only as far as the ancestors in the seven temples, and not extend it to temples whose tablets have been moved out or destroyed.”

units.zh: 成粲、武茂、劉訥並云：「同諡非嫌。
units.en: Cheng Can, Wu Mao and Liu Na all said, "It is not inappropriate to have the same posthumous title.
units.literal: Cheng Can, Wu Mao and Liu Na all said, "It is not inappropriate to have the same posthumous title.

units.zh: 號諡者，國之大典，所以厲時作教，經天人之遠旨也。
units.en: Posthumous titles are a great statute of the state, used to spur the age and teach, carrying the far-reaching purpose of Heaven and man.
units.literal: The person with the posthumous title is the grand ceremony of the country, so he teaches in a timely manner and obeys the distant decrees of heaven and man.
